ex.cn: 欲知故事的趣味所在，请往下读。

senses.def: used to show that sb/sth moves or is sent forward

ex.en: She stopped for a moment, then walked on.
ex.cn: 她停了一会儿，然后又向前走。

ex.en: Keep straight on for the beach.
ex.cn: 一直向前走到海滩。

ex.en: From then on he never trusted her again.
ex.cn: 从那时起，他再也不信任她了。

ex.en: Please send the letter on to my new address.
ex.cn: 请把信件转寄到我的新地址。

senses.def: on sb's body; being worn

ex.en: Put your coat on.
ex.cn: 把外衣穿上。

ex.en: I didn't have my glasses on.
ex.cn: 我没戴眼镜。

ex.en: What did she have on (= what was she wearing)?
ex.cn: 她穿着什么衣服？

senses.def: covering, touching or forming part of sth
senses.chn: （表示覆盖、接触某物或成为某物的一部分）

ex.en: Make sure the lid is on.
ex.cn: 要注意盖上盖子。

senses.def: connected or operating; being used
senses.chn: （表示已连接、处于工作状态或使用中）

ex.en: The lights were all on.
ex.cn: 灯都亮着。

ex.en: The TV is always on in their house.
ex.cn: 他们家的电视总是开着。

ex.en: We were without electricity for three hours but it's on again now.
ex.cn: 我们停电三个小时了，不过现在又来电了。

senses.def: happening

ex.en: There was a war on at the time.
ex.cn: 当时正值战争。

ex.en: What's on at the movies?
ex.cn: 电影院在上演什么片子？

ex.en: The band are on (= performing) in ten minutes.
ex.cn: 乐队再过十分钟开始演奏。

senses.def: planned to take place in the future

ex.en: The game is still on (= it has not been cancelled).
ex.cn: 比赛仍将举行。

ex.en: I don't think we've got anything on this weekend.
ex.cn: 我想这个周末我们没安排活动。

ex.en: I'm sorry we can't come—we've got a lot on.
ex.cn: 很抱歉我们去不了，我们安排得太满了。

senses.def: on duty; working

ex.en: I'm on now till 8 tomorrow morning.
ex.cn: 我正在值班，要值到明早 8 点钟。

senses.def: in or into a vehicle

ex.en: The bus stopped and four people got on.
ex.cn: 公共汽车停下来，四个人上了车。

ex.en: They hurried on to the plane.
ex.cn: 他们匆忙登上了飞机。

senses.def: to talk about sth; to mean sth

ex.en: I didn't know what he was on about. It didn't make sense.
ex.cn: 我不知道他说的是什么，他说得不清不楚的。

senses.def: to talk in a boring or complaining way about sth

ex.en: Stop keeping on about it!
ex.cn: 别再唠叨那件事了！

senses.def: to keep asking or telling sb sth so that they become annoyed or tired
senses.chn: （对某人）絮叨；说（或问）得令人生厌

ex.en: He was on at me again to lend him money.
ex.cn: 他又来缠着我借钱给他。

senses.def: to want to do sth

ex.en: Is anyone on for a drink after work?
ex.cn: 有人想下班后喝一杯吗？

senses.def: used to say that sth is not acceptable
without stopping; continuously

ex.en: She went on and on about her trip.
ex.cn: 她没完没了地谈她的旅行。

senses.def: used when you are very surprised at sb's behaviour and are suggesting that they are acting in a similar way to sb using drugs
senses.chn: 你鬼迷心窍了吧；你吃错药了吧

senses.def: used when you are accepting a bet
from time to time; now and again
senses.chn: 不时地；有时；断断续续地

ex.en: It rained on and off all day.
ex.cn: 雨断断续续地下了一整天。

senses.def: if you buy sth or pay on account, you pay nothing or only a small amount immediately and the rest later
senses.chn: 挂账；（先付小部分款额的）赊账

senses.def: when the scores of a number of games are added together

ex.en: They won 4–2 on aggregate.
ex.cn: 他们以总分 4:2 获胜。

senses.def: having no chance of success, or not getting much advantage even if you do succeed
senses.chn: 毫无成功机会；（即使成功了）也得不到多大好处

senses.def: being broadcast

ex.en: She explains how she deals with on-air technical problems.
ex.cn: 她解释了她是如何处理播放中的技术问题的。

ex.en: We will be back on air tomorrow morning at 7.
ex.cn: 明天早上 7 点本节目再见。

ex.en: The programme was taken off the air over the summer.
ex.cn: 这个节目在夏季停播。

senses.def: finely balanced between success and failure

ex.en: The economy is balanced on a knife-edge.
ex.cn: 经济形势尚不明朗。

senses.def: very worried or anxious about the result of sth
senses.chn: 十分焦虑；急于知道结果

senses.def: bent over with hands and knees on the ground

ex.en: We were crawling around on all fours.
ex.cn: 我们匍匐着四处爬行。

senses.def: without stopping; continuously

ex.en: She went on and on about her trip.
ex.cn: 她没完没了地谈她的旅行。

senses.def: with people being told only the things they need to know when they need to know them, and no more than that
senses.chn: 仅限于人们需要知道的范围

ex.en: Information will be released strictly on a need-to-know basis.
ex.cn: 资讯发布将严格限制在人们需要知道的范围之内。

senses.def: living, working or happening in a calm way, with no sudden changes, especially after a difficult time
senses.chn: （生活、工作等经历困难后）平稳下来，顺顺当当

senses.def: using very little money

ex.en: In the early years, the business was run on a shoestring.
ex.cn: 早年，这家店铺是小本经营的。

senses.def: if you are given sth on a silver platter, you do not have to do much to get it

ex.en: These rich kids expect to have it all handed to them on a silver platter.
ex.cn: 这些富家子弟指望一切都有人拱手送上。

on a wing and a prayer.lemma: on a wing and a prayer

senses.def: with only a very slight chance of success
after considering all the information

ex.en: On balance, the company has had a successful year.
ex.cn: 总的来说，公司这一年业绩很好。

senses.def: as the representative of sb or instead of them

ex.en: On behalf of the department I would like to thank you all.
ex.cn: 我谨代表全系感谢大家。

ex.en: Mr Knight cannot be here, so his wife will accept the prize on his behalf.
ex.cn: 奈特先生不能来，因此由他的夫人代他领奖。

senses.def: in order to help sb

ex.en: They campaigned on behalf of asylum seekers.
ex.cn: 他们为政治难民发起运动。

senses.def: because of sb; for sb

ex.en: Don't worry on my behalf.
ex.cn: 别为我担心。

senses.def: on or in a ship, an aircraft or a train
senses.chn: 在船上（或飞机上、火车上）

ex.en: Have the passengers gone on board yet?
ex.cn: 乘客们登机了吗？

senses.def: giving your support to an idea or a project

ex.en: We must get more sponsors on board.
ex.cn: 我们必须得到更多赞助商的支持。

ex.en: You need to bring the whole staff on board.
ex.cn: 你需要取得全体员工的支持。

senses.def: on a ship, aircraft or vehicle

ex.en: an on-board motor
ex.cn: 舷内发动机

senses.def: relating to, or controlled by, part of the main circuit board

ex.en: a PC with onboard sound
ex.cn: 有板载声卡的个人电脑

senses.def: available for work if necessary, especially in an emergency
senses.chn: （尤指紧急情况下）随叫随到的

ex.en: on-call doctors
ex.cn: 随时应诊的医生

senses.def: being filmed or shown on television
senses.chn: 在摄制中；在电视上播放

ex.en: Are you prepared to tell your story on camera?
ex.cn: 你愿意在电视上讲述你的经历吗？

senses.def: on one occasion only; one time

ex.en: I've only been there once.
ex.cn: 我只去过那里一次。

ex.en: He cleans his car once a week.
ex.cn: 他每周洗一次汽车。

ex.en: She only sees her parents once every six months.
ex.cn: 她每半年只探望一次父母。

ex.en: He only did it the once.
ex.cn: 这种事儿他仅仅干过一次。

senses.def: at some time in the past

ex.en: I once met your mother.
ex.cn: 我曾经见过你母亲。

ex.en: He once lived in Zambia.
ex.cn: 他曾在赞比亚生活过。

ex.en: This book was famous once, but nobody reads it today.
ex.cn: 这本书曾名噪一时，但现在却无人问津。

senses.def: used in negative sentences and questions, and after if to mean 'ever' or 'at all'
senses.chn: （用于否定句、疑问句和 if 后）曾，根本

ex.en: He never once offered to help.
ex.cn: 他从没有主动提出过帮忙。

ex.en: If she once decides to do something, you won't change her mind.
ex.cn: 她一旦决定干什么，谁也改变不了她的主意。

senses.def: suddenly

ex.en: All at once she lost her temper.
ex.cn: 她突然大发脾气。

senses.def: all together; at the same time

ex.en: I can't do everything all at once—you'll have to be patient.
ex.cn: 我不能万事一把抓呀。你可急不得。

senses.def: immediately; without delay

ex.en: Come here at once!
ex.cn: 马上到这里来！

senses.def: at the same time

ex.en: Don't all speak at once!
ex.cn: 大家不要同时讲！

ex.en: I can't do two things at once.
ex.cn: 我不能同时做两件事。

senses.def: on this occasion (which is in contrast to what happens usually)
senses.chn: 仅此一次（与通常情况对比而言）

ex.en: Just for once he arrived on time.
ex.cn: 只有这一次他按时到了。

ex.en: Can't you be nice to each other just this once?
ex.cn: 难道你们就不能彼此客气哪怕一次？

senses.def: said by an auctioneer to show that an item has been sold
one more time; another time

ex.en: Once again the train was late.
ex.cn: 火车又一次晚点了。

ex.en: Let me hear it just once more.
ex.cn: 让我再听一遍。

senses.def: used to say that sb cannot change
senses.chn: （表示一个人不能改变）一次为…便永远是…

ex.en: Once an actor, always an actor.
ex.cn: 一朝从艺，永为艺人。

senses.def: now and for the last time; finally or completely
senses.chn: 最终地；最后地；彻底地；一次了结地

ex.en: We need to settle this once and for all.
ex.cn: 我们需要把这事一次解决。

senses.def: after an unpleasant experience you are careful to avoid sth similar
senses.chn: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕井绳

senses.def: very rarely
senses.chn: 极少地；难得地；破天荒地

senses.def: occasionally
a few times

ex.en: I don't know her well, I've only met her once or twice.
ex.cn: 我跟她不很熟，我只见过她一两次。

senses.def: used to say that sb has done sth wrong or stupid again, and this time they will suffer because of it

ex.en: You've tried that trick once too often.
ex.cn: 你故伎重施，可这次再逃不脱了。

senses.def: used, especially at the beginning of stories, to mean 'a long time in the past'
senses.chn: （用于故事的开头）从前，很久以前

ex.en: Once upon a time there was a beautiful princess.
ex.cn: 从前，有一位美丽的公主。

senses.def: as soon as; when

ex.en: We didn't know how we would cope once the money had gone.
ex.cn: 一旦钱花光了，我们就不知道该怎么办了。

ex.en: The water is fine once you're in!
ex.cn: 你一旦下了水，就会觉得水里挺舒适。

senses.def: one more time; another time

ex.en: Once again the train was late.
ex.cn: 火车又一次晚点了。

ex.en: Let me hear it just once more.
ex.cn: 让我再听一遍。

senses.def: now and for the last time; finally or completely
senses.chn: 最终地；最后地；彻底地；一次了结地

ex.en: We need to settle this once and for all.
ex.cn: 我们需要把这事一次解决。

senses.def: very rarely
senses.chn: 极少地；难得地；破天荒地

senses.def: used to describe sth special that is not likely to happen to you again

ex.en: An opportunity like this comes once in a lifetime.
ex.cn: 像这样的机会一生也许只会遇到一次。

ex.en: a once-in-a-lifetime experience
ex.cn: 一生只会拥有一次的经历

senses.def: one more time; another time

ex.en: Once again the train was late.
ex.cn: 火车又一次晚点了。

ex.en: Let me hear it just once more.
ex.cn: 让我再听一遍。

senses.def: a few times

ex.en: I don't know her well, I've only met her once or twice.
ex.cn: 我跟她不很熟，我只见过她一两次。

senses.def: to look at sb/sth quickly to see what they or it are like
to clean sth quickly

ex.en: She gave the room a quick once-over before the guests arrived.
ex.cn: 趁客人还没来，她匆匆把屋子打扫了一下。

senses.def: used to say that sb has done sth wrong or stupid again, and this time they will suffer because of it

ex.en: You've tried that trick once too often.
ex.cn: 你故伎重施，可这次再逃不脱了。

senses.def: used, especially at the beginning of stories, to mean 'a long time in the past'
senses.chn: （用于故事的开头）从前，很久以前

ex.en: Once upon a time there was a beautiful princess.
ex.cn: 从前，有一位美丽的公主。

senses.def: extremely happy
the scientific study of and treatment of tumours in the body
coming towards you
senses.chn: 迎面而来的；即将来临的

ex.en: Always walk facing the oncoming traffic.
ex.cn: 走路一定要面向驶来的车辆。

senses.def: done or happening whenever sb asks

ex.en: Feed the baby on demand.
ex.cn: 宝宝需要时再喂食。

ex.en: on-demand printing of books
ex.cn: 书籍按需印刷

senses.def: done or happening whenever sb asks
senses.chn: 按需的；随选即行提供的

ex.en: The new network promises lightning-fast access to on-demand video.
ex.cn: 新的网络会以闪电般的速度接入视频点播。

senses.def: put in a place where people can look at it

ex.en: Designs for the new sports hall are on display in the library.
ex.cn: 新体育馆的设计图展示在图书馆里。

ex.en: to put sth on temporary/permanent display
ex.cn: 临时／长期展出某物

senses.def: taken from a large container (= a barrel )

ex.en: This beer is not available on draught (= it is available only in bottles or cans).
ex.cn: 这种啤酒不卖散装。

senses.def: the number 1

ex.en: Do you want one or two?
ex.cn: 你要一个还是两个？

ex.en: There's only room for one person.
ex.cn: 只有一个人的空间。

ex.en: One more, please!
ex.cn: 请再来一个！

ex.en: a one-bedroomed apartment
ex.cn: 一间卧室的公寓房

ex.en: I'll see you at one (= one o'clock).
ex.cn: 我一点钟见你。

senses.def: used in formal language or for emphasis before hundred, thousand, etc., or before a unit of measurement
senses.chn: （正式用语或表示强调，用在 hundred、thousand 等或度量单位之前）一

ex.en: It cost one hundred and fifty pounds.
ex.cn: 那东西花了一百五十英镑。

ex.en: He lost by less than one second.
ex.cn: 他以不到一秒钟的差距输了比赛。

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean 'a single' or 'just one'
senses.chn: （表示强调）单独一个，仅仅一个

ex.en: There's only one thing we can do.
ex.cn: 我们能做的只有一件事。

senses.def: a person or thing, especially when they are part of a group
senses.chn: （尤指一组中的）一个人，一件事物

ex.en: One of my friends lives in Brighton.
ex.cn: 我有一个朋友住在布赖顿。

ex.en: One place I'd really like to visit is Bali.
ex.cn: 我真正想去的一个地方就是巴厘岛。

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean 'the only one' or 'the most important one'
senses.chn: （表示强调）唯一的一个，最重要的一个

ex.en: He's the one person I can trust.
ex.cn: 他是我唯一可以信赖的人。

ex.en: Her one concern was for the health of her baby.
ex.cn: 她唯一操心的就是孩子的健康。

ex.en: It's the one thing I can't stand about him.
ex.cn: 这是我最不能容忍他的一件事。

senses.def: used when you are talking about a time in the past or the future, without actually saying which one
senses.chn: （用于一般地谈论过去或将来的某个时间）

ex.en: I saw her one afternoon last week.
ex.cn: 我在上周的一个下午见到了她。

ex.en: One day (= at some time in the future) you'll understand.
ex.cn: 总有一天你会明白的。

senses.def: the same

ex.en: They all went off in one direction.
ex.cn: 他们都朝同一个方向走了。

senses.def: used for emphasis instead of a or an
senses.chn: （代替 a 或 an，表示强调）

ex.en: That was one hell of a game!
ex.cn: 那一场比赛简直不得了！

ex.en: She's one snappy dresser.
ex.cn: 她的穿着很入时。

senses.def: used with a person's name to show that the speaker does not know the person
senses.chn: （与人名连用，表示说话人不认识的人）某一个

ex.en: He worked as an assistant to one Mr Ming.
ex.cn: 他给一位明先生当助手。

senses.def: in agreement; all together

ex.en: We spoke as one on this matter.
ex.cn: 在这个问题上我们口径一致。

senses.def: to feel that you completely agree with sb/sth, or that you are part of sth

ex.en: a place where you can feel at one with nature
ex.cn: 一个能让你感到与大自然融为一体的地方

senses.def: used to emphasize that a particular person does sth and that you believe other people do too
senses.chn: 就是其中之一（表达意见时用以加强语气）

ex.en: I, for one, would prefer to postpone the meeting.
ex.cn: 主张推迟会期的，我就是一个。

senses.def: to understand or guess sth immediately
to get an advantage over sb/sth

ex.en: I'm not going to let them get one over on me!
ex.cn: 我决不让他们胜过我！

senses.def: to do sth better than sb else or than you have done before
senses.chn: 胜人一筹；（比自己过去）做得更好

ex.en: She did well this year and next year she hopes to go one better.
ex.cn: 今年她干得不错，她希望明年更上一层楼。

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth has different roles, contains different things or is used for different purposes
senses.chn: 集于一身（或一体）；多功能；多用途

ex.en: She's a mother and company director in one.
ex.cn: 她既是母亲又是公司董事。

ex.en: It's a public relations office, a press office and a private office all in one.
ex.cn: 那儿既是公关办公室，也是新闻办公室，又是私人办公室：三合一。

senses.def: first one person or thing, and then another, and then another, up to any number or amount
senses.chn: 一个接一个地；陆续地；络绎不绝地

ex.en: The bills kept coming in, one after another.
ex.cn: 账单纷至沓来。

senses.def: everyone

ex.en: Happy New Year to one and all!
ex.cn: 祝各位新年快乐！

senses.def: used to emphasize that sb is famous
senses.chn: 绝无仅有的；唯一的；有名的

ex.en: Here he is, the one and only Van Morrison!
ex.cn: 他来了，这盖世无双的范 · 莫里森！

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean 'the same'

ex.en: I never realized Ruth Rendell and Barbara Vine were one and the same (= the same person using two different names).
ex.cn: 我从未意识到鲁思 · 兰德尔和芭芭拉 · 瓦因原来是同一个人。

senses.def: separately and in order

ex.en: I went through the items on the list one by one.
ex.cn: 我逐条看了清单上的条目。

senses.def: a few

ex.en: We've had one or two problems—nothing serious.
ex.cn: 我们有一些问题，不过没什么大不了的。

senses.def: having an advantage over sb
used to say that all types of the things mentioned are very similar
senses.chn: 所有的…都大同小异；知其一便知其全部

ex.en: I don't like science fiction novels much. When you've read one, you've read them all.
ex.cn: 我不太喜欢科幻小说。读过一本，就知道其他的内容了。

senses.def: having two or more uses, functions, etc.

ex.en: It's a corkscrew and bottle-opener all in one.
ex.cn: 这是一物多用，既是瓶塞钻，又是开瓶器。

senses.def: to be the only person to have a particular opinion or to vote a particular way
senses.chn: 是唯一持不同意见者；是唯一投此票者

senses.def: a return to the situation you were in at the beginning of a project, task, etc., because you have made no real progress
senses.chn: （因无进展）回到起点，从头再来

ex.en: If this suggestion isn't accepted, we'll be back to square one.
ex.cn: 如果这个建议得不到采纳，我们就得从头再来了。

senses.def: used to avoid repeating a noun, when you are referring to sb/sth that has already been mentioned, or that the person you are speaking to knows about
senses.chn: （用来避免重复已提过的或是听者已知的事物的名称）

ex.en: I'd like an ice cream. Are you having one, too?
ex.cn: 我想买份冰淇淋，你也要一份吗？

ex.en: Our car's always breaking down. But we're getting a new one soon.
ex.cn: 我们的汽车老出毛病，但我们快要买新的了。

ex.en: She was wearing her new dress, the red one.
ex.cn: 她穿着她的新衣服，那件红的。

ex.en: My favourite band? Oh, that's a hard one (= a hard question).
ex.cn: 我最喜爱的乐队？哦，这可就难说了。

ex.en: What made you choose the one rather than the other?
ex.cn: 你怎么选了这个而不是那个？

ex.en: How about those ones over there?
ex.cn: 你看那边那些怎么样？

senses.def: used when you are identifying the person or thing you are talking about

ex.en: Our house is the one next to the school.
ex.cn: 我家的房子就是学校旁边的那座。

ex.en: The students who are most successful are usually the ones who come to all the classes.
ex.cn: 成绩最好的学生往往是出全勤的那些。

senses.def: a person or thing belonging to a particular group

ex.en: It's a present for one of my children.
ex.cn: 这是送给我的一个孩子的礼物。

ex.en: We think of you as one of the family.
ex.cn: 我们把你看作家中的一员。

senses.def: a person of the type mentioned

ex.en: 10 o'clock is too late for the little ones.
ex.cn: 十点钟对那些小家伙来说就太晚了。

ex.en: He ached to be home with his loved ones.
ex.cn: 他渴望着回家与亲人团聚。

ex.en: She was never one to criticize.
ex.cn: 她是个从不爱批评人的人。

senses.def: used to mean 'people in general' or 'I', when the speaker is referring to himself or herself

ex.en: One should never criticize if one is not sure of one's facts.
ex.cn: 一个人如果对自己掌握的事实没有把握，就绝不该随便批评。

ex.en: One gets the impression that they disapprove.
ex.cn: 据本人观察，他们不赞成。

senses.def: a person whose behaviour is amusing or surprising
senses.chn: （举止）有趣的人，令人惊奇的人

ex.en: Oh, you are a one!
ex.cn: 哈！你这个活宝！

senses.def: the joke

ex.en: Have you heard the one about the Englishman, the Irishman and the Scotsman?
ex.cn: 你听没听过那个关于英格兰人、爱尔兰人和苏格兰人的笑话？

senses.def: to be a person who enjoys sth, or who does sth often or well
senses.chn: 乐于（或长于）做某事的人

ex.en: I've never been a great one for fish and chips.
ex.cn: 我一向对炸鱼薯条不热衷。

senses.def: everyone

ex.en: Happy New Year to one and all!
ex.cn: 祝各位新年快乐！

senses.def: used to emphasize that sb is famous
senses.chn: 绝无仅有的；唯一的；有名的

ex.en: Here he is, the one and only Van Morrison!
ex.cn: 他来了，这盖世无双的范 · 莫里森！

senses.def: used for emphasis to mean 'the same'

ex.en: I never realized Ruth Rendell and Barbara Vine were one and the same (= the same person using two different names).
ex.cn: 我从未意识到鲁思 · 兰德尔和芭芭拉 · 瓦因原来是同一个人。

senses.def: one another is used when you are saying that each member of a group does sth to or for the other people in the group

ex.en: We all try and help one another.
ex.cn: 我们都尽力互相帮助。

ex.en: I think we've learned a lot about one another in this session.
ex.cn: 我认为这一学年我们相互有了很多了解。

senses.def: used after negative nouns or pronouns to emphasize what you are saying
senses.chn: （用于否定名词或代词之后表示强调）在世界上，在人世间

ex.en: Nothing on earth would persuade me to go with him.
ex.cn: 无论什么都不能说服我跟他一块儿走。

senses.def: enjoying a comfortable way of life with plenty of money
senses.chn: 环境舒适；生活优裕；安定富足

senses.def: separately and in order

ex.en: I went through the items on the list one by one.
ex.cn: 我逐条看了清单上的条目。

senses.def: at some time in the future, or on a particular day in the past

ex.en: One day, I want to leave the city and move to the country.
ex.cn: 有朝一日，我要离开城市搬到乡下去。

ex.en: One day, he walked out of the house with a small bag and never came back.
ex.cn: 一天，他带了个小提包走出家门，再也没有回来。

senses.def: a last alcoholic drink before you leave a party, etc.
senses.chn: 告辞前喝的最后一杯酒

senses.def: you should help sb who has helped you
senses.chn: 善须善报；要以德报德；好人应得好报

senses.def: a small town with not many interesting things to do or places to go to
a short joke or funny remark
senses.chn: 小笑话；俏皮话；风趣的话

ex.en: He came out with some good one-liners.
ex.cn: 他讲了几个很有趣的小笑话。

senses.def: done or controlled by one person only; suitable for one person
senses.chn: 适于一个人的；由一个人操作的

ex.en: a one-man show/business
ex.cn: 独角戏；一个人经营的生意

ex.en: a one-man tent
ex.cn: 单人帐篷

senses.def: a street musician who plays several instruments at the same time
senses.chn: 一人乐队（一个人同时演奏几种乐器的街头艺人）

ex.en: He runs the business as a one-man band (= one person does everything).
ex.cn: 他是单枪匹马办企业。

one man's meat is another man's poison.lemma: one man's meat is another man's poison

senses.def: used to say that different people like different things; what one person likes very much, another person does not like at all
senses.chn: 兴趣爱好因人而异；一人手中宝，他人脚下草

senses.def: in a vertical position

ex.en: It'll fit if you stand it on end.
ex.cn: 如果把它竖着就放得进去了。

senses.def: for the stated length of time, without stopping

ex.en: He would disappear for weeks on end.
ex.cn: 他常常是连续几周不见人影。

senses.def: the state of being completely united with sb/sth, or of being in complete agreement with sb

ex.en: a sense of oneness with the natural world
ex.cn: 与自然界的和谐感

senses.def: a sexual relationship that lasts for a single night; a person that sb has this relationship with
senses.chn: 一夜情；露水情缘；曾与之有一夜情的人

ex.en: I wanted it to be more than a one-night stand.
ex.cn: 我要的不止是一夜情缘。

ex.en: For her I was just a one-night stand.
ex.cn: 我不过是她玩一夜情的对象而已。

senses.def: the only one like this

ex.en: My father was one of a kind—I'll never be like him.
ex.cn: 我的父亲很独特，我决不会像他的。

senses.def: made or happening only once and not regularly

ex.en: a one-off payment
ex.cn: 一次性付款

senses.def: a thing that is made or that happens only once and not regularly
senses.chn: 绝无仅有的事物；仅出现一次的事物

ex.en: It was just a one-off; it won't happen again.
ex.cn: 这事绝无仅有，不会再发生了。

senses.def: an old-fashioned person who likes to do things as they were done in the past
before a long time has passed

ex.en: One of these days you'll come back and ask me to forgive you.
ex.cn: 你很快就会回来请求我原谅的。

senses.def: a day when there are a lot of mistakes and a lot of things go wrong
senses.chn: 诸事不顺的日子；倒霉的日子

ex.en: It's been one of those days!
ex.cn: 这一天真倒霉！

senses.def: a few

ex.en: We've had one or two problems—nothing serious.
ex.cn: 我们有一些问题，不过没什么大不了的。

senses.def: a family in which the children live with one parent rather than two
consisting of one piece, not separate parts
senses.chn: 上下一件式的；连体式的

ex.en: a one-piece swimsuit
ex.cn: 连体式游泳衣

senses.def: needing great effort; causing trouble or worry
senses.chn: 费力的；艰巨的；令人焦虑的

ex.en: an onerous duty/task/responsibility
ex.cn: 繁重的义务／工作／职责

senses.def: the possessive form of one
senses.chn: （one 的所有格）个人的，自己的

ex.en: One tries one's best.
ex.cn: 一个人尽其所能。

senses.def: used as the object of a verb or preposition when 'one' is the subject of the verb or is understood as the subject
senses.chn: （one 作动词的主语时，oneself 作动词或介词的宾语）自己，自身

ex.en: One has to ask oneself what the purpose of the exercise is.
ex.cn: 大家必须问一问自己，这个锻炼的目的是什么。

ex.en: One cannot choose freedom for oneself without choosing it for others.
ex.cn: 人不能光为了自己的自由而不顾别人的自由。

ex.en: It is difficult to make oneself concentrate for long periods.
ex.cn: 让自己长时间聚精会神是很困难的。

senses.def: used to emphasize one

ex.en: One likes to do it oneself.
ex.cn: 人都喜欢亲自去做。

senses.def: to be in a normal state of body and mind, not influenced by other people

ex.en: One needs space to be oneself.
ex.cn: 人要有空间才能怡然自得。

senses.def: alone; without anyone else
without help
not shared with anyone
made or happening only once and not regularly
showing only one side of the situation; not balanced

ex.en: The press were accused of presenting a very one-sided picture of the issue.
ex.cn: 新闻界被指责对这件事的报道非常片面。

senses.def: involving people who have different abilities; involving one person more than another

ex.en: a totally one-sided match
ex.cn: 实力非常悬殊的比赛

ex.en: a one-sided conversation (= in which one person talks most of the time)
ex.cn: 一边倒的交谈

senses.def: a piece of clothing that covers the top half of the body and the legs
designed to be suitable for a wide range of situations or needs

ex.en: a one-size-fits-all monetary policy
ex.cn: 通用的货币政策

senses.def: having one star in a system that measures quality. The highest standard is usually represented by four or five stars

ex.en: a one-star hotel
ex.cn: 一星级宾馆

senses.def: having the fifth-highest military rank, and wearing uniform which has one star on it

ex.en: a one-star general
ex.cn: 一星少将

senses.def: in which you can buy or do everything you want in one place
senses.chn: 综合性的；全方位服务的；一站式的；一切全包的

ex.en: Our agency is a one-stop shop for all your travel needs.
ex.cn: 我社为您的旅游提供全方位服务。

one swallow doesn't make a summer.lemma: one swallow doesn't make a summer

senses.def: you must not take too seriously a small sign that sth is happening or will happen in the future, because the situation could change
senses.chn: 别略有好事就以为佳时已到；好事可能纯属偶然；一燕不成夏（不能单凭微小的迹象而下定论）

senses.def: used to suggest that the way one event or action leads to others is so obvious that it does not need to be stated
senses.chn: （暗示事情的发展过程显而易见）一来二去，自然而然

ex.en: He offered me a ride home one night, and, well, one thing led to another and now we're married!
ex.cn: 一天晚上他让我搭车回家，唔，就这样自然发展，我们现在结婚了！

senses.def: former

ex.en: her one-time best friend, Anna
ex.cn: 她以前的挚友安娜

senses.def: not to be repeated

ex.en: a one-time fee of $500
ex.cn: 500 美元的一次性总费用

senses.def: between two people only
senses.chn: 一对一的；仅限两人之间的

ex.en: a one-to-one meeting
ex.cn: 一对一的会见

senses.def: matching sth else in an exact way
senses.chn: 一一对应的；完全对应的

ex.en: There is no one-to-one correspondence between sounds and letters.
ex.cn: 发音与字母之间没有一对一的关系。

senses.def: relating to play in which players control and pass the ball with the first touch of their foot
senses.chn: 触球即传出的；一脚传球的

ex.en: They're playing some nice one-touch football.
ex.cn: 他们正在踢足球，展现精彩的一脚传球的技术。

senses.def: if sb has a one-track mind, they can only think about one subject (often used to refer to sb thinking about sex)
senses.chn: 单向褊狭的思路；一根筋；满脑子只想着一件事（常指性爱）

senses.def: a performer who is only famous for one song, etc.; a person or business that is only good at doing one thing
senses.chn: “一招鲜”（指只有一首成名曲的歌手、单一特长的人或单一经营的企业）

ex.en: This comedian is no one-trick pony.
ex.cn: 这位喜剧演员并不止有一招绝活。

senses.def: the skill of getting an advantage over other people
if sth is on everyone's lips, they are all talking about it
moving or allowing movement in only one direction

ex.en: one-way traffic
ex.cn: 单向交通

ex.en: a one-way street
ex.cn: 单行道

ex.en: a one-way valve
ex.cn: 单向阀门

senses.def: a one-way ticket, etc. can be used for travelling to a place but not back again
operating in only one direction

ex.en: Theirs was a one-way relationship (= one person made all the effort).
ex.cn: 他们的关系是一头热。

ex.en: They observed the prisoners through a one-way mirror (= a mirror that allows a person standing behind it to see through it).
ex.cn: 他们透过单向镜子监视犯人。

senses.def: used to say that it does not matter which one of two possibilities happens, is chosen or is true

ex.en: Was it his fault or not? Either way, an explanation is due.
ex.cn: 是他的错或不是？无论是不是，都得有个解释。

ex.en: We could meet today or tomorrow—I don't mind one way or the other.
ex.cn: 我们可以在今天或明天见面，哪一天对我都行。

senses.def: done or controlled by one woman only
senses.chn: 一个女人做的；由一个女人控制的

ex.en: a one-woman show
ex.cn: 女独角戏

senses.def: at or on a sports field

ex.en: on-field medical treatment
ex.cn: 场上治疗

senses.def: giving you a painful burning feeling

ex.en: He couldn't breathe. His chest was on fire.
ex.cn: 他无法呼吸。他的胸部火辣辣地疼痛。

senses.def: when you first meet sb

ex.en: Even on first acquaintance it was clear that he was not 'the right type'.
ex.cn: 初次见面就看出他显然不是 “对路子的人”。

senses.def: continuing to exist or develop
senses.chn: 持续存在的；仍在进行的；不断发展的

ex.en: an ongoing debate/discussion/process
ex.cn: 持续的辩论／讨论／过程

ex.en: The police investigation is ongoing.
ex.cn: 警方的调查在持续进行中。

senses.def: available, especially to help

ex.en: The emergency services were on hand with medical advice.
ex.cn: 随时都有急诊服务，并提供医疗咨询。

senses.def: in a high place

ex.en: We gazed down into the valley from on high.
ex.cn: 我们从高处向下眺望山谷。

senses.def: the people in senior positions in an organization

ex.en: An order came down from on high that lunchbreaks were to be half an hour and no longer.
ex.cn: 上头指示说午餐休息时间不得超过半小时。

senses.def: in heaven

ex.en: The disaster was seen as a judgement from on high.
ex.cn: 这场灾难被视作上天的惩罚。

senses.def: delayed until a later time or date

ex.en: She put her career on hold to have a baby.
ex.cn: 她中断了事业以便生孩子。

ex.en: The project is on hold until more money is available.
ex.cn: 这项工程暂停，等到有更多的资金时再进行。

senses.def: if a person on the telephone is put on hold, they have to wait until the person that they want to talk to is free
sitting on a horse; using horses

ex.en: a soldier on horseback
ex.cn: 骑着马的士兵

senses.def: kept cold by being surrounded by ice
not being dealt with now; waiting to be dealt with at a later time

ex.en: We've had to put our plans on ice for the time being.
ex.cn: 我们不得不把计划暂时搁置。

senses.def: performed by skaters on an ice rink

ex.en: Cinderella on ice
ex.cn: 《灰姑娘》冰上演出

senses.def: a round vegetable with many layers inside each other and a brown, red or white skin. Onions have a strong smell and flavour.

ex.en: Chop the onions finely.
ex.cn: 把洋葱切细。

ex.en: French onion soup
ex.cn: 法式洋葱汤

senses.def: a dome found especially in Russia on top of towers, etc., which is rounded at the sides and pointed at the top
senses.chn: 洋葱头穹顶（尤见于俄罗斯的塔楼等建筑）

senses.def: controlled by or connected to a computer or to the Internet

ex.en: Online shopping is both cheap and convenient.
ex.cn: 网上购物既便宜又方便。

ex.en: an online database
ex.cn: 在线数据库

ex.en: He spends hours playing online games.
ex.cn: 他花很长时间玩网络游戏。

senses.def: using the Internet to arrange to meet sb and possibly begin a romantic relationship with them
senses.chn: 网上交友（服务），网恋（通过网上结识对象，开始恋情）

ex.en: an online dating service/site
ex.cn: 网上交友服务／网站

senses.def: a person who is connected to a computer or to the Internet

ex.en: What percentage of onliners use e-commerce?
ex.cn: 网民使用电子商务的比例是多少 ?

senses.def: a person who watches sth that is happening but is not involved in it

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene of the crash.
ex.cn: 在撞车现场聚集了一大群围观者。

ex.en: Police have appealed for witnesses to the accident.
ex.cn: 警方呼吁这起事故的目击者出来作证。

ex.en: According to observers, the plane exploded shortly after take-off.
ex.cn: 据目击者说，飞机起飞后不久就爆炸了。

ex.en: A crowd of onlookers gathered at the scene of the crash.
ex.cn: 在撞车地点聚集了一大群围观者。

ex.en: Police asked passers-by if they had witnessed the accident.
ex.cn: 警察询问过路的人是否目击了这次事故。

ex.en: Three innocent bystanders were killed in the crossfire.
ex.cn: 三名无辜的旁观者在交火中丧生。

senses.def: used to say that no other or others of the same group exist or are there

ex.en: She's their only daughter.
ex.cn: 她是他们的独生女。

ex.en: We were the only people there.
ex.cn: 我们是唯一在场的人。

ex.en: His only answer was a grunt.
ex.cn: 他唯一的回答就只是哼了一声。

senses.def: used to say that sb/sth is the best and you would not choose any other

ex.en: She's the only person for the job.
ex.cn: 她是这项工作最合适的人选。

senses.def: used before mentioning a worry or problem you have with sth
senses.chn: 问题是；麻烦的是；只是；不过

ex.en: I'd love to come—the only thing is I might be late.
ex.cn: 我很想去，只不过我可能会迟到。

senses.def: officially recognized but not existing in reality

ex.en: He's party leader in name only.
ex.cn: 他只是名义上的政党领袖。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sb is famous
senses.chn: 绝无仅有的；唯一的；有名的

ex.en: Here he is, the one and only Van Morrison!
ex.cn: 他来了，这盖世无双的范 · 莫里森！

senses.def: nobody or nothing except

ex.en: There are only a limited number of tickets available.
ex.cn: 剩下的票数量很有限。

ex.en: The bar is for members only.
ex.cn: 这间酒吧只对会员开放。

ex.en: You only have to look at her to see she doesn't eat enough.
ex.cn: 你只消看一眼就知道她吃得不够多。

ex.en: Only five people turned up.
ex.cn: 只来了五个人。

senses.def: in no other situation, place, etc.

ex.en: I agreed, but only because I was frightened.
ex.cn: 我当时同意只是因为我很害怕。

ex.en: Children are admitted only if accompanied by an adult.
ex.cn: 儿童必须有成年人陪同方可入场。

ex.en: Only in Paris do you find bars like this.
ex.cn: 只有在巴黎才会看到这样的酒吧。

ex.en: Only if these conditions are fulfilled can the application proceed to the next stage.
ex.cn: 只有这些条件都满足，申请才能进入下一程序。

senses.def: no more important, interesting, serious, etc. than

ex.en: It was only a suggestion.
ex.cn: 这只是个提议罢了。

ex.en: Don't blame me, I'm only the messenger!
ex.cn: 别责怪我，我只不过是个传话的！

ex.en: He was only teasing you.
ex.cn: 他只是逗你玩玩罢了。

senses.def: no more than; no longer than

ex.en: She's only 21 and she runs her own business.
ex.cn: 她只有 21 岁，就经营起自己的企业了。

ex.en: It only took a few seconds.
ex.cn: 那只需要几秒钟。

ex.en: It took only a few seconds.
ex.cn: 那只需要几秒钟。

senses.def: not until

ex.en: We only got here yesterday.
ex.cn: 我们昨天才到这里。

ex.en: Only then did she realize the stress he was under.
ex.cn: 直到那时她才意识到他所承受的压力。

senses.def: used to say that sb can do no more than what is mentioned, although this is probably not enough

ex.en: We can only guess what happened.
ex.cn: 我们只能猜测发生了什么事。

ex.en: He could only watch helplessly as the car plunged into the ravine.
ex.cn: 他只能眼睁睁地看着汽车冲落峡谷。

ex.en: I only hope that she never finds out.
ex.cn: 我唯有希望永远别被她知道。

senses.def: used to say that sth will have a bad effect
senses.chn: （用于说明事情的恶果）只会，愈加

ex.en: If you do that, it will only make matters worse.
ex.cn: 如果你那样做，只会乱上加乱。

ex.en: Trying to reason with him only enrages him even more.
ex.cn: 跟他讲理只会使他更加生气。

senses.def: used to mention sth that happens immediately afterwards, especially sth that causes surprise, disappointment, etc.

ex.en: She turned up the driveway, only to find her way blocked.
ex.cn: 她开上自家车道，不料发现路已被堵。

senses.def: used to emphasize that sth else is also true

ex.en: He not only read the book, but also remembered what he had read.
ex.cn: 他不但读了这本书，而且记得所读的内容。

ex.en: Bilingual children do better in IQ tests than children who speak only one language. In addition / What is more, they seem to find it easier to learn third or even fourth languages.
ex.cn: 讲两种语言的儿童比只讲一种语言的儿童智商测试得分更高。此外／而且，讲两种语言的儿童似乎在学习第三种甚至第四种语言时觉得更容易。

ex.en: Learning another language not only improves children's job prospects in later life, but also boosts their self-esteem.
ex.cn: 学习另一种语言不仅可以提升儿童未来的职业前景，而且可以增强他们的自尊心。

ex.en: Teaching children a second language improves their job prospects in later life. Other benefits include increased self-esteem and greater tolerance of other cultures.
ex.cn: 教儿童第二语言可以提升他们未来的职业前景。此外，还可以使他们获得更强的自尊心、对其他文化更包容。

ex.en: Another / One further / One additional reason for encouraging bilingual education is that it boosts children's self-esteem.
ex.cn: 另一个鼓励双语教育的原因是它能增强儿童的自尊心。

ex.en: Studies suggest that bilingual children find it easier to learn additional languages. There is, moreover, increasing evidence that bilingual children perform better across a range of school subjects, not just foreign languages.
ex.cn: 研究表明，讲两种语言的儿童学习其他语言觉得更容易。此外，越来越多的证据表明，讲两种语言的儿童不仅在外语学习上，同时在其他各门学科的学习上都表现得更好。

senses.def: not long ago/before

ex.en: We've only just arrived.
ex.cn: 我们刚到。

senses.def: almost not

ex.en: He only just caught the train.
ex.cn: 他差点没赶上火车。

ex.en: I can afford it, but only just.
ex.cn: 这东西我刚好买得起。

senses.def: very

ex.en: I was only too pleased to help.
ex.cn: 我非常乐意帮忙。

ex.en: Children can be difficult as we know only too well.
ex.cn: 小孩子往往很难对付，对此我们都非常清楚。

senses.def: young people should enjoy themselves as much as possible, because they will have to work and worry later in their lives
senses.chn: 行乐当及年少时；青春只有一次

senses.def: to be in love with only one particular person
senses.chn: 只钟情于某人；只爱某人

ex.en: He's only ever had eyes for his wife.
ex.cn: 他始终只爱自己的妻子。

senses.def: used to say that you wish sth was true or that sth had happened

ex.en: If only I were rich.
ex.cn: 但愿我很富有。

ex.en: If only I knew her name.
ex.cn: 我要是知道她的名字就好了。

ex.en: If only he'd remembered to send that letter.
ex.cn: 要是他没忘记发那封信就好了。

ex.en: If only I had gone by taxi.
ex.cn: 我要是乘出租车去就好了。

senses.def: except that; but

ex.en: I'd love to come, only I have to work.
ex.cn: 我很想去，但是我要上班。

ex.en: It tastes like chicken, only stronger.
ex.cn: 这东西尝起来像鸡肉，只是味道浓一点。

senses.def: a child who has no brothers or sisters

ex.en: I'm an only child.
ex.cn: 我是独生子。

senses.def: used to say that you think sth is sb's own fault
senses.chn: 只能怪你自己；是你自己的错

ex.en: If you lose your job, you'll only have yourself to blame.
ex.cn: 如果你丢了工作，你只能怪你自己。

senses.def: used to state the only situation in which sth can happen

ex.en: Only if a teacher has given permission is a student allowed to leave the room.
ex.cn: 学生只有得到老师的许可才能离开教室。

ex.en: Only if the red light comes on is there any danger to employees.
ex.cn: 只有红灯闪亮时才有危及职工的险情。

senses.def: not long ago/before

ex.en: We've only just arrived.
ex.cn: 我们刚到。

senses.def: almost not

ex.en: He only just caught the train.
ex.cn: 他差点没赶上火车。

ex.en: I can afford it, but only just.
ex.cn: 这东西我刚好买得起。

senses.def: used to say that you will have to wait for some time to find out the result of a situation

ex.en: Only time will tell if the treatment has been successful.
ex.cn: 只有时间才能证明这种疗法是否成功。

senses.def: not being operated automatically
senses.chn: 处于非自动状态；处于手动状态

ex.en: Leave the controls on manual.
ex.cn: 让操纵杆处于手动状态。

senses.def: not for any reason

ex.en: On no account should the house be left unlocked.
ex.cn: 离开住宅时千万要锁门。

senses.def: not in any situation; never

ex.en: You must on no condition tell them what happened.
ex.cn: 你决不能告诉他们所发生的事。

senses.def: having the positions 'on' and 'off'
senses.chn: 开–关的；双位的；通断的；离合的

ex.en: an on-off switch
ex.cn: 通断开关

senses.def: interrupted by periods when the relationship is not continuing
that can be bought, used, etc.

ex.en: The following is a list of courses currently on offer.
ex.cn: 以下是目前所开设课程的清单。

ex.en: Prizes worth more than £20 000 are on offer.
ex.cn: 优胜者奖品总值逾 20 000 英镑。

senses.def: on sale at a lower price than normal for a short period of time
senses.chn: 短期内打折销售；削价出售

ex.en: Italian wines are on (special) offer this week.
ex.cn: 意大利葡萄酒本周特价销售。

senses.def: the fact of words containing sounds similar to the noises they describe, for example hiss; the use of words like this in a piece of writing
when you put sth on paper, you write it down
judged from written information only, but not proved in practice

ex.en: The idea looks good on paper.
ex.cn: 仅就字面看，这个主意不错。

senses.def: when sth has been paid

ex.en: Entry is only allowed on payment of the full registration fee.
ex.cn: 缴付全数登记费用方可进入。

senses.def: appropriate or relevant to the situation

ex.en: The quotation was directly on point.
ex.cn: 这段话引用得恰到好处。

ex.en: Let's stay on point.
ex.cn: 咱们不要偏离主题。

senses.def: when you show sth

ex.en: Discounts only on production of your student ID card.
ex.cn: 须出示学生证方可打折。

senses.def: not by accident; deliberately

ex.en: He did it on purpose, knowing it would annoy her.
ex.cn: 他明知会激怒她，却故意那么做。

senses.def: a road used for driving onto a major road such as an interstate
senses.chn: （高速公路等的）驶进匝道，驶进坡道

senses.def: a strong movement forward; the sudden development of sth
available to be bought, especially in a shop/store

ex.en: Tickets are on sale from the booking office.
ex.cn: 售票处正在售票。

ex.en: The new model goes on sale next month.
ex.cn: 新款下月上市。

senses.def: being offered at a reduced price

ex.en: All video equipment is on sale today and tomorrow.
ex.cn: 所有录像设备今明两天降价出售。

senses.def: because of what you think sb wants

ex.en: Please don't change your plans on my account.
ex.cn: 请别因为我而改变你的计划。

senses.def: as the representative of sb or instead of them

ex.en: On behalf of the department I would like to thank you all.
ex.cn: 我谨代表全系感谢大家。

ex.en: Mr Knight cannot be here, so his wife will accept the prize on his behalf.
ex.cn: 奈特先生不能来，因此由他的夫人代他领奖。

senses.def: in order to help sb

ex.en: They campaigned on behalf of asylum seekers.
ex.cn: 他们为政治难民发起运动。

senses.def: because of sb; for sb

ex.en: Don't worry on my behalf.
ex.cn: 别为我担心。

senses.def: using the success and influence of another person to help yourself become successful
senses.chn: 利用他人的成就和声望（帮助自己成功）

ex.en: She got where she is today on her brother's coat-tails.
ex.cn: 她倚仗她哥哥的声望爬上了今天的位置。

senses.def: based on a statement that sb makes without giving any proof
senses.chn: 仅凭某人的空口白话；听信某人不实之词

ex.en: He hired and fired people on his partner's say-so.
ex.cn: 他雇谁辞谁全听他的合伙人的一句话。

senses.def: if blame, guilt, etc. is on sb's shoulders, they must take responsibility for it
following behind sb very closely, especially in a car
according to the conditions that you or sb else decides
senses.chn: 按照自己的条件；根据…的主张

ex.en: I'll only take the job on my own terms.
ex.cn: 我只会按照自己的条件接受这份工作。

ex.en: I'm not doing it on your terms.
ex.cn: 我不会按你的条件办的。

senses.def: appearing or written on the screen of a computer, television or cinema/movie theater
senses.chn: 屏幕上的；荧屏的；影视的

ex.en: on-screen courtroom dramas
ex.cn: 荧屏播映的法庭戏

ex.en: on-screen messages
ex.cn: 屏幕上的信息

senses.def: connected with the imaginary story of a film/movie and not with real life
senses.chn: 扮演的；屏幕上的；非现实生活的

ex.en: His on-screen father is also his father in real life.
ex.cn: 他那荧幕上的父亲也是他现实生活中的父亲。

senses.def: used to say that you have changed your opinion
senses.chn: （表示已改变想法）又一想，转念一想

ex.en: I'll wait here. No, on second thoughts, I'll come with you.
ex.cn: 我就在这儿等。不，再一想，我还是跟你一起走。

senses.def: the beginning of sth, especially sth unpleasant
senses.chn: 开端，发生，肇始（尤指不快的事件）

ex.en: the onset of disease/old age/winter
ex.cn: 疾病的发作；老年的开始；冬天的来临

senses.def: on the land rather than at sea

ex.en: an onshore oil field
ex.cn: 陆上油田

senses.def: blowing from the sea towards the land
not in any special order

ex.en: I put the iPod on shuffle and hit play.
ex.cn: 我把 iPod 设置成随机播放，然后按播放键。

senses.def: in a position on the field where you are allowed to play the ball
to get/keep sb's support
senses.chn: 得到（或保持）某人的支持

ex.en: The party needs to keep the major national newspapers onside if it's going to win the next election.
ex.cn: 这个政党要想在下次大选中获胜，就需要得到全国各大报纸的继续支持。

senses.def: a strong or violent attack

ex.en: the enemy onslaught on our military forces
ex.cn: 敌军对我军的进攻

ex.en: The town survives the onslaught of tourists every summer.
ex.cn: 每年夏天，这座小城都要熬过一段旅游者蜂拥而至的苦日子。

ex.en: an onslaught of abuse
ex.cn: 一阵谩骂

senses.def: working or performing well
when you do sth on spec, you are trying to achieve sth without organizing it in advance, but hoping you will be lucky
on sale at a lower price for a short period of time

ex.en: The chocolates were on special at my local store.
ex.cn: 我家附近商店的巧克力在做特价。

senses.def: on the stage in a theatre; in front of an audience

ex.en: onstage fights
ex.cn: 舞台上的打斗

senses.def: ready to do sth immediately if needed or asked
senses.chn: 随时可以投入行动；处于待命状态；招之即来

ex.en: The emergency services were put on standby after a bomb warning.
ex.cn: 接到炸弹警报后，各应急服务机构进入待命状态。

senses.def: ready to travel or go somewhere if a ticket or sth that is needed suddenly becomes available
senses.chn: 候补座位（如临时有票或具备其他必要条件便可立即出发的）

ex.en: He was put on standby for the flight to New York.
ex.cn: 这班飞往纽约的班机，他候补待位。

senses.def: located at the side of a public road rather than in a garage, a drive, etc.
if you do sth on sufferance, sb allows you to do it although they do not really want you to
senses.chn: 经勉强同意；由于（某人的）宽容

ex.en: He's only staying here on sufferance.
ex.cn: 他是经人勉强同意待在这儿的。

senses.def: available to be used at any time

ex.en: We have this sort of information on tap.
ex.cn: 我们可随时向您提供这种资料。

senses.def: beer that is on tap is in a barrel with a tap on it
senses.chn: （啤酒）装在有旋塞的桶里的，散装的

senses.def: something that is on tap is being discussed or prepared and will happen soon
senses.chn: 协商中；准备中；即将发生

senses.def: a province of eastern Canada, between Hudson Bay and the Great Lakes. The capital is Toronto.
senses.chn: 安大略（加拿大东部省份，位于哈得孙湾和五大湖之间，首府多伦多）

senses.def: left for the present time, to be done or considered later
as a result of an achievement or a success

ex.en: The profits growth came on the back of a 26 per cent rise in sales.
ex.cn: 利润增长来自 26% 的销售额增长。

senses.def: no longer working correctly
very active

ex.en: We have several projects all on the boil at once.
ex.cn: 我们热火朝天地同时上马了几个项目。

senses.def: one after the other, without anything else coming between

ex.en: We've won six matches on the bounce.
ex.cn: 我们已经六连胜。

senses.def: at exactly the right time or at the exact time mentioned

ex.en: We arrived at 4 o'clock on the button.
ex.cn: 我们在 4 点钟准时到达。

senses.def: exactly right

ex.en: You're on the button there!
ex.cn: 那让你说中了！

senses.def: likely to happen

ex.en: The merger has been on the cards for some time now.
ex.cn: 合并的事情已经酝酿了一段时间。

senses.def: spending less money than you usually need to spend to do sth

ex.en: a guide to decorating your house on the cheap
ex.cn: 房屋廉价装潢指南

senses.def: used to introduce a statement that says the opposite of the last one

ex.en: 'It must have been terrible.' 'On the contrary, I enjoyed every minute.'
ex.cn: “那一定是很糟糕。” “恰恰相反，我非常喜欢。”

senses.def: used to introduce the good points about sb/sth, especially after the bad points have been mentioned
senses.chn: （尤用于提及缺点之后）就优点方面而言

senses.def: on the woman's side of the family
exactly on time or at the exact time mentioned

ex.en: The taxi showed up on the dot.
ex.cn: 出租车准时到了。

ex.en: Breakfast is served at 8 on the dot.
ex.cn: 8 点整开早饭。

senses.def: secretly; not wanting other people to discover what you are doing
being prepared or considered

ex.en: It's just one of several projects on the drawing board.
ex.cn: 这只是正在筹划的几个项目中的一个。

on the edge of your seat.lemma: on the edge of your seat

senses.def: very excited and giving your full attention to sth
senses.chn: 异常兴奋；极为激动；有浓厚兴趣

ex.en: The game had the crowd on the edge of their seats.
ex.cn: 这场比赛使观众兴奋不已。

senses.def: used to say that sth seems to be good, true, etc. but that this opinion may need to be changed when you know more about it

ex.en: On the face of it, it seems like a great deal.
ex.cn: 表面上看来好像很多。

senses.def: on level ground, without hills or jumps (= for example in horse racing)
if you do sth on the fly, you do it quickly while sth else is happening, and without thinking about it very much
not working

ex.en: The TV is on the fritz again.
ex.cn: 电视机又出故障了。

senses.def: being given a lot of attention because it is considered important
senses.chn: 处于前列重要地位；受到重视；为当务之急

ex.en: Anything that keeps education on the front burner is good.
ex.cn: 任何重视教育的事都是好事。

senses.def: in the place where sth is happening and among the people who are in the situation, especially a war
senses.chn: 当场；在现场；（尤指）处于战火中

ex.en: On the ground, there are hopes that the fighting will soon stop.
ex.cn: 战火中的人都希望战斗尽快结束。

ex.en: There's a lot of support for the policy on the ground.
ex.cn: 很多在场的人支持这一政策。

senses.def: happening at home, or in your own country
meat that is sold, transported, etc. on the hoof is sold, etc. while the cow or sheep is still alive
if you do sth on the hoof, you do it quickly and without giving it your full attention because you are doing sth else at the same time
likely to happen soon
senses.chn: 很可能即将发生；已露端倪

ex.en: There's trouble looming on the horizon.
ex.cn: 可能快要出事了。

on the horns of a dilemma.lemma: on the horns of a dilemma

senses.def: in a situation in which you have to make a choice between things that are equally unpleasant
drinks or meals that are on the house are provided free by the pub/bar or restaurant and you do not have to pay
belonging to a group or an organization and therefore able to get information that is not available to other people
senses.chn: 属于某团伙（或组织）的；知情的

ex.en: The thieves must have had someone on the inside helping them.
ex.cn: 这些窃贼肯定有内应。

senses.def: while doing a particular job
senses.chn: 在上班时；在干活时；在工作岗位上

ex.en: No sleeping on the job!
ex.cn: 上班时严禁睡觉！

ex.en: on-the-job training
ex.cn: 在职培训

senses.def: having sex
senses.chn: 在交媾；在性交；在干那事

senses.def: escaping from sb, especially from the police
senses.chn: 在逃，逃匿（尤指逃避警方追缉）

senses.def: closed but not locked

ex.en: Can you leave the door on the latch so I can get in?
ex.cn: 你别锁门好不好？我好进来。

senses.def: honest; legal

ex.en: I'm not convinced he's on the level.
ex.cn: 我不相信他是真诚的。

ex.en: Are you sure this deal is on the level?
ex.cn: 你确信这笔交易合法吗？

senses.def: having escaped from somewhere; free

ex.en: Three prisoners are still on the loose.
ex.cn: 有三名囚犯仍然在逃。

senses.def: trying to get money or an advantage for yourself
marching somewhere
senses.chn: 在行军中；在行进中；在进展中

ex.en: The enemy are on the march.
ex.cn: 敌人正在行军途中。

senses.def: available for people to buy

ex.en: to put your house on the market
ex.cn: 出售房屋

ex.en: The house came on the market last year.
ex.cn: 这栋房屋去年就上市了。

ex.en: There are hundreds of different brands on the market.
ex.cn: 有数百种不同的品牌供应。

senses.def: getting better after an illness or injury; improving after a difficult situation

ex.en: My leg is definitely on the mend now.
ex.cn: 我的腿正在明显地好转。

ex.en: Does he believe the economy's really on the mend?
ex.cn: 他相信经济确实在复苏吗？

senses.def: correct; accurate

ex.en: His prediction was right on the money.
ex.cn: 他的预测准确无误。

senses.def: without delay

ex.en: They're good customers who always pay on the nail.
ex.cn: 他们是好主顾，付账从不耽搁。

senses.def: on hire purchase (= by making payments over a long period)

ex.en: to buy a new car on the never-never
ex.cn: 以分期付款的方式购买一辆新车

senses.def: if a proposal is accepted on the nod, it is accepted without any discussion
exactly

ex.en: The budget should hit the $136 billion target on the nose.
ex.cn: 预算应该正好达到 1 360 亿美元的目标。

senses.def: available to buy without any restrictions

on the other side of the fence.lemma: on the other side of the fence

senses.def: in a situation that is different from the one that you are in
senses.chn: 与自己所处情况不同的一面；事物的另一面

senses.def: used to describe how sb appears or seems

ex.en: On the outside she seems calm, but I know she's worried.
ex.cn: 她貌似镇定，但我知道她有心事。

senses.def: not in prison

ex.en: Life on the outside took some getting used to again.
ex.cn: 费了很大劲儿才慢慢适应了狱后的生活。

senses.def: trying to find a sexual partner
without telling anyone
paying close attention to a situation, in case sth happens

ex.en: He's always on the qui vive for a business opportunity.
ex.cn: 他总是密切关注商机。

senses.def: feeling extreme pressure, anxiety or pain
senses.chn: 倍感压力；焦虑万分；痛苦不堪

senses.def: while you are sad and confused, especially after a relationship has ended
senses.chn: （尤指关系破裂之后）在伤心困惑之时

senses.def: travelling, especially for long distances or periods of time
senses.chn: 在途中；（尤指）长途旅行中

ex.cn: 那支乐队巡回演出已有六个月了。

ex.cn: 要花大约 500 英镑才能让车子重新上路。

senses.def: moving from place to place, and having no permanent home

ex.cn: 流浪生活会非常艰辛。

ex.cn: 休的婚姻触礁了。

senses.def: served with pieces of ice but no water

ex.cn: 加冰块的苏格兰威士忌酒

senses.def: very close to being defeated
trying to avoid being captured

ex.en: He's on the run from the police.
ex.cn: 他在躲避警方的追捕。

senses.def: continuously active and moving around

ex.cn: 这是一些快餐食谱，赶时间的话可以选。

senses.chn: 目标一致；就目标达成共识

senses.def: no longer wanted or considered useful
trying to get sth by persuading sb to give it to you
not wanted by anyone; not used
considered to be too old to get married
in addition to your main job
senses.chn: 作为副业；兼职；在正事之外

ex.en: a mechanic who buys and sells cars on the side
ex.cn: 兼做汽车买卖的机修工

senses.def: secretly or illegally
senses.chn: 秘密地；偷偷摸摸地；非法地

ex.en: He's married but he has a girlfriend on the side.
ex.cn: 他有妻室，但暗地里还有一个女友。

senses.def: served at the same time as the main part of the meal, but on a separate plate
secretly; not wanting other people to discover what you are doing

ex.en: He has to visit them on the sly.
ex.cn: 他只得偷偷地去看望他们。

senses.def: immediately

ex.en: He answered the question on the spot.
ex.cn: 他当场就回答了那个问题。

ex.en: an on-the-spot parking fine
ex.cn: 当场进行的违章停车罚款

senses.def: at the actual place where sth is happening

ex.en: An ambulance was on the spot within minutes.
ex.cn: 几分钟之内，一辆救护车便赶到现场。

ex.en: an on-the-spot report
ex.cn: 现场报道

senses.def: in one exact place, without moving in any direction

ex.en: Running on the spot is good exercise.
ex.cn: 原地跑步是一种很好的锻炼。

on the spur of the moment.lemma: on the spur of the moment

senses.def: suddenly, without planning in advance
senses.chn: 一时冲动之下；心血来潮

ex.en: I phoned him up on the spur of the moment.
ex.cn: 我一时冲动，给他打了电话。

ex.en: a spur-of-the-moment decision
ex.cn: 心血来潮的决定

senses.def: in the process of being made, built or prepared

ex.en: Our new model is already on the stocks and will be available in the spring.
ex.cn: 我们已着手生产新的款式，明年春天就可以上市。

senses.def: because sb has been influenced or persuaded by sth
senses.chn: 凭借（或根据）某事物；在某事物的影响下

ex.en: I got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
ex.cn: 由于您的推荐，我得到了那份工作。

senses.def: when not thought about deeply or thoroughly; when not looked at carefully
senses.chn: 表面上；从外表看；乍一看

ex.en: It seems like a good idea on the surface but there are sure to be problems.
ex.cn: 这主意乍一看不错，但肯定存在问题。

ex.en: On the surface, he appeared unchanged.
ex.cn: 看外表他好像没变。

senses.def: offered to people so that they can consider or discuss it

ex.en: Management have put several new proposals on the table.
ex.cn: 管理部门已将几项新的建议提交讨论。

senses.def: not going to be discussed or considered until a future date

on the tip of your tongue.lemma: on the tip of your tongue

senses.def: if a word or name is on the tip of your tongue, you are sure that you know it but you cannot remember it
senses.chn: 话在嘴边上（却一时想不起来）

senses.def: one after the other
senses.chn: 接连地；接二连三；一个接着一个

ex.en: They've now won three games on the trot.
ex.cn: 他们现在已经连胜三场比赛。

senses.def: busy all the time

ex.en: I've been on the trot all day.
ex.cn: 我一整天忙得不可开交。

senses.def: going to change soon

ex.en: His luck is on the turn.
ex.cn: 他就要时来运转了。

senses.def: increasing or improving

ex.en: Business confidence is on the up.
ex.cn: 商业信心正在增强。

senses.def: becoming more and more successful
senses.chn: 蒸蒸日上；日益兴旺；越来越好

ex.en: The club has been on the up and up since the beginning of the season.
ex.cn: 从本季开始，这个俱乐部便日益欣欣向荣。

senses.def: becoming smaller, less important or less common

ex.en: Her popularity has been on the wane for some time.
ex.cn: 她的人气一段时间以来江河日下。

senses.def: as you are leaving
going out of fashion
considering everything; in general
senses.chn: 总的说来；大体上；基本上

ex.en: On the whole, I'm in favour of the idea.
ex.cn: 大体说来，我赞成这个想法。

senses.def: flying

on the wrong side of the law.lemma: on the wrong side of the law

senses.def: in trouble with the police
used with verbs to express movement on or to a particular place or position
senses.chn: （与动词连用，表示朝某处或某位置运动）向，朝

ex.en: Move the books onto the second shelf.
ex.cn: 把书移到第二层架子上。

ex.en: She stepped down from the train onto the platform.
ex.cn: 她走下火车来到站台上。

senses.def: used to show that sth faces in a particular direction

ex.en: The window looked out onto the terrace.
ex.cn: 窗户外对着的是露天平台。

senses.def: to know about what sb has done wrong

ex.en: She knew the police would be onto them.
ex.cn: 她知道警方将追查他们。

senses.def: to be talking to sb, usually in order to ask or tell them sth

ex.en: They've been onto me for ages to get a job.
ex.cn: 很久以来，他们一直催促我找份工作。

senses.def: to know about sth or be in a situation that could lead to a good result for you
senses.chn: 了解；掌握；处于有利地位

ex.en: Scientists believe they are onto something big.
ex.cn: 科学家相信，他们将会有重大发现。

ex.en: She's onto a good thing with that new job.
ex.cn: 她在新工作中将大有作为。

senses.def: a branch of philosophy that deals with the nature of existence
a list of concepts and categories in a subject area that shows the relationships between them
senses.chn: 本体（一个主题下不同概念及类别）

ex.en: a guide to creating a marketing ontology
ex.cn: 市场本体构建指南

senses.def: on the highest point or surface

ex.en: a cake with cream on top
ex.cn: 上面浇有奶油的蛋糕

ex.en: Stand on top and look down.
ex.cn: 站在顶上俯视。

ex.en: He's going bald on top (= on the top of his head).
ex.cn: 他谢顶了。

senses.def: in a leading position or in control
senses.chn: 处于领先地位；控制局面

ex.en: She remained on top for the rest of the match.
ex.cn: 在比赛的余下部分她一直领先。

senses.def: in addition

ex.en: Look, here's 30 dollars, and I'll buy you lunch on top.
ex.cn: 你看，这是给你的 30 美元，另外我还会给你买午餐。

senses.def: appropriate or relevant to the situation

ex.en: Keep the text short and on topic.
ex.cn: 文章要简短切题。

ex.en: Let's get back on topic.
ex.cn: 我们回到正题上来吧。

senses.def: very happy or proud
senses.chn: 欢天喜地；心满意足；非常自豪

senses.def: very fashionable

ex.en: That jacket is bang on-trend.
ex.cn: 那种夹克衫非常流行。

ex.en: an on-trend haircut
ex.cn: 流行发型

senses.def: the responsibility for sth

ex.en: The onus is on employers to follow health and safety laws.
ex.cn: 雇主有义务遵行健康安全法。

senses.def: being shown in a public place so that people can look at it
continuing or moving forward

ex.en: Ticket prices include your flight and onward rail journey.
ex.cn: 票价包括您的机票和接续的铁路旅费。

senses.def: continuing from a particular time

ex.en: They lived there from the 1980s onwards.
ex.cn: 他们从 20 世纪 80 年代起一直住在那里。

ex.en: The pool is open from 7 a.m. onwards.
ex.cn: 游泳池从早上 7 点起开放。

senses.def: forward

ex.en: We drove onwards towards the coast.
ex.cn: 我们驱车前往海滨。

senses.def: making you feel guilty for doing or failing to do sth

ex.en: I'll write and apologize. I've had it on my conscience for weeks.
ex.cn: 我要写信赔礼道歉。几个星期以来我都为此而良心不安。

senses.def: completely well or in a normal state again after an illness or a time of trouble
senses.chn: （困境后）恢复，完全复原；（病后）痊愈

ex.en: Sue's back on her feet again after her operation.
ex.cn: 休手术后又恢复健康了。

ex.en: The new chairman hopes to get the company back on its feet within six months.
ex.cn: 新董事长希望在六个月以内使公司恢复元气。

ex.en: She was too weak to stand.
ex.cn: 她虚弱得站都站不住。

ex.en: Stand still when I'm talking to you!
ex.cn: 我跟你说话，站着别动！

ex.en: We stood talking for a few minutes.
ex.cn: 我们站着谈了几分钟。

ex.en: He stood and looked out to sea.
ex.cn: 他站着向大海望去。

senses.def: if you have sb/sth on your hands, you are responsible for them or it

ex.en: Let me take care of the invitations—you've enough on your hands with the caterers.
ex.cn: 让我来负责发邀请吧，你负责洽办酒席就够忙了。

senses.def: used to promise very seriously that you will do sth or that sth is true
senses.chn: 用人格担保；以名誉担保

ex.en: I swear on my honour that I knew nothing about this.
ex.cn: 我以人格担保我根本不知道这件事。

senses.def: to be trusted to do sth

ex.en: You're on your honour not to go into my room.
ex.cn: 依你的人格，相信你不会进我的房间。

senses.def: sitting on your heels with your knees bent up in front of you
prepared to use all your skills, knowledge, etc. because you are being tested
senses.chn: 奋发起来；准备尽最大努力

senses.def: if sb/sth is on your mind, you are thinking and worrying about them/it a lot

ex.en: You've been on my mind all day.
ex.cn: 我一整天都在为你担心。

ex.en: Don't bother your father tonight—he's got a lot on his mind.
ex.cn: 今晚就别打扰你父亲了，他的烦心事儿已经够多了。

senses.def: for yourself

ex.en: In 2012 Smith set up in business on his own account.
ex.cn: 2012 年史密斯开始创业。

senses.def: because you want to and you have decided, not sb else

ex.en: No one sent me. I am here on my own account.
ex.cn: 没有人派我，我自己来的。

senses.def: according to the conditions that you or sb else decides
senses.chn: 按照自己的条件；根据…的主张

ex.en: I'll only take the job on my own terms.
ex.cn: 我只会按照自己的条件接受这份工作。

ex.en: I'm not doing it on your terms.
ex.cn: 我不会按你的条件办的。

senses.def: alone; without anybody else
on your own; alone
having very little money
a type of stone that has layers of different colours in it, usually used for decorative objects
a large amount of sth
used for expressing surprise, especially about sth sexual
senses.chn: （表示惊讶，尤指对性方面）啊，哎呀

senses.def: used for expressing surprise, happiness or pain
senses.chn: （表示惊讶、高兴或疼痛）哎呀，啊哈，哎哟

senses.def: used to refer to the sound produced by a group of brass instruments
senses.chn: （铜管乐器组发出的）嗡姆吧声

ex.en: an oompah band
ex.cn: 铜管乐队

senses.def: energy; a special good quality

ex.en: a styling product to give your hair more oomph
ex.cn: 使头发更靓丽的一种定型剂

senses.def: used when sb has almost had an accident, broken sth, etc.
senses.chn: （差点出事故、摔破物品等时说）哎

ex.en: Oops! I almost spilled the wine.
ex.cn: 哎！我差点把酒洒了。

senses.def: used when you have done sth embarrassing, said sth rude by accident, told a secret, etc.
senses.chn: （做了令人尴尬的事、说了无理的话或泄露了秘密等时说）哎

ex.en: Oops, I shouldn't have said that.
ex.cn: 哎，我不应该那么说。

senses.def: if a thick liquid oozes from a place, or if sth oozes a thick liquid, the liquid flows from the place slowly

ex.en: Blood oozed out of the wound.
ex.cn: 血从伤口慢慢流出来。

ex.en: an ugly swelling oozing with pus
ex.cn: 流着脓水的烂疮

ex.en: The wound was oozing blood.
ex.cn: 伤口流着血。

ex.en: a plate of toast oozing butter
ex.cn: 一盘渗着黄油的烤面包片

senses.def: if sb/sth oozes a particular characteristic, quality, etc., they show it strongly
senses.chn: 洋溢着，充满（特质、气质等）

ex.en: She walked into the party oozing confidence.
ex.cn: 她信心十足地来到聚会上。

ex.en: His voice oozed with sex appeal.
ex.cn: 他的声音充溢着性感。

senses.def: very soft mud, especially at the bottom of a lake or river
the very slow flow of a thick liquid
the fact of being difficult to see through; the fact of being opaque
the fact of being difficult to understand; the fact of being opaque
a white or almost clear semi-precious stone in which changes of colour are seen, used in jewellery

ex.en: an opal ring
ex.cn: 蛋白石戒指

senses.def: changing colour like an opal
senses.chn: 像猫眼石般变色的；色彩变幻的

senses.def: not clear enough to see through or allow light through
senses.chn: 不透明的；不透光的；浑浊的

ex.en: opaque glass
ex.cn: 不透明的玻璃

ex.en: opaque tights
ex.cn: 不透明的连裤袜

senses.def: difficult to understand; not clear

ex.en: The jargon in his talk was opaque to me.
ex.cn: 他谈话中使用的行话对我是一团迷雾。

senses.def: a style of modern art that uses patterns and colours in a way that makes the images seem to move as you look at them
senses.chn: 欧普艺术，光效应艺术（利用色彩图形使画面产生动感的现代艺术）

senses.def: Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (an organization of countries that produce and sell oil)
senses.chn: 石油输出国组织；欧佩克

senses.def: the page in a newspaper opposite the editorial page that contains comment on the news and articles on particular subjects
senses.chn: （报章上与社论版位置相对的）评论版

senses.def: allowing things or people to go through

ex.en: A wasp flew in the open window.
ex.cn: 一只黄蜂飞进了开着的窗子。

ex.en: She had left the door wide open.
ex.cn: 她把房门敞开着。

senses.def: with eyelids or lips apart

ex.en: She had difficulty keeping her eyes open (= because she was very tired).
ex.cn: 她连睁开眼睛的力气都没有了。

ex.en: He was breathing through his open mouth.
ex.cn: 他张着嘴呼吸。

senses.def: spread out; with the edges apart

ex.en: The flowers are all open now.
ex.cn: 花现在都开了。

ex.en: The book lay open on the table.
ex.cn: 书摊开在桌子上。

senses.def: not blocked by anything

ex.en: The pass is kept open all the year.
ex.cn: 关口一年到头都是开放的。

senses.def: not fastened or covered, so that things can easily come out or be put in

ex.en: Leave the envelope open.
ex.cn: 别封上信封。

ex.en: The bag burst open and everything fell out.
ex.cn: 袋子爆开了，里边的东西都散落出来。

senses.def: not fastened

ex.en: Her coat was open.
ex.cn: 她的外衣敞着。

senses.def: not surrounded by anything; not confined

ex.en: open country (= without forests, buildings, etc.)
ex.cn: 空旷的田野

ex.en: a city with a lot of parks and open spaces
ex.cn: 有很多公园和空地的城市

ex.en: driving along the open road (= part of a road in the country, where you can drive fast)
ex.cn: 沿开阔的道路开车

senses.def: with no cover or roof on

ex.en: an open drain
ex.cn: 一条明沟

ex.en: people working in the open air (= not in a building)
ex.cn: 在户外作业的人

ex.en: The hall of the old house was open to the sky.
ex.cn: 旧房子的门厅是露天的。

ex.en: an open wound (= with no skin covering it)
ex.cn: 开放性伤口

ex.en: an open flame
ex.cn: 明火

senses.def: if a shop/store, bank, business, etc. is open, it is ready for business and will admit customers or visitors

ex.en: Is the museum open on Sundays?
ex.cn: 博物馆每星期天都开放吗？

ex.en: The new store will be open in the spring.
ex.cn: 新商店将在春天开业。

ex.en: The house had been thrown open to the public.
ex.cn: 这所宅院已向公众开放。

ex.en: I declare this festival open.
ex.cn: 我宣布庆祝活动开始。

senses.def: if a competition, etc. is open, anyone can enter it
senses.chn: 对大众开放的；公开的；人人可以参加的

ex.en: an open debate/championship/scholarship
ex.cn: 公开的辩论会；人人可以参加的锦标赛；人人均可申请的奖学金

ex.en: She was tried in open court (= the public could go and listen to the trial).
ex.cn: 她被公开审判。

ex.en: The debate was thrown open to the audience.
ex.cn: 辩论会对听众开放。

senses.def: if a competition, building, etc. is open to particular people, those people can enter it
senses.chn: （比赛、建筑物等）对特定群体开放

ex.en: The competition is open to young people under the age of 18.
ex.cn: 这项比赛让 18 岁以下的青少年参加。

ex.en: The house is not open to the public.
ex.cn: 这所住宅不对外开放。

senses.def: to be available and ready to use

ex.en: What options are open to us?
ex.cn: 我们有什么选择？

ex.en: Is the offer still open?
ex.cn: 这个报价还有效吗？

ex.en: I want to keep my Swiss bank account open.
ex.cn: 我想保留我的瑞士银行账户。

senses.def: likely to suffer sth such as criticism, injury, etc.

ex.en: The system is open to abuse.
ex.cn: 这项制度容易被滥用。

ex.en: He has laid himself wide open to political attack.
ex.cn: 他在政治上已经处于极易受到攻击的境地。

senses.def: known to everyone; not kept hidden
senses.chn: 人人皆知的；不保密的；公开的

ex.en: an open quarrel
ex.cn: 公开的争吵

ex.en: open government
ex.cn: 透明的管理

ex.en: their open display of affection
ex.cn: 他们的公开秀恩爱

ex.en: His eyes showed open admiration as he looked at her.
ex.cn: 他看她的时候，眼神里明显流露着敬佩之情。

senses.def: honest; not keeping thoughts and feelings hidden

ex.en: She was always open with her parents.
ex.cn: 她总是与父母无话不谈。

ex.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
ex.cn: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

ex.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
ex.cn: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

ex.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
ex.cn: 坦白说，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

ex.en: You'll have to get used to his direct manner.
ex.cn: 你得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

ex.en: He was quite open about his reasons for leaving.
ex.cn: 他对离开的原因完全未加隐瞒。

senses.def: willing to listen to and think about new ideas
senses.chn: 思想开明的；不固执己见的

ex.en: I'm open to suggestions for what you would like to do in our classes.
ex.cn: 我很乐意听听你们对课堂活动的建议。

senses.def: not yet finally decided or settled

ex.en: The race is still wide open (= anyone could win).
ex.cn: 赛跑胜负未定。

ex.en: The price is not open to negotiation.
ex.cn: 价格不容商议。

ex.en: Some phrases in the contract are open to interpretation.
ex.cn: 合同中的某些条文容有不同诠释。

ex.en: Which route is better remains an open question (= it is not decided).
ex.cn: 哪条路线较好尚待决定。

ex.en: In an interview try to ask open questions (= to which the answer is not just 'yes' or 'no').
ex.cn: 主持面试时要尽量问一些开放式的问题。

senses.def: with wide spaces between the threads

ex.en: an open weave
ex.cn: 稀疏织法

senses.def: produced by opening the mouth wide
if sth is an open secret, many people know about it, although it is supposed to be a secret
to be willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
senses.chn: 愿意聆听（或接受）意见；（对…）不怀成见；思想开明

senses.def: to be quick to notice or hear things
if you describe sb or their life as an open book, you mean that you can easily understand them and know everything about them
an invitation to sb to visit you at any time
if sth is an open invitation to criminals, etc., it encourages them to commit a crime by making it easier
senses.chn: 容易引诱人犯罪的行为

ex.en: Leaving your camera on the seat in the car is an open invitation to thieves.
ex.cn: 把照相机留在汽车座位上无异于开门揖盗。

senses.def: if you welcome sb with open arms, you are extremely happy and pleased to see them
to open suddenly or violently; to make sth open in this way

ex.en: The door burst open.
ex.cn: 门突然开了。

ex.en: Firefighters burst the door open and rescued them.
ex.cn: 消防队员撞开门，把他们救了出来。

senses.def: (to provide) the means of getting or reaching sth; (to create) the opportunity for sth
senses.chn: （为…提供）达到目的的手段；（为…创造）机会

ex.en: The agreement will open the door to increased international trade.
ex.cn: 此协议将会提供增长国际贸易的机会。

ex.en: Our courses are the door to success in English.
ex.cn: 我们的课程是通向掌握英语的成功之路。

senses.def: to look for sb/sth while you are doing other things

ex.en: Police have asked residents to keep an eye out for anything suspicious.
ex.cn: 警方要求居民密切注意一切可疑的情况。

senses.def: fully aware of the possible problems or results of a particular course of action
senses.chn: 明知后果如何；明知有问题；心中有数

ex.en: I went into this with my eyes open so I guess I only have myself to blame.
ex.cn: 我是明明知道做这事的后果的，所以我想只能责怪我自己。

senses.def: available to buy without any restrictions
