ex.cn: 保证学习效果的最佳条件

senses.def: the best possible result, set of conditions, etc.
something that you can choose to have or do; the freedom to choose what you do
senses.chn: 可选择的事物；选择；选择权；选择的自由

ex.en: As I see it, we have two options…
ex.cn: 据我看，我们有两种选择…

ex.en: There are various options open to you.
ex.cn: 你有多种选择。

ex.en: Going to college was not an option for me.
ex.cn: 上大学不是我能选的道路。

ex.en: I had no option but to (= I had to) ask him to leave.
ex.cn: 我别无选择，只有请他离开。

ex.en: Students have the option of studying abroad in their second year.
ex.cn: 学生在二年级时可以选择出国学习。

ex.en: A savings plan that gives you the option to vary your monthly payments.
ex.cn: 一项允许可调每月存款额度的储蓄方案。

senses.def: a subject that a student can choose to study, but that they do not have to do

ex.en: The course offers options in design and computing.
ex.cn: 这一课程开了设计和计算机技术的选修科目。

senses.def: the right to buy or sell sth at some time in the future

ex.en: We have an option on the house.
ex.cn: 我们有权购买这所房子。

ex.en: He has promised me first option on his car (= the opportunity to buy it before anyone else).
ex.cn: 他答应我可以优先买他的汽车。

ex.en: The property is for rent with an option to buy at any time.
ex.cn: 这房子供出租，但可随时买下。

ex.en: share options (= the right to buy shares in a company)
ex.cn: 认股选择权

senses.def: one of the choices you can make when using a computer program

ex.en: Choose the 'Cut' option from the Edit menu.
ex.cn: 从编辑选单上选 “剪切” 项。

senses.def: to avoid making a decision now so that you still have a choice in the future
senses.chn: 保留选择余地；暂不决定

senses.def: a choice which is thought to be easier because it involves less effort, difficulty, etc.

ex.en: They are anxious that the new course should not be seen as a soft option.
ex.cn: 他们盼望新办法不会被视为捷径。

ex.en: He decided to take the easy option and give them what they wanted.
ex.cn: 他决定顺水推舟，他们要什么就给什么。

senses.def: to buy or sell the right to own or use sth, at some time in the future

ex.en: The novel has been optioned for the screen by his production company.
ex.cn: 这部小说改编成影视作品的权利已经被他的制作公司买下了。

senses.def: that you can choose to do or have if you want to

ex.en: Certain courses are compulsory; others are optional.
ex.cn: 有些课程是必修的，其他是选修的。

ex.en: This model comes with a number of optional extras (= things you can choose to have but which you will have to pay extra for).
ex.cn: 这一型号有一系列可供选择的附件，价格另计。

senses.def: a person whose job is to examine people's eyes and to recommend and sell glasses
the job of measuring how well people can see and checking their eyes for disease
(in Britain) the action of a school or hospital that decides to manage its own money and is therefore no longer controlled by a local authority or similar organization
senses.chn: （英国学校、医院从地方当局财政管辖的）退出，脱离

senses.def: the act of choosing not to be involved in an agreement

ex.en: an opt-out clause
ex.cn: 退出的条款

ex.en: MPs hoped to reverse Britain's opt-out from the treaty.
ex.cn: 国会议员希望推翻英国退出该条约的决定。

senses.def: made or decorated using expensive materials
senses.chn: 豪华的；富丽堂皇的；华丽的

senses.def: extremely rich
a piece of music written by a famous composer and usually followed by a number that shows when it was written
senses.chn: （按作曲家的创作时间排列的）编号乐曲

ex.en: Beethoven's Opus 18
ex.cn: 贝多芬第十八号作品

senses.def: an important piece of literature, etc., especially one that is on a large scale
senses.chn: 主要（文学等）作品；（尤指）大作，巨著

senses.def: used to introduce another possibility
senses.chn: （用以引出另一种可能性）或，或者，还是

ex.en: Is your sister older or younger than you?
ex.cn: 你有姐姐还是妹妹？

ex.en: Are you coming or not?
ex.cn: 你来还是不来？

ex.en: Is it a boy or a girl?
ex.cn: 是个男孩还是女孩？

ex.en: It can be black, white or grey.
ex.cn: 它可能是黑的、白的或灰的。

senses.def: used in negative sentences when mentioning two or more things
senses.chn: （用于否定句，提出两种或多种事物时）也不

ex.en: He can't read or write.
ex.cn: 他不会读，也不会写。

ex.en: There are people without homes, jobs or family.
ex.cn: 有人既无房屋，又无工作，又无家庭。

senses.def: used to warn or advise sb that sth bad could happen; otherwise

ex.en: Turn the heat down or it'll burn.
ex.cn: 把炉火开小一些，不然就烧焦了。

senses.def: used between two numbers to show approximately how many
senses.chn: （用于两个数字之间表示约略数目）大约

ex.en: There were six or seven of us there.
ex.cn: 我们约有六七个人在场。

senses.def: used to introduce a word or phrase that explains or means the same as another
senses.chn: （用于引出解释性词语）或者说

ex.en: geology, or the science of the earth's crust
ex.cn: 地质学，或者说地壳的科学

ex.en: It weighs a kilo, or just over two pounds.
ex.cn: 这东西重一公斤，或者说两磅多一点儿。

senses.def: used to say why sth must be true

ex.en: He must like her, or he wouldn't keep calling her.
ex.cn: 他一定喜欢她，不然他不会老给她打电话。

senses.def: used to introduce a contrasting idea

ex.en: He was lying—or was he?
ex.cn: 他在说谎，还是没有说谎？

senses.def: about

ex.en: It'll cost €100 or so.
ex.cn: 这大约要花 100 欧元。

senses.def: used when you are not exactly sure about a person, thing or place
senses.chn: （表示对人、事、地点不太有把握）

ex.en: He's a factory supervisor or something.
ex.cn: 他是工厂监督一类的人吧。

ex.en: 'Who said so?' 'Oh, somebody or other. I can't remember who it was.'
ex.cn: “这是谁说的？” “啊，某一个人吧，我记不清是谁了。”

senses.def: (in ancient Greece) a place where people could go to ask the gods for advice or information about the future; the priest or priestess through whom the gods were thought to give their message
senses.chn: （古希腊的）神示所；（传达神谕的）牧师，女祭司

ex.en: They consulted the oracle at Delphi.
ex.cn: 他们在德尔斐神示所向神请示。

senses.def: (in ancient Greece) the advice or information that the gods gave, which often had a hidden meaning
senses.chn: （古希腊常有隐含意义的）神谕，神示

senses.def: a person or book that gives valuable advice or information
senses.chn: 能提供宝贵信息的人（或书）；权威；智囊

ex.en: My sister's the oracle on investment matters.
ex.cn: 我姐姐是个万无一失的投资顾问。

senses.def: of or like an oracle; with a hidden meaning
senses.chn: 神谕般的；天书般的；晦涩难懂的

senses.def: spoken rather than written

ex.en: a test of both oral and written French
ex.cn: 法语口试和笔试

ex.en: oral evidence
ex.cn: 口头证据

ex.en: He was interested in oral history (= history that is collected from interviews with people who have personal knowledge of past events).
ex.cn: 他对口述历史感兴趣。

ex.en: an exam in spoken English
ex.cn: 英语口语考试

ex.en: There will be a test of both oral and written French.
ex.cn: 将有一次法语口试和笔试。

ex.en: spoken/oral French
ex.cn: 法语口语

senses.def: connected with the mouth

ex.en: oral hygiene
ex.cn: 口腔卫生

ex.en: oral sex (= using the mouth to stimulate sb's sex organs)
ex.cn: 口交

senses.def: produced without the air in the nose vibrating
a spoken exam, especially in a foreign language

ex.en: a French oral
ex.cn: 法语口试

ex.en: He failed the oral.
ex.cn: 他口试不及格。

senses.def: a spoken exam in a university
the collection and study of historical information using sound recordings of interviews with people who remember past events
senses.chn: 口述历史（用访谈录音方法）；口述历史学

senses.def: the system of teaching deaf people to communicate using speech and lip-reading
senses.chn: 口语教学法（教聋人通过讲话和唇读来交际）

senses.def: a round citrus fruit with thick reddish-yellow skin and a lot of sweet juice

ex.en: orange peel
ex.cn: 柑橘皮

ex.en: an orange tree
ex.cn: 橙树

ex.en: freshly squeezed orange juice
ex.cn: 鲜榨橙汁

ex.en: orange groves (= groups of orange trees)
ex.cn: 橙树丛

ex.en: orange blossom
ex.cn: 香橙花

senses.def: orange juice, or a drink made from or tasting of oranges

ex.en: Would you like some orange?
ex.cn: 您想喝点橙汁吗？

ex.en: A vodka and orange, please.
ex.cn: 请来一份橙汁伏特加酒。

senses.def: a bright reddish-yellow colour
used to describe a situation in which two people or things are completely different from each other
senses.chn: 苹果橘子两码事；截然不同

ex.en: They really are apples and oranges.
ex.cn: 他们确实是迥然不同。

ex.en: They are both great but you can't compare apples and oranges.
ex.cn: 他们俩都很棒，但是截然不同，无法比较。

senses.def: bright reddish-yellow in colour

ex.en: yellow and orange flames
ex.cn: 黄色和橙色的火焰

senses.def: related to or belonging to a Protestant political group which believes that Northern Ireland should remain part of the UK
senses.chn: 奥兰治党的，奥兰治社团的（新教政治团体，主张北爱尔兰继续隶属英国）

ex.en: an Orange march
ex.cn: 奥兰治党的游行

senses.def: a sweet drink with an orange flavour. In Britain it always has bubbles in it; in the US it can be with or without bubbles.
senses.chn: 橙汁饮料；橘子汁；橙汁汽水

senses.def: a glass of orangeade
a member of the Orange Order, a Protestant political organization that wants Northern Ireland to remain part of the United Kingdom
senses.chn: 奥兰治党员，奥兰治人（主张北爱尔兰继续隶属英国的新教政治组织成员）

senses.def: a glass building where orange trees are grown
a thick sweet liquid made with orange juice and sugar; a drink made from this with water added

ex.en: a bottle of orange squash
ex.cn: 一瓶橙子水饮料

senses.def: a glass of orange squash

ex.en: Two orange squashes, please.
ex.cn: 请来两杯橙汁饮料。

senses.def: a large ape (= an animal like a large monkey with no tail) with long arms and reddish hair, that lives in Borneo and Sumatra
senses.chn: 猩猩，褐猿（产于婆罗洲和苏门答腊）

senses.def: or another thing of a similar type

ex.en: If you want to call a meeting or anything, just let me know.
ex.cn: 要是你想召集个会议什么的，就请告诉我。

senses.def: a formal speech made on a public occasion, especially as part of a ceremony
senses.chn: 演说，致辞（尤指作为仪式的一部分）

senses.def: a person who makes formal speeches in public or is good at public speaking
senses.chn: 讲演者；雄辩家；善于演说的人

ex.en: a fine political orator
ex.cn: 优秀的政治演说家

senses.def: connected with the art of public speaking

ex.en: oratorical skills
ex.cn: 演说技能

senses.def: a long piece of music for singers and an orchestra, usually based on a story from the Bible
senses.chn: 清唱剧，神剧（通常以《圣经》故事为主题）

senses.def: the skill of making powerful and effective speeches in public
a room or small building that is used for private prayer or worship
an object shaped like a ball, especially the sun or moon
a gold ball with a cross on top, carried by a king or queen at formal ceremonies as a symbol of power
senses.chn: 王权宝球（国王或女王在正式仪式上携带的顶部饰十字架的金球，是权力的象征）

senses.def: a curved path followed by a planet or an object as it moves around another planet, star, moon, etc.

ex.en: the earth's orbit around the sun
ex.cn: 地球环绕太阳的轨道

ex.en: a space station in orbit round the moon
ex.cn: 绕月球运行的一个空间站

ex.en: A new satellite has been put into orbit around the earth.
ex.cn: 一颗新的人造卫星被送上了环绕地球的轨道。

senses.def: an area that a particular person, organization, etc. deals with or is able to influence
senses.chn: （人、组织等的）影响范围，势力范围

ex.en: to come/fall/be within sb's orbit
ex.cn: 进入／落入／属于某人的势力范围

senses.def: to move in an orbit (= a curved path) around a much larger object, especially a planet, star, etc.

ex.en: The earth takes a year to orbit the sun.
ex.cn: 地球绕太阳一周要一年的时间。

senses.def: connected with the orbit of a planet or object in space
built around the edge of a town or city to reduce the amount of traffic travelling through the centre
a very large ring road, especially if it is a motorway

ex.en: the M25 London orbital
ex.cn: 伦敦 M25 高速环行路

senses.def: a spacecraft designed to move around a planet or moon rather than to land on it
senses.chn: （绕天体作轨道运行的）宇宙飞船；轨道飞行器

senses.def: a person from the islands of Orkney in Scotland
senses.chn: （苏格兰奥克尼群岛的）奥克尼人

senses.def: a piece of land, normally separated from the surrounding area, in which fruit trees are grown
a large group of people who play various musical instruments together, led by a conductor

ex.en: She plays the flute in the school orchestra.
ex.cn: 她在校管弦乐队里吹长笛。

ex.en: the Scottish Symphony Orchestra
ex.cn: 苏格兰交响乐团

senses.def: the seats that are nearest to the stage in a theatre
connected with an orchestra

ex.en: orchestral music
ex.cn: 管弦乐曲

senses.def: the place in a theatre just in front of the stage where the orchestra sits and plays for an opera, a ballet, etc.
senses.chn: 乐池，乐队席（舞台前乐队演奏的地方）

senses.def: to arrange a piece of music in parts so that it can be played by an orchestra
to organize a complicated plan or event very carefully or secretly

ex.en: a carefully orchestrated publicity campaign
ex.cn: 精心策划的一场宣传运动

senses.def: a plant with brightly coloured flowers of unusual shapes. There are many different types of orchid and some of them are very rare.
to make sb a priest, minister or rabbi

ex.en: He was ordained (as) a priest last year.
ex.cn: 他去年被授以神父圣职。

senses.def: to order or command sth; to decide sth in advance

ex.en: Fate had ordained that they would never meet again.
ex.cn: 他们命里注定永远不会再相见。

senses.def: a difficult or unpleasant experience
senses.chn: 磨难；折磨；煎熬；严酷的考验

ex.en: They are to be spared the ordeal of giving evidence in court.
ex.cn: 他们将免受出庭作证的难堪。

ex.en: The hostages spoke openly about the terrible ordeal they had been through.
ex.cn: 人质公开陈述了他们所遭受的非人的折磨。

ex.en: The interview was less of an ordeal than she'd expected.
ex.cn: 面试并非如她想象的那样可怕。

senses.def: the way in which people or things are placed or arranged in relation to each other

ex.en: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
ex.cn: 姓名是按字母顺序排列的。

ex.en: in chronological/numerical order
ex.cn: 按时间／数字顺序

ex.en: arranged in order of priority/importance/size
ex.cn: 按优先次序／重要性／大小排列

ex.en: The results, ranked in descending/ascending order, are as follows:
ex.cn: 结果按降序／升序排列如下：

ex.en: All the procedures must be done in the correct order.
ex.cn: 一切手续必须按正确顺序办理。

ex.en: Let's take the problems in a different order.
ex.cn: 咱们换一个顺序来处理这些问题吧。

senses.def: the state of being carefully and neatly arranged

ex.en: It was time she put her life in order.
ex.cn: 她到了该好好安排自己生活的时候了。

ex.en: The house had been kept in good order.
ex.cn: 房子保持得井井有条。

ex.en: Get your ideas into some sort of order before beginning to write.
ex.cn: 落笔之前，先要理清思路。

ex.en: It is one of the functions of art to bring order out of chaos.
ex.cn: 艺术的功能之一就是在于呈现纷乱中的秩序。

senses.def: the state that exists when people obey laws, rules or authority

ex.en: The army has been sent in to maintain order in the capital.
ex.cn: 军队被调进首都维持治安。

ex.en: Some teachers find it difficult to keep their classes in order.
ex.cn: 有些教师觉得难以维持课堂秩序。

ex.en: The police are trying to restore public order.
ex.cn: 警察正在努力恢复公共秩序。

ex.en: The argument continued until the chairman called them both to order (= ordered them to obey the formal rules of the meeting).
ex.cn: 争论持续不休，直到主席要求双方遵守议事规则。

senses.def: something that sb is told to do by sb in authority

ex.en: He gave orders for the work to be started.
ex.cn: 他下令开始工作。

ex.en: The general gave the order to advance.
ex.cn: 将军下令前进。

ex.en: I'm under orders not to let anyone in.
ex.cn: 我奉命不准任何人进入。

ex.en: She takes orders only from the president.
ex.cn: 她只听从总裁的吩咐。

ex.en: Dogs can be trained to obey orders.
ex.cn: 狗可以训练得听从命令。

ex.en: No sugar for me— doctor's orders.
ex.cn: 我不要糖，谨遵医嘱嘛。

senses.def: a request to make or supply goods

ex.en: I would like to place an order for ten copies of this book.
ex.cn: 这本书我想订购十册。

ex.en: an order form
ex.cn: 订货单

ex.en: The machine parts are still on order (= they have been ordered but have not yet been received).
ex.cn: 机器零件尚在订购之中。

ex.en: These items can be made to order (= produced especially for a particular customer).
ex.cn: 这几项可以定做。

senses.def: goods supplied in response to a particular order that sb has placed
senses.chn: 所订的货物；交付的订货

ex.en: The stationery order has arrived.
ex.cn: 订购的文具到货了。

senses.def: a request for food or drinks in a restaurant, bar, etc.; the food or drinks that you ask for

ex.en: May I take your order?
ex.cn: 您现在点菜吗？

ex.en: Last orders at the bar now please!(= because the bar is going to close)
ex.cn: 本店（打烊前）最后一次点酒了！

ex.en: an order for steak and fries
ex.cn: 点一份牛排炸薯条

ex.en: a side order (= for example, vegetables or salad that you eat with your main dish)
ex.cn: 配菜（主菜以外的蔬菜、色拉等）

senses.def: a formal written instruction for sb to be paid money or to do sth
senses.chn: 付款指令（或委托书）；书面指令；汇票

senses.def: the way that a society, the world, etc. is arranged, with its system of rules and customs

ex.en: a change in the political and social order
ex.cn: 政治和社会结构的改变

ex.en: the natural order of things
ex.cn: 天地万物的自然秩序

ex.en: He was seen as a threat to the established order.
ex.cn: 他被视为现存制度的大敌。

ex.en: A new order seems to be emerging.
ex.cn: 新的秩序似乎正在显现。

senses.def: a social class

ex.en: the lower orders
ex.cn: 底层社会

senses.def: a group into which animals, plants, etc. that have similar characteristics are divided, smaller than a class and larger than a family

ex.en: the order of primates
ex.cn: 灵长目

senses.def: a group of people living in a religious community, especially monks or nuns
senses.chn: （按照一定的规范生活的）宗教团体；（尤指）修会

ex.en: religious orders
ex.cn: 修会

ex.en: the Benedictine order
ex.cn: 本笃会

senses.def: a group of people who have been given a special honour by a queen, king, president, etc.
senses.chn: （获国王、女王、总统等）授勋的人；勋位；勋爵士团

ex.en: The Order of the Garter is an ancient order of chivalry.
ex.cn: 嘉德勋位是古老的骑士勋位。

senses.def: a badge or ribbon worn by members of an order who have been given a special honour
a secret society whose members meet for special ceremonies

ex.en: the Ancient Order of Druids
ex.cn: 古德鲁伊特共济会

senses.def: to be/become a priest
senses.chn: 已领受／领受神品（或圣秩）；为／成为神职人员

senses.def: that can be used because it is all correct and legal

ex.en: Is your work permit in order?
ex.cn: 你的工作许可证有效吗？

senses.def: as it should be

ex.en: Is everything in order, sir?
ex.cn: 一切都正常吗，先生？

senses.def: if sth is in order, it is a suitable thing to do or say on a particular occasion

ex.en: I think a drink would be in order.
ex.cn: 我想应该喝杯饮料了吧。

senses.def: allowed according to the rules of a meeting, etc.

ex.en: Is it in order to speak now?
ex.cn: 依规定现在可以发言了吗？

senses.def: so that sth can happen

ex.en: All those concerned must work together in order that agreement can be reached on this issue.
ex.cn: 一切有关人员必须通力合作，以便能在这个问题上达成协议。

senses.def: with the purpose or intention of doing or achieving sth

ex.en: She arrived early in order to get a good seat.
ex.cn: 她早早到场，好找个好位置。

ex.en: In order to get a complete picture, further information is needed.
ex.cn: 为掌握全面情况，还需要详细资料。

ex.en: This diagram illustrates the process of paper-making./This diagram shows how paper is made.
ex.cn: 这个图说明了造纸的过程。

ex.en: First / First of all, logs are delivered to a paper mill, where the bark is removed and the wood is cut into small chips.

ex.cn: 这个选择比其他任何一个都好。

ex.cn: 有一些设计比其他的好。

ex.cn: 这双鞋脏了，我要穿别的鞋。

ex.cn: 我去游泳，而其他人去打网球了。

ex.cn: 除了你，我不认识别的法国人。

ex.cn: 我们六月份外出；除此以外，我整个夏天都在这里。

ex.cn: 我从没见过他不自私。

ex.cn: 我父母借钱给我了。否则，我可付不起这次旅费。

ex.cn: 把窗户关好，不然屋子里就太冷了。

ex.cn: 我们是全心全意投入这项工作的，否则我们就不会到这里来了。

ex.cn: 楼上有些音乐声。除此以外，房子里静悄悄的。

ex.cn: 他除了一点青肿之外没有受伤。

ex.cn: 俾斯麦，亦称为 “铁血宰相”

ex.cn: 不准出售或以其他方式散发过去的试卷。

ex.cn: 你明明知道这是怎么回事，为什么装作不知道？

ex.en: I wanted to see him but he was otherwise engaged (= doing sth else).
ex.cn: 我想见他，但他正忙着别的事情。

ex.cn: 有必要查证这些说法是真是假。

ex.cn: 我们的保险涵盖一切意外损失及其他各种损失。

ex.cn: 哎呦！疼死了！

ex.en: They ought to apologize.
ex.cn: 他们应该道歉。

ex.cn: “我应该写信致谢吗？” “对，我觉得你应该。”

ex.cn: 他们本该道歉的。

ex.cn: 这种事应该禁止。

ex.en: He oughtn't to have been driving so fast.
ex.cn: 他本不该把车开得那么快。

ex.cn: 你应该把这婴儿带去看看医生。

senses.chn: （表示期望或可能发生的事）应该

ex.cn: 儿童 7 岁时应该识字了。

ex.cn: 护士的薪资应该多一点。

ex.en: We ought to be leaving now.
ex.cn: 我们现在该动身了。

ex.cn: 这个菜很可口，你可得尝尝。

ex.cn: 会议可有意思了，你真该参加。

senses.chn: （表示可能发生的或真实的事情）应该

ex.cn: 他如果九点出发，现在应该到这里了。

ex.cn: 这些食物应该够咱们四个人吃了。

ex.cn: 我们给他们看了我们的一些照片。

ex.cn: 我们主要出口大米。

ex.cn: 现在是驻罗马记者的报道…

ex.cn: 上帝

ex.en: Our Lady (= the Virgin Mary)
ex.cn: 圣母马利亚

ex.cn: 他们的房子和我们的十分相像，但我们的要大些。

ex.cn: 不，那些是埃利的孩子。我们的都在楼上。

ex.cn: 他是我们的朋友。

ex.cn: 周日来我们家吃晚饭怎么样？

ex.cn: 我们不应该为发生的事责怪自己。

ex.cn: 咱们轻松一下，好好享受享受。

ex.cn: 我们想亲眼看看它。

senses.chn: （用于强调或代替 we 或 us）我们自己，亲自

ex.cn: 我们常想亲自到那里去一趟。

ex.cn: 那里除了我们，没有别人。

senses.def: alone; without anyone else
without help
for us alone; not shared with anyone

ex.en: We had the pool all to ourselves.
ex.cn: 这个游泳池完全供我们自己使用。

senses.def: to force sb out of a job or position of power, especially in order to take their place

ex.en: He was ousted as chairman.
ex.cn: 他的主席职务被革除了。

ex.en: The rebels finally managed to oust the government from power.
ex.cn: 反叛者最后总算推翻了政府。

senses.def: the act of removing sb from a position of authority in order to put sb else in their place; the fact of being removed in this way

ex.en: the president's ouster by the military
ex.cn: 军方对总统的废黜

senses.def: away from the inside of a place or thing

ex.en: She ran out into the corridor.
ex.cn: 她跑出来，冲进走廊。

ex.en: She shook the bag and some coins fell out.
ex.cn: 她抖了抖袋子，几个硬币掉了出来。

ex.en: I got out of bed.
ex.cn: 我起了床。

ex.en: He opened the box and out jumped a frog.
ex.cn: 他打开盒子，从里面跳出一只青蛙来。

ex.en: Out you go! (= used to order sb to leave a room)
ex.cn: 滚出去！

ex.en: He ran out the door.
ex.cn: 他跑出门去。

senses.def: away from or not at home or their place of work
senses.chn: 不在家；不在工作地点；外出

ex.en: I called Liz but she was out.
ex.cn: 我打电话给利兹，但她不在家。

ex.en: Let's go out this evening (= for example to a restaurant or club).
ex.cn: 咱们今天晚上出去吧。

ex.en: We haven't had a night out for weeks.
ex.cn: 我们已经好几个星期晚上没出去过了。

ex.en: Mr Green is out of town this week.
ex.cn: 格林先生本周到外地去了。

senses.def: away from the edge of a place

ex.en: The boy dashed out into the road.
ex.cn: 男孩子向路中间冲去。

ex.en: Don't lean out of the window.
ex.cn: 不要探出窗外。

senses.def: a long or a particular distance away from a place or from land
senses.chn: 远离（某地或陆地）；离（某地或陆地）

ex.en: She's working out in Australia.
ex.cn: 她远在澳大利亚工作。

ex.en: He lives right out in the country.
ex.cn: 他住在远离此地的乡间。

ex.en: The boats are all out at sea.
ex.cn: 船只全都出海了。

ex.en: The ship sank ten miles out of Stockholm.
ex.cn: 那艘船在距离斯德哥尔摩十英里处沉入海中。

senses.def: used to show that sth/sb is removed from a place, job, etc.

ex.en: This detergent is good for getting stains out.
ex.cn: 这种洗涤剂能清除斑渍。

ex.en: We want this government out.
ex.cn: 我们想要这届政府下台。

ex.en: He got thrown out of the restaurant.
ex.cn: 他被逐出了餐馆。

senses.def: used to show that sth comes from or is obtained from sth/sb

ex.en: He drank his beer out of the bottle.
ex.cn: 他从瓶口直接喝啤酒。

ex.en: a statue made out of bronze
ex.cn: 一尊青铜像

ex.en: a romance straight out of a fairy tale
ex.cn: 童话故事般的爱情

ex.en: I paid for the damage out of my savings.
ex.cn: 我用自己的积蓄赔偿了损失。

ex.en: We'll get the truth out of her.
ex.cn: 我们会从她那里套出实情。

senses.def: used to show that sb/sth does not have any of sth

ex.en: We're out of milk.
ex.cn: 我们没有牛奶了。

ex.en: He's been out of work for six months.
ex.cn: 他已经失业六个月了。

ex.en: You're out of luck —she left ten minutes ago.
ex.cn: 你真不走运，她十分钟前才离开。

senses.def: used to show that sb/sth is not or no longer in a particular state or condition

ex.en: Try and stay out of trouble.
ex.cn: 尽量别惹麻烦。

ex.en: I watched the car until it was out of sight.
ex.cn: 我目送汽车，直到看不见为止。

senses.def: used to show that sb is no longer involved in sth

ex.en: It was an awful job and I'm glad to be out of it.
ex.cn: 那件差事简直是受罪，我很高兴摆脱掉了。

ex.en: He gets out of the army in a few weeks.
ex.cn: 几周之后他就要离开部队。

ex.en: They'll be out (= of prison) on bail in no time.
ex.cn: 他们马上就要获得保释出狱。

ex.en: Brown goes on to the semi-finals but Lee is out.
ex.cn: 布朗进入了半决赛，但李被淘汰了。

senses.def: used to show the reason why sth is done

ex.en: I asked out of curiosity.
ex.cn: 我因为好奇问了问。

ex.en: She did it out of spite.
ex.cn: 她那么做是出于恶意。

senses.def: from a particular number or set

ex.en: You scored six out of ten.
ex.cn: 总分十分你得了六分。

ex.en: Two out of three people think the President should resign.
ex.cn: 有三分之二的人认为总统应当辞职。

senses.def: not in the library; borrowed by sb else

ex.en: The book you wanted is out on loan.
ex.cn: 你要的那本书借出去了。

senses.def: at or towards its lowest point on land

ex.en: I like walking on the wet sand when the tide is out.
ex.cn: 我喜欢退潮后走在湿润的沙滩上。

senses.def: if the sun, moon or stars are or come out, they can be seen from the earth and are not hidden by clouds
fully open

ex.en: There should be some snowdrops out by now.
ex.cn: 现在应该有雪花莲开放了。

senses.def: available to everyone; known to everyone

ex.en: When does her new book come out?
ex.cn: 她的新书什么时候出版？

ex.en: Word always gets out (= people find out about things) no matter how careful you are.
ex.cn: 无论你多么小心，总会有消息走漏。

ex.en: Out with it!(= say what you know)
ex.cn: 你就说出来吧！

senses.def: clearly and loudly so that people can hear

ex.en: to call/cry/shout out
ex.cn: 大声叫／哭／喊

ex.en: Read it out loud.
ex.cn: 请大声朗读。

ex.en: Nobody spoke out in his defence.
ex.cn: 没有人站出来替他辩护。

senses.def: having told other people that you are homosexual

ex.en: I had been out since I was 17.
ex.cn: 我从 17 岁起就公开我是同性恋。

senses.def: if a team or team member is out, it is no longer their turn with the bat

ex.en: The West Indies were all out for 364 (= after scoring 364 runs in cricket ).
ex.cn: 西印度群岛队以 364 分全队出局。

senses.def: if the ball is out, it landed outside the line

ex.en: The umpire said the ball was out.
ex.cn: 裁判员判球出界。

senses.def: not correct or exact; wrong

ex.en: I was slightly out in my calculations.
ex.cn: 我的计算出了点小错。

ex.en: Your guess was a long way out (= completely wrong).
ex.cn: 你的猜测完全错了。

ex.en: The estimate was out by more than $100.
ex.cn: 这个估计差了 100 多美元。

senses.def: not possible or not allowed

ex.en: Swimming is out until the weather gets warmer.
ex.cn: 天气转暖前，游泳是不可能的。

senses.def: not fashionable

ex.en: Black is out this year.
ex.cn: 今年黑色不时兴了。

senses.def: not or no longer burning or lit

ex.en: Suddenly all the lights went out.
ex.cn: 突然间所有的灯光都灭了。

ex.en: The fire had burnt itself out.
ex.cn: 炉火烧尽熄灭了。

senses.def: at an end

ex.en: It was summer and school was out.
ex.cn: 夏天，学校放假了。

ex.en: She was to regret her words before the day was out.
ex.cn: 她到不了天黑就会为自己说的话后悔。

senses.def: unconscious

ex.en: He was out for more than an hour and came round in the hospital.
ex.cn: 他昏迷了一个多小时，在医院才苏醒过来。

ex.en: She was knocked out cold.
ex.cn: 她完全被打昏了。

senses.def: on strike
to the end; completely

ex.en: Hear me out before you say anything.
ex.cn: 你听我说完再讲话。

ex.en: We left them to fight it out (= settle a disagreement by fighting or arguing).
ex.cn: 我们让他们争吵下去，争出个输赢。

senses.def: to be trying to get or do sth

ex.en: I'm not out for revenge.
ex.cn: 我不是来寻报复的。

ex.en: She's out for what she can get (= trying to get something for herself).
ex.cn: 她力图得到自己能得的。

ex.en: The company is out to capture the Canadian market.
ex.cn: 这家公司竭尽全力抢占加拿大市场。

senses.def: able to go outside again after an illness
travelling around a place

ex.en: We've been out and about talking to people all over the country.
ex.cn: 我们游遍了全国，和各地的人交谈。

senses.def: going or leaving

ex.en: As soon as I get my money I'm out of here!
ex.cn: 我一拿到钱就走！

senses.def: sad because you are not included in sth
senses.chn: （觉得自己是外人而）不是味儿

ex.en: We've only just moved here so we feel a little out of it.
ex.cn: 我们刚搬到这里，所以心里觉得有点不适应。

senses.def: not aware of what is happening, usually because of drinking too much alcohol, or taking drugs
senses.chn: （因酒或药物作用而对周围事情）茫然不觉，昏昏然

senses.def: a way of avoiding having to do sth

ex.en: She was desperately looking for an out.
ex.cn: 她在拼命找一条脱身之计。

ex.en: He was in and out of jail for most of his life.
ex.cn: 他大半生的时间都是监狱的常客。

senses.def: having told other people that you are homosexual

ex.en: an out gay man
ex.cn: 已公开同性恋身份的男子

senses.def: to say publicly that sb is homosexual, especially when they would prefer to keep the fact a secret

ex.en: He is the latest politician to be outed by gay activists.
ex.cn: 他是被同性恋维权人士新近揭露的同性恋政治人物。

senses.def: to say sth publicly about sb/sth that they would prefer to keep secret
senses.chn: 揭露，公布（别人想要保守的秘密）

ex.en: The man who claimed to have found the diaries has been outed as a fraud.
ex.cn: 声称找到日记的人被揭露是个骗子。

senses.def: greater, better, further, longer, etc.

ex.en: outnumber
ex.cn: 在数量上压倒

ex.en: outwit
ex.cn: 在智慧上胜过

ex.en: outgrow
ex.cn: 长得比…快

ex.en: outlive
ex.cn: 活得比…长

senses.def: outside; outward; away from

ex.en: outbuildings
ex.cn: 附属建筑物

ex.en: outpatient
ex.cn: 门诊病人

ex.en: outlying
ex.cn: 偏远的

ex.en: outgoing
ex.cn: 向外的

senses.def: a period of time when the supply of electricity, etc. is not working

ex.en: a power outage
ex.cn: 停电期间

senses.def: able to go outside again after an illness
travelling around a place

ex.en: We've been out and about talking to people all over the country.
ex.cn: 我们游遍了全国，和各地的人交谈。

senses.def: in every way
senses.chn: 十足的；完全的；彻头彻尾的

ex.en: What she said was an out-and-out lie.
ex.cn: 她说的是个弥天大谎。

senses.def: the area of Australia that is a long way from the coast and the towns, where few people live
to offer more money than sb else in order to buy sth, for example at an auction
on, towards or near the outside of a ship or an aircraft
senses.chn: （船或飞机）舷外的，外侧的，靠近外侧的

senses.def: an engine that you can fix to the back of a small boat
travelling from a place rather than arriving in it
senses.chn: 向外的；出港的；离开某地的

ex.en: outbound flights/passengers
ex.cn: 出港航班／旅客

senses.def: the place on a computer where new email messages that you write are stored before they are sent
the sudden start of sth unpleasant, especially violence or a disease
senses.chn: （暴力、疾病等坏事的）爆发，突然发生

ex.en: the outbreak of war
ex.cn: 战争的爆发

ex.en: an outbreak of typhoid
ex.cn: 伤寒的爆发

ex.en: Outbreaks of rain are expected in the afternoon.
ex.cn: 下午将有暴雨。

senses.def: a building such as a shed or stable that is built near to, but separate from, a main building
a sudden strong expression of an emotion

ex.en: an outburst of anger
ex.cn: 突然大怒

ex.en: She was alarmed by his violent outburst.
ex.cn: 他暴跳如雷，令她惊恐万状。

senses.def: a sudden increase in a particular activity or attitude

ex.en: an outburst of racism
ex.cn: 种族主义的突然高涨

senses.def: a person who is not accepted by other people and who sometimes has to leave their home and friends

ex.en: People with the disease were often treated as social outcasts.
ex.cn: 患有这种疾病的人常被社会摈弃。

senses.def: to be much better than sb you are competing against
senses.chn: 远远高出，远远超过（对手）

ex.en: Kennedy was outclassed 0–6 0–6 in the final.
ex.cn: 肯尼迪在决赛中以 0:6 和 0:6 连输两盘落败。

senses.def: the result or effect of an action or event

ex.en: We are waiting to hear the final outcome of the negotiations.
ex.cn: 我们在等待谈判的最终结果。

ex.en: These costs are payable whatever the outcome of the case.
ex.cn: 无论讼案结果如何，这些费用都应照付。

ex.en: We are confident of a successful outcome.
ex.cn: 我们相信会有圆满的结果。

ex.en: Four possible outcomes have been identified.
ex.cn: 现已确定有四种可能的结果。

ex.en: She died as a result of her injuries.
ex.cn: 她因伤死亡。

ex.en: This book is the result of 25 years of research.
ex.cn: 这本书是 25 年研究的结晶。

senses.def: a large mass of rock that stands above the surface of the ground
a reaction of anger or strong protest shown by people in public

ex.en: an outcry over the proposed change
ex.cn: 对拟议的改革所发出的强烈抗议

ex.en: The new tax provoked a public outcry.
ex.cn: 新税项引起了公众的强烈抗议。

ex.en: There was outcry at the judge's statement.
ex.cn: 法官的陈辞引起一片哗然。

senses.def: no longer useful because of being old-fashioned

ex.en: outdated equipment
ex.cn: 过时的设备

ex.en: These figures are now outdated.
ex.cn: 这些数字现在已经过时。

senses.def: to leave sb/sth behind by going faster, further, etc.; to be better than sb/sth
to do more or better than sb else

ex.en: Sometimes small firms can outdo big business when it comes to customer care.
ex.cn: 在顾客服务方面，有时小企业可能优于大企业。

ex.en: Not to be outdone (= not wanting to let sb else do better), she tried again.
ex.cn: 她不甘落后，又试了一次。

senses.def: used, happening or located outside rather than in a building

ex.en: outdoor clothing/activities
ex.cn: 户外穿的衣服／活动

ex.en: an outdoor swimming pool
ex.cn: 室外游泳池

ex.en: I'm not really the outdoor type (= I prefer indoor activities).
ex.cn: 我不是那种真正喜爱户外活动的人。

senses.def: outside, rather than in a building

ex.en: The rain prevented them from eating outdoors.
ex.cn: 雨天使他们无法户外用餐。

senses.def: the countryside, away from buildings and busy places

ex.en: They both have a love of the outdoors.
ex.cn: 他们俩都喜爱郊外的环境。

ex.en: Come to Canada and enjoy the great outdoors.
ex.cn: 到加拿大来享受蓝天碧野吧！

senses.def: on the outside of sth

ex.en: the outer layers of the skin
ex.cn: 皮肤表层

senses.def: furthest from the inside or centre of sth

ex.en: I walked along the outer edge of the track.
ex.cn: 我沿着跑道的外缘走。

ex.en: the outer suburbs of the city
ex.cn: 城市的远郊

ex.en: Outer London
ex.cn: 伦敦的外围地区

ex.en: to explore the outer (= most extreme) limits of human experience
ex.cn: 探索人类经验的极限

senses.def: a road that is built around a city or town to reduce traffic in the centre
furthest from the inside or centre

ex.en: the outermost planet
ex.cn: 最远的行星

ex.en: He fired and hit the outermost ring of the target.
ex.cn: 他开枪射中了靶子的最外一环。

senses.def: clothes such as coats, hats, etc. that you wear outside
to defeat an enemy or opponent by being brave and remaining confident
the place where a river, pipe, etc. flows out into the sea
senses.chn: （河流、管道等的）排放口，出水口；入海口；河口

ex.en: a sewage outfall
ex.cn: 污水排放口

senses.def: the outer part of the field in baseball, cricket and some other sports
senses.chn: （棒球、板球等体育运动的）外场，外野

senses.def: in or to the outfield
a player in the outfield
a set of clothes that you wear together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose
senses.chn: 全套服装，装束（尤指为某场合或目的）

ex.en: She was wearing an expensive new outfit.
ex.cn: 她穿着一身昂贵的新衣裳。

ex.en: a wedding outfit
ex.cn: 一套结婚礼服

ex.en: a cowboy/Superman outfit (= one that you wear for fun in order to look like the type of person mentioned)
ex.cn: 一套牛仔／超人服装

senses.def: a group of people working together as an organization, business, team, etc.

ex.en: a market research outfit
ex.cn: 市场调查组

ex.en: This was the fourth album by the top rock outfit.
ex.cn: 这是这个顶级摇滚乐队的第四张唱片专辑。

senses.def: a set of equipment that you need for a particular purpose

ex.en: a bicycle repair outfit
ex.cn: 修自行车的整套工具

senses.def: to provide sb/sth with equipment or clothes for a special purpose
senses.chn: 装备；配置设备；供给服装

ex.en: The ship was outfitted with a 12-bed hospital.
ex.cn: 这艘船配备了一所有 12 个床位的医院。

senses.def: a shop/store that sells men's clothes or school uniforms
a shop/store that sells equipment for camping and other outdoor activities
senses.chn: 户外用品店；露营装备店

senses.def: to move around the side of an enemy or opponent, especially in order to attack them from behind
to gain an advantage over sb, especially by doing sth unexpected
the movement of a large amount of money, liquid, people, etc. out of a place

ex.en: There was a capital outflow of $22 billion in 2008.
ex.cn: 2008 年的资本外流量为 220 亿美元。

ex.en: a steady outflow of oil from the tank
ex.cn: 石油从油罐里不断的流出

ex.en: the outflow of refugees
ex.cn: 难民涌出

senses.def: unable to get up again within ten seconds after being knocked down
senses.chn: （被击倒后的十秒钟以内）无法再站立起来

senses.def: in a deep sleep
to gain an advantage over sb by being more clever than they are
in the part of a theatre, restaurant, etc. where the public sits

ex.en: There's only a small audience out front tonight.
ex.cn: 今夜观众席上人很少。

senses.def: in the area near to the entrance to a building

ex.en: I'll wait for you out (the) front.
ex.cn: 我在大门外等你。

senses.def: liking to meet other people, enjoying their company and being friendly towards them
senses.chn: 爱交际的；友好的；外向的

ex.en: an outgoing personality
ex.cn: 外向的性格

senses.def: leaving the position of responsibility mentioned

ex.en: the outgoing president/government
ex.cn: 即将下台的总统／政府

senses.def: going away from a particular place rather than arriving in it

ex.en: This telephone should be used for outgoing calls.
ex.cn: 这部电话用来往外拨打电话。

ex.en: outgoing flights/passengers
ex.cn: 离港航班／旅客

ex.en: the outgoing tide
ex.cn: 退潮

senses.def: the amount of money that a person or a business has to spend regularly, for example every month

ex.en: low/high outgoings
ex.cn: 开支低／高

ex.en: Write down your incomings and outgoings.
ex.cn: 把你的收入与支出记下来。

senses.def: the people who do not belong to a particular in-group in a society
to grow too big to be able to wear or fit into sth
senses.chn: 长得穿不下（衣服）；增长得容不进（某地）

ex.en: She's already outgrown her school uniform.
ex.cn: 她已经长得连校服都不能穿了。

ex.en: The company has outgrown its offices.
ex.cn: 公司发展得办公室都不够用了。

senses.def: to grow taller, larger or more quickly than another person

ex.en: He's already outgrown his older brother.
ex.cn: 他已长得比他哥哥还高。

senses.def: to stop doing sth or lose interest in sth as you become older
senses.chn: 因长大而放弃；年增志移

ex.en: He's outgrown his passion for rock music.
ex.cn: 随着年龄的增长，他已对摇滚乐失去了热情。

senses.def: a thing that grows out of sth else

ex.en: The eye first appears as a cup-shaped outgrowth from the brain.
ex.cn: 眼睛最初看上去是从大脑长出，呈杯状。

senses.def: a natural development or result of sth

ex.en: The law was an outgrowth of the 2008 presidential election.
ex.cn: 这项法律是 2008 年总统选举的自然产物。

senses.def: to have greater military strength than sb

ex.en: The England team was completely outgunned.
ex.cn: 英格兰队毫无还手之力。

senses.def: a small building, such as a shed, outside a main building
senses.chn: （主建筑的）外围建筑，附属建筑

senses.def: a toilet in a small building of its own
a trip that you go on for pleasure or education, usually with a group of people and lasting no more than one day
senses.chn: （集体）出外游玩（或学习等）；远足

ex.en: We went on an outing to London.
ex.cn: 我们游览了伦敦。

ex.en: a family outing
ex.cn: 全家远足

ex.en: a business trip
ex.cn: 出差

ex.en: a five-minute trip by taxi
ex.cn: 五分钟的出租车车程

ex.en: a long and difficult journey across the mountains
ex.cn: 漫长而艰难的翻山旅行

ex.en: a trip to New York
ex.cn: 去纽约的旅行

senses.def: an occasion when sb takes part in a competition
the practice of naming people as homosexuals in public, when they do not want anyone to know
senses.chn: （违背同性恋者本人意愿）对（其）身份的公开挑明

senses.def: strange or extremely unusual
senses.chn: 古怪的；极不寻常的；奇特的

ex.en: outlandish costumes/ideas
ex.cn: 奇装异服；古怪的想法

senses.def: to continue to exist or take part in an activity for a longer time than sb/sth

ex.en: He can outlast anyone on the dance floor.
ex.cn: 在舞场上，他比谁都能跳。

senses.def: to make sth illegal
senses.chn: 宣布…不合法；使…成为非法

ex.en: plans to outlaw the carrying of knives
ex.cn: 宣布携带刀具为非法的方案

ex.en: the outlawed nationalist party
ex.cn: 被宣布为非法的民族主义党

senses.def: (in the past) to make sb an outlaw
(used especially about people in the past) a person who has done sth illegal and is hiding to avoid being caught; a person who is not protected by the law
senses.chn: （尤指过去的人）亡命徒，逃犯，草莽英雄，被剥夺法律权益者

ex.en: Robin Hood, the world's most famous outlaw
ex.cn: 罗宾汉，蜚声世界的绿林好汉

senses.def: the money that you have to spend in order to start a new project

ex.en: The business quickly repaid the initial outlay on advertising.
ex.cn: 这家公司很快偿付了初期的广告费。

ex.en: a massive financial/capital outlay
ex.cn: 大量的财政／资本开支

ex.en: labour/production costs
ex.cn: 人工／生产成本

ex.en: rising costs
ex.cn: 正在上涨的成本

ex.en: public spending
ex.cn: 公共开支

ex.en: More spending on health was promised.
ex.cn: 已承诺增加医疗开支。

senses.def: a way of expressing or making good use of strong feelings, ideas or energy
senses.chn: （感情、思想、精力发泄的）出路；表现机会

ex.en: She needed to find an outlet for her many talents and interests.
ex.cn: 她多才多艺、兴趣广泛，需要找个施展的机会。

ex.en: Sport became the perfect outlet for his aggression.
ex.cn: 运动成为他攻击性情绪的最佳释放途径。

senses.def: a shop/store or an organization that sells goods made by a particular company or of a particular type

ex.en: The business has 34 retail outlets in this state alone.
ex.cn: 那家商号仅在本州就有 34 个零售店。

senses.def: a shop/store that sells goods of a particular make at reduced prices

ex.en: the Nike outlet in the outlet mall
ex.cn: 折扣品商场里的耐克折扣店

senses.def: a pipe or hole through which liquid or gas can flow out

ex.en: a sewage outlet
ex.cn: 污水排放口

ex.en: an outlet pipe
ex.cn: 排水管道

senses.def: a device in a wall that you put a plug into in order to connect electrical equipment to the power supply of a building
to give a description of the main facts or points involved in sth

ex.en: We outlined our proposals to the committee.
ex.cn: 我们向委员会提纲挈领地讲了讲我们的提案。

senses.def: to show or mark the outer edge of sth
senses.chn: 显示…的轮廓；勾勒…的外形

ex.en: They saw the huge building outlined against the sky.
ex.cn: 他们看见了在天空的映衬下那座巨大建筑的轮廓。

senses.def: a description of the main facts or points involved in sth

ex.en: This is a brief outline of the events.
ex.cn: 这就是事件的简要情况。

ex.en: You should draw up a plan or outline for the essay.
ex.cn: 你应该为文章草拟个计划或提纲。

ex.en: The book describes in outline the main findings of the research.
ex.cn: 本书扼要叙述了主要的研究结果。

ex.en: an outline agreement/proposal
ex.cn: 协议／建议纲要

senses.def: the line that goes around the edge of sth, showing its main shape but not the details

ex.en: At last we could see the dim outline of an island.
ex.cn: 我们终于能看到一小岛朦胧的轮廓了。

ex.en: an outline map/sketch
ex.cn: 略图；草图

ex.en: She drew the figures in outline.
ex.cn: 她简略地勾勒出人物的轮廓。

senses.def: to live longer than sb

ex.en: He outlived his wife by three years.
ex.cn: 他比妻子多活了三年。

senses.def: to continue to exist after sth else has ended or disappeared

ex.en: The machine had outlived its usefulness (= was no longer useful).
ex.cn: 这机器已无用了。

senses.def: the attitude to life and the world of a particular person, group or culture
senses.chn: 观点；见解；世界观；人生观

ex.en: He had a practical outlook on life.
ex.cn: 他的人生观很实际。

ex.en: Most Western societies are liberal in outlook.
ex.cn: 西方社会大多思想观念开放。

senses.def: the probable future for sb/sth; what is likely to happen

ex.en: The outlook for jobs is bleak.
ex.cn: 就业市场前景暗淡。

ex.en: the country's economic outlook
ex.cn: 国家的经济前景

ex.en: The outlook (= the probable weather) for the weekend is dry and sunny.
ex.cn: 周末天气可望晴朗干燥。

senses.def: a view from a particular place

ex.en: The house has a pleasant outlook over the valley.
ex.cn: 房子俯瞰山谷，景色宜人。

senses.def: in a voice that can be heard by other people

ex.en: I laughed out loud.
ex.cn: 我放声大笑。

ex.en: Please read the letter out loud.
ex.cn: 请把信大声念出来。

senses.def: far away from the cities of a country or from the main part of a place
senses.chn: 边远的；偏远的；远离市镇的

ex.en: outlying areas
ex.cn: 偏远地区

senses.def: to do better than an opponent by acting in a way that is cleverer or more skilful

ex.en: The president has so far managed to outmanoeuvre his critics.
ex.cn: 到目前为止，总统面对批评者都能够应付裕如。

senses.def: no longer fashionable or useful

ex.en: an outmoded attitude
ex.cn: 陈腐的观点

senses.def: to be greater in number than sb/sth

ex.en: The demonstrators were heavily outnumbered by the police.
ex.cn: 示威者人数远不及警察人数。

ex.en: In this profession, women outnumber men by two to one (= there are twice as many women as men).
ex.cn: 在这个行业，女性人数是男性的两倍。

senses.def: not able to work or be used because of injury or damage
senses.chn: 不能工作；失去作用；停止运转

ex.en: Jon will be out of action for weeks with a broken leg.
ex.cn: 乔恩断了一条腿，将有几个星期不能工作。

ex.en: The photocopier is out of action today.
ex.cn: 复印机今天出故障了。

senses.def: a feeling of being outside your own body, especially when you feel that you are watching yourself from a distance
senses.chn: 离体体验，灵魂出窍体验（尤指从远处观看自己的感觉）

senses.def: outside the area of play which is allowed

ex.en: His shot went out of bounds.
ex.cn: 他的球出界了。

senses.def: not reasonable or acceptable
senses.chn: 不合理的；令人无法接受的

ex.en: His demands were out of bounds.
ex.cn: 他的要求不合理。

senses.def: having difficulty breathing after exercise
senses.chn: （运动后）喘不上气，透不过气来

ex.en: We were out of breath after only five minutes.
ex.cn: 我们五分钟后便气喘吁吁了。

senses.def: having stopped operating as a business because there is no more money or work available

ex.en: The new regulations will put many small businesses out of business.
ex.cn: 新法规将使很多小企业关闭。

ex.en: Some travel companies will probably go out of business this summer.
ex.cn: 今年夏天一些旅游公司很可能歇业。

senses.def: typical/not typical of a person's character
senses.chn: 符合（或不符合）某人的性格

ex.en: Her behaviour last night was completely out of character.
ex.cn: 她昨晚的举止与她的性格截然不符。

senses.def: old-fashioned or without the most recent information and therefore no longer useful
senses.chn: 过时的；缺乏新信息的；陈腐的

ex.en: These figures are very out of date.
ex.cn: 这些数字早已过时。

ex.en: Suddenly she felt old and out of date.
ex.cn: 她猛然觉得自己老了，跟不上时代了。

ex.en: an out-of-date map
ex.cn: 已过时的地图

ex.en: out-of-date technology
ex.cn: 落伍的技术

senses.def: no longer valid

ex.en: an out-of-date driving licence
ex.cn: 过期的驾驶执照

senses.def: not inside a building

ex.en: You should spend more time out of doors in the fresh air.
ex.cn: 你应多花点时间在户外呼吸新鲜空气。

senses.def: difficult or impossible to control

ex.en: Unemployment is getting out of hand.
ex.cn: 失业问题越来越难以控制。

senses.def: if you reject, etc. sth out of hand, you do so immediately without thinking about it fully or listening to other people's arguments

ex.en: All our suggestions were dismissed out of hand.
ex.cn: 我们的建议均遭到了草率的拒绝。

senses.def: in a safe place where sb/sth cannot be hurt or injured or do any damage to sb/sth
too far away to hear sb/sth or to be heard
senses.chn: 离得太远听不见；在听力范围外

ex.en: She had moved out of hearing.
ex.cn: 她走远了，已经听不到。

senses.def: going or leaving

ex.en: As soon as I get my money I'm out of here!
ex.cn: 我一拿到钱就走！

senses.def: sad because you are not included in sth
senses.chn: （觉得自己是外人而）不是味儿

ex.en: We've only just moved here so we feel a little out of it.
ex.cn: 我们刚搬到这里，所以心里觉得有点不适应。

senses.def: not aware of what is happening, usually because of drinking too much alcohol, or taking drugs
senses.chn: （因酒或药物作用而对周围事情）茫然不觉，昏昏然

senses.def: pushed out of its correct position
not working or behaving in the normal way
not agreeing with or the same as sth else

ex.en: His views are out of kilter with world opinion.
ex.cn: 他的观点与世人的看法不一样。

senses.def: no longer continuing or working in the normal way

ex.en: Long flights throw my sleeping pattern out of kilter for days.
ex.cn: 长途飞行把我的睡眠习惯打乱了好几天。

senses.def: not working correctly

ex.en: The phone is out of order.
ex.cn: 电话坏了。

senses.def: not arranged correctly or neatly

ex.en: I checked the files and some of the papers were out of order.
ex.cn: 我检查过案卷，其中有些未按顺序编排。

senses.def: behaving in a way that is not acceptable or right
senses.chn: 行为不当；举止令人难以接受

ex.en: You were well out of order taking it without asking.
ex.cn: 你不问一声就把它拿走，这是很不妥当的。

senses.def: not allowed by the rules of a formal meeting or debate
senses.chn: 违反规程的；不合乎（会议或辩论）规则的

ex.en: His objection was ruled out of order.
ex.cn: 他的反对被裁定为违反会议规则。

senses.def: not in the correct place

ex.en: Some of these files seem to be out of place.
ex.cn: 有些档案似乎没放对地方。

senses.def: not suitable for a particular situation

ex.en: Her remarks were out of place.
ex.cn: 她出言不当。

ex.en: I felt completely out of place among all these successful people.
ex.cn: 夹在这些事业有成的人中间我觉得自己格格不入。

senses.def: small business expenses that you pay yourself, with your employer paying you back later

ex.en: On business trips she has some travel and other out-of-pocket expenses.
ex.cn: 她出差要垫付一些差旅费和其他费用。

senses.def: no longer available from the company that publishes it
not easily available because it is not the right time of year for them
at the times of year when few people go on holiday/vacation

ex.en: Hotels are cheaper out of season.
ex.cn: 在淡季，旅馆要便宜些。

senses.def: not having the normal shape

ex.en: The wheel had been twisted out of shape.
ex.cn: 轮子已经扭曲变形了。

senses.def: not in good physical condition
ill/sick or upset

ex.en: She was tired and out of sorts by the time she arrived home.
ex.cn: 她回到家里，又累又烦。

senses.def: coming from or happening in a different state

ex.en: out-of-state license plates
ex.cn: 外州的汽车牌照

senses.def: not moving or working at exactly the same time and speed as sb/sth else
not in agreement with sb/sth; not working well with sb/sth
if sb says that an object or a custom is out of the ark or went out with the ark, they think that it is very old-fashioned
unexpectedly; without warning
senses.chn: 出乎意料；突然；晴天霹雳

ex.en: The decision came out of the blue.
ex.cn: 这个决定来得很突然。

out of the frying pan into the fire.lemma: out of the frying pan into the fire

senses.def: from a bad situation to one that is worse
senses.chn: 跳出油锅又落火坑；逃出虎口又入狼窝；每况愈下

out of the goodness of your heart.lemma: out of the goodness of your heart

senses.def: from feelings of kindness, without thinking about what advantage there will be for you
senses.chn: 出于好心（不从中捞取好处）

ex.en: You're not telling me he offered to lend you the money out of the goodness of his heart?
ex.cn: 你该不是说他是纯粹出于好心才主动借钱给你的吧？

senses.def: part of a group of people that is dealing with sth important; not part of this group
senses.chn: 属（处理要务的）圈内／圈外人士

senses.def: unusual or different

ex.en: I'm looking for something a little more out of the ordinary.
ex.cn: 我正在找些稍不寻常的东西。

senses.def: impossible or not allowed and therefore not worth discussing
senses.chn: 不可能；不允许；不值得讨论

ex.en: Another trip abroad this year is out of the question.
ex.cn: 今年再度出国是绝无可能的。

senses.def: no longer stopping sb from moving or doing sth

ex.en: I moved my legs out of the way so that she could get past.
ex.cn: 我挪开腿让她过去。

ex.en: I didn't say anything until Dad was out of the way.
ex.cn: 我直到爸爸不再打扰之后才说话。

senses.def: finished; dealt with

ex.en: Our region is poised for growth once the election is out of the way.
ex.cn: 大选一结束，我们地区就准备大展拳脚。

senses.def: used in negative sentences to mean 'unusual'
senses.chn: （用于否定句）奇特的，不寻常的，罕见的

ex.en: She had obviously noticed nothing out of the way.
ex.cn: 她显然没发现异常情况。

senses.def: far from a town or city

ex.en: a little out-of-the-way place on the coast
ex.cn: 海边一个偏远的小地方

senses.def: from nowhere or nothing, as if by magic
used to emphasize how good, beautiful, etc. sth is
senses.chn: 好（或美等）得不得了；非凡；呱呱叫

ex.en: The meal was out of this world.
ex.cn: 这顿饭简直是没治了。

senses.def: located away from the centre of a town or city

ex.en: out-of-town superstores
ex.cn: 市郊超级商场

senses.def: coming from or happening in a different place

ex.en: an out-of-town guest
ex.cn: 外来客

ex.en: an out-of-town performance
ex.cn: 外地演出

senses.def: if an object is out of true, it is not straight or in the correct position
senses.chn: 歪七扭八；位置不正；偏斜

senses.def: no longer correct or working properly
senses.chn: 不对头；有毛病；运行不正常

ex.en: The system is clearly out of whack.
ex.cn: 这个系统明显是运行不正常。

ex.en: All the traveling had thrown my body out of whack.
ex.cn: 这一路旅行已经使我的身体出了毛病。

senses.def: not agreeing with or the same as sth else

ex.en: Expectations and reality got out of whack.
ex.cn: 期望和现实之间出现了差距。

senses.def: unemployed

ex.en: an out-of-work actor
ex.cn: 待业演员

senses.def: in a situation that you are not used to and that makes you feel uncomfortable
senses.chn: 处于不适应的环境；不得其所

senses.def: no longer your responsibility

ex.en: I'm afraid the matter is now out of my hands.
ex.cn: 恐怕这件事现已不归我管。

senses.def: not on the route that you planned to take

ex.en: I'd love a ride home—if it's not out of your way.
ex.cn: 我很想搭你的车回家，如果这不叫你绕路的话。

senses.def: not supported by other people

ex.en: Are you prepared to go out on a limb (= risk doing sth that other people are not prepared to do) and make your suspicions public?
ex.cn: 你愿意冒险把你怀疑的事公开吗？

senses.def: to go, rise, improve, etc. faster than sb/sth

ex.en: He easily outpaced the other runners.
ex.cn: 他轻而易举地超过了其他赛跑选手。

ex.en: Demand is outpacing production.
ex.cn: 需求正在超过生产。

senses.def: a person who goes to a hospital for treatment but does not stay there

ex.en: an outpatient clinic
ex.cn: 门诊部

senses.def: to achieve better results than sb/sth
the process of helping people to find new jobs after they have been made unemployed
senses.chn: （对失业人员的）安置，再就业服务

senses.def: to play much better than sb you are competing against

ex.en: We were totally outplayed and lost 106–74.
ex.cn: 我们以 74:106 惨败。

senses.def: to defeat sb by scoring more points
a small military camp away from the main army, used for watching an enemy's movements, etc.
a small town or group of buildings in a lonely part of a country

ex.en: a remote outpost
ex.cn: 偏远的村镇

ex.en: the last outpost of civilization
ex.cn: 文明的边缘地区

senses.def: a strong and sudden expression of feeling

ex.en: spontaneous outpourings of praise
ex.cn: 一片自然迸发的赞美声

senses.def: a large amount of sth produced in a short time

ex.en: a remarkable outpouring of new ideas
ex.cn: 新思想的大量涌现

senses.def: the amount of sth that a person, a machine or an organization produces

ex.en: Manufacturing output has increased by 8%.
ex.cn: 工业产量增长了 8%。

senses.def: the information, results, etc. produced by a computer

ex.en: data output
ex.cn: 数据输出

ex.en: an output device
ex.cn: 输出装置

senses.def: the power, energy, etc. produced by a piece of equipment

ex.en: an output of 100 watts
ex.cn: 输出功率 100 瓦

senses.def: a place where energy, power, information, etc. leaves a system

ex.en: Connect a cable to the output.
ex.cn: 把缆线接到输出端上。

senses.def: to supply or produce information, results, etc.

ex.en: Computers can now output data much more quickly.
ex.cn: 现在计算机能更快地输出数据。

senses.def: a strong feeling of shock and anger

ex.en: The judge's remarks caused public outrage.
ex.cn: 裁判的话引起了公愤。

ex.en: Environmentalists have expressed outrage at the ruling.
ex.cn: 环境保护主义者对这一裁决表示愤慨。

senses.def: an act or event that is violent, cruel or very wrong and that shocks people or makes them very angry

ex.en: No one has yet claimed responsibility for this latest bomb outrage.
ex.cn: 迄今还没有人宣称对最近的爆炸丑行负责。

senses.def: to make sb very shocked and angry

ex.en: He was outraged at the way he had been treated.
ex.cn: 他对所遭受的待遇感到非常愤怒。

senses.def: very shocking and unacceptable

ex.en: outrageous behaviour
ex.cn: 极端无礼的行为

ex.en: 'That's outrageous!' he protested.
ex.cn: “简直骇人听闻！” 他抗议说。

senses.def: very unusual and slightly shocking

ex.en: She says the most outrageous things sometimes.
ex.cn: 她有时候尽说些耸人听闻的事。

ex.en: outrageous clothes
ex.cn: 怪里怪气的服装

senses.def: to be of higher rank, quality, etc. than sb
senses.chn: （在职衔、质量等上）超过，在…之上

senses.def: the activity of an organization that provides a service or advice to people in the community, especially those who cannot or are unlikely to come to an office, a hospital, etc. for help
senses.chn: 外展服务（在服务机构以外的场所提供的社区服务等）

ex.en: an outreach and education programme
ex.cn: 外展服务及教育计划

ex.en: outreach workers
ex.cn: 外展服务人员

ex.en: efforts to expand the outreach to black voters
ex.cn: 扩大对黑人选民外展服务的努力

senses.def: a person who rides a motorcycle or a horse in front of or beside the vehicle of an important person in order to give protection
senses.chn: （要人座车周围的）骑士护卫，摩托护卫

senses.def: a wooden structure that is fixed to the side of a boat or ship in order to keep it steady in the water; a boat fitted with such a structure
senses.chn: 舷外托架；有舷外托架的小船

senses.def: complete and total

ex.en: an outright ban/rejection/victory
ex.cn: 完全禁止；断然拒绝；彻底胜利

ex.en: She was the outright winner.
ex.cn: 她是绝对的优胜者。

ex.en: No one party is expected to gain an outright majority.
ex.cn: 没有任何政党可望获得绝对多数。

senses.def: open and direct
senses.chn: 公开的；直率的；直截了当的

ex.en: There was outright opposition to the plan.
ex.cn: 该计划遭到公开直接反对。

senses.def: in a direct way and without trying to hide anything
senses.chn: 公开地；直率地；毫无保留地

ex.en: Why don't you ask him outright if it's true?
ex.cn: 你为什么不直截了当地问他那是否属实？

ex.en: She couldn't help herself and she laughed outright.
ex.cn: 她忍不住大笑起来。

senses.def: clearly and completely

ex.en: Neither candidate won outright.
ex.cn: 两个候选人谁也没干脆利落地获胜。

ex.en: The group rejects outright any negotiations with the government.
ex.cn: 这个团体断然拒绝与政府进行任何谈判。

senses.def: not gradually; immediately

ex.en: Most of the crash victims were killed outright.
ex.cn: 飞机坠毁的遇难者大都是当场死亡。

ex.en: We had saved enough money to buy the house outright.
ex.cn: 我们存了足够的钱，能一次付清款项买下这所房子。

senses.def: to run faster or further than sb/sth

ex.en: He couldn't outrun his pursuers.
ex.cn: 他跑不过追他的人。

senses.def: to develop faster than sth

ex.en: Demand for the new model is outrunning supply.
ex.cn: 新型号的产品供不应求。

senses.def: to sell more or to be sold in larger quantities than sb/sth

ex.en: We are now outselling all our competitors.
ex.cn: 我们现在比所有竞争对手都卖得多。

ex.en: This year the newspaper has outsold its main rival.
ex.cn: 今年该报的发行量已超过了它的主要对手。

senses.def: at/from the beginning of sth

ex.en: I made it clear right from the outset that I disapproved.
ex.cn: 从一开始我就明确地说我不赞成。

senses.def: to be more impressive than sb/sth; to be better than sb/sth
senses.chn: 比…做得好；使逊色；高人一筹

senses.def: the outer side or surface of sth

ex.en: The outside of the house needs painting.
ex.cn: 房子的外墙需要油漆一下。

ex.en: You can't open the door from the outside.
ex.cn: 你从外边打不开这个门。

senses.def: the area that is near or around a building, etc.

ex.en: I walked around the outside of the building.
ex.cn: 我绕着这座建筑四周散步。

ex.en: I didn't go into the temple—I only saw it from the outside.
ex.cn: 我没有走进庙宇，只是从外面看了一下。

senses.def: the part of a road nearest to the middle

ex.en: Always overtake on the outside.
ex.cn: 超车务必走外侧道。

senses.def: the part of a curving road or track furthest from the inner or shorter side of the curve
senses.chn: （弯曲路面或轨道的）外道，外缘

senses.def: at the most; as a maximum

ex.en: There was room for 20 people at the outside.
ex.cn: 最多只能容纳 20 个人。

senses.def: used to describe how sb appears or seems

ex.en: On the outside she seems calm, but I know she's worried.
ex.cn: 她貌似镇定，但我知道她有心事。

senses.def: not in prison

ex.en: Life on the outside took some getting used to again.
ex.cn: 费了很大劲儿才慢慢适应了狱后的生活。

senses.def: of, on or facing the outer side
senses.chn: 外部的；在外面的；向外的

ex.en: The outside walls are damp.
ex.cn: 外墙潮湿。

senses.def: not located in the main building; going out of the main building
senses.chn: 主建筑物以外的；向外面的

ex.en: an outside toilet
ex.cn: 户外厕所

ex.en: You have to pay to make outside calls.
ex.cn: 打外线电话必须付费。

ex.en: I can't get an outside line.
ex.cn: 我接不通外线。

senses.def: not included in or connected with your group, organization, country, etc.
senses.chn: 不属于本团体（或机构、国家等）的；外部的；不相关的

ex.en: We plan to use an outside firm of consultants.
ex.cn: 我们计划利用外面的咨询公司。

ex.en: She has a lot of outside interests (= not connected with her work).
ex.cn: 她有许多业余爱好。

ex.en: They felt cut off from the outside world (= from other people and from other things that were happening).
ex.cn: 他们觉得与外界隔绝了。

senses.def: used to say that sth is very unlikely
senses.chn: 不可能的；可能性极小的

ex.en: They have only an outside chance of winning.
ex.cn: 他们的胜算极小。

ex.en: 150 is an outside estimate (= it is very likely to be less).
ex.cn: 估计最多不超过 150。

senses.def: on or to a place on the outside of sth

ex.en: You can park your car outside our house.
ex.cn: 你可以把汽车停在我们家屋外。

senses.def: away from or not in a particular place

ex.en: It's the biggest theme park outside the United States.
ex.cn: 这是美国以外最大的主题游乐园。

ex.en: We live in a small village just outside Leeds.
ex.cn: 我们就住在利兹市外的一个小村子里。

senses.def: not part of sth

ex.en: The matter is outside my area of responsibility.
ex.cn: 此事不属于我的职责范围。

ex.en: You may do as you wish outside working hours.
ex.cn: 上班时间以外，你爱干什么就干什么。

senses.def: apart from

ex.en: There was nothing they could do, outside of hoping things would get better.
ex.cn: 除了盼望情况好转，他们无能为力。

senses.def: not in a room, building or container but on or to the outside of it

ex.en: I'm seeing a patient—please wait outside.
ex.cn: 我正在给病人看病，请在外面等候。

ex.en: The house is painted green outside.
ex.cn: 房子的外墙漆成了绿色。

senses.def: not inside a building

ex.en: It's warm enough to eat outside.
ex.cn: 天气暖和了，可以露天吃饭了。

ex.en: Go outside and see if it's raining.
ex.cn: 去外边看看是否下雨了。

senses.def: a programme filmed or recorded away from the main studio
senses.chn: 实地拍摄的节目；现场录制的节目

senses.def: the part of a major road such as a motorway or interstate nearest the middle of the road, where vehicles drive fastest and can go past vehicles ahead
senses.chn: （高速公路等靠近路中心的）外车道，超车道

senses.def: a person who is not accepted as a member of a society, group, etc.

ex.en: Here she felt she would always be an outsider.
ex.cn: 她在这里总觉得是个外人。

senses.def: a person who is not part of a particular organization or profession

ex.en: They have decided to hire outsiders for some of the key positions.
ex.cn: 他们决定在某些关键职位上聘任外来人员。

ex.en: To an outsider it may appear to be a glamorous job.
ex.cn: 在外面的人看来，这似乎是一份令人向往的工作。

senses.def: a person or an animal taking part in a race or competition that is not expected to win
senses.chn: （比赛中）不被看好的人（或动物）

ex.en: The race was won by a 20–1 outsider.
ex.cn: 比赛获胜者是匹不被看好、1 赔 20 的赛马。

ex.en: To everyone's surprise, the post went to a rank outsider (= a complete outsider ).
ex.cn: 出人意料的是，那个职位竟然落到一个毫不起眼的人头上。

senses.def: larger than the usual size
senses.chn: 较大的；超过一般型号的

ex.en: an outsize desk
ex.cn: 一张特大号桌子

senses.def: designed for large people

ex.en: outsize clothes
ex.cn: 特大号服装

senses.def: the parts of a town or city that are furthest from the centre

ex.en: They live on the outskirts of Milan.
ex.cn: 他们住在米兰市郊。

senses.def: to gain an advantage over sb by acting in a clever way

ex.en: She always managed to outsmart her political rivals.
ex.cn: 她总有办法表现得比她的政敌智高一筹。

senses.def: to arrange for sb outside a company to do work or provide goods for that company

ex.en: We outsource all our computing work.
ex.cn: 我们把全部计算工作包给外边去做。

senses.def: saying exactly what you think, even if this shocks or offends people
senses.chn: 直率的，直言不讳的（不怕得罪人）

ex.en: an outspoken opponent of the leader
ex.cn: 一个直言不讳反对领导的人

ex.en: outspoken comments
ex.cn: 直率的评论

ex.en: She was outspoken in her criticism of the plan.
ex.cn: 她直言不讳批评该计划。

ex.en: Thank you for being so honest with me.
ex.cn: 感谢你对我这么坦诚。

ex.en: To be frank with you, I think your son has little chance of passing the exam.
ex.cn: 坦白说，我认为你的儿子不大可能通过考试。

ex.en: You'll have to get used to his direct manner.
ex.cn: 你得慢慢习惯他这种直率的方式。

senses.def: spread out completely

ex.en: The bird soared high, with outspread wings.
ex.cn: 鸟儿展翅高飞。

senses.def: extremely good; excellent

ex.en: an outstanding player/achievement/success
ex.cn: 杰出的运动员／成绩／成就

ex.en: an area of outstanding natural beauty
ex.cn: 自然风景极美的地区

ex.en: The rooms are excellent value at $20 a night.
ex.cn: 这些房间一晚 20 美元太合算了。

ex.en: He speaks excellent English.
ex.cn: 他英语说得棒极了。

ex.en: You can all come? Excellent!
ex.cn: 你们都能来？太好了！

ex.en: an outstanding achievement
ex.cn: 杰出的成绩

senses.def: very obvious or important

ex.en: the outstanding features of the landscape
ex.cn: 这一景观的突出特征

senses.def: not yet paid, done, solved, etc.
senses.chn: 未支付的；未完成的；未解决的

ex.en: She has outstanding debts of over £500.
ex.cn: 她未清偿的债务超过 500 英镑。

ex.en: A lot of work is still outstanding.
ex.cn: 许多工作尚未完成。

senses.def: used to emphasize the good quality of sth

ex.en: outstandingly successful
ex.cn: 非常成功

senses.def: extremely well

ex.en: He performed well but not outstandingly.
ex.cn: 他表演得还不错，但算不上非常出色。

senses.def: a branch of a company or an organization that is far from the headquarters (= the place from which the company or organization is controlled)
senses.chn: （远离总部的）外设分公司，外设分部

senses.def: working or studying in a place where you do not live
senses.chn: （工作或学习）在非居住地的；离家在外的

ex.en: The business school has accommodation for outstation students.
ex.cn: 商学院为外地学生提供住宿。

senses.def: a cheque from a bank account in one place that is exchanged for money in another city, state, etc.
to stay somewhere as a guest longer than you are wanted
senses.chn: 做客太久而不再受欢迎

senses.def: stretched or spread out as far as possible

ex.en: He ran towards her with arms outstretched/with outstretched arms.
ex.cn: 他张开双臂朝她飞奔而去。

senses.def: to become larger, more important, etc. than sb/sth
senses.chn: 比…大（或重要等）；超过；胜过

ex.en: Demand is outstripping supply.
ex.cn: 需求快超过供给了。

senses.def: to be faster, better or more successful than sb you are competing against

ex.en: Their latest computer outstrips all its rivals.
ex.cn: 他们最新型的计算机超越了所有的对手。

senses.def: to run faster than sb in a race so that you pass them
used for writing the way 'out of' is sometimes pronounced in informal speech
senses.chn: （用于书写，表示 out of 在非正式口语中的发音）

ex.en: I'm outta here!(= I'm leaving now.)
ex.cn: 我要走了！

senses.def: a piece of a film that is removed before the film/movie is shown, for example because it contains a mistake
senses.chn: （电影的）不选用镜头，剪掉的镜头

senses.def: (of people) different, confident, having strong opinions, and attracting attention to yourself ; (of ideas) different from what most people consider normal, but exciting
senses.chn: （人）特立独行的；（想法）吸引他人瞩目的，让人耳目一新的；自成一格的

ex.en: Wow, this is such an out-there character. This role is definitely going to be cool.
ex.cn: 哇，这是个如此个性鲜明的人物。这个角色一定很酷。

ex.en: It may be totally out-there but I think it could work.
ex.cn: 这可能离经叛道，但我认为行得通。

senses.def: behaving in a strange or confused way
far away from land where the sea is deepest

ex.en: She fell overboard and was swept out to sea.
ex.cn: 她从船上落入水中，被海浪冲向外海。

senses.def: (in an office) a container on your desk for letters or documents that are waiting to be sent out or passed to sb else
to defeat sb/sth by winning a larger number of votes

ex.en: His proposal was outvoted by 10 votes to 8.
ex.cn: 他的提案以 10 比 8 票被否决。

senses.def: connected with the way people or things seem to be rather than with what is actually true

ex.en: Mark showed no outward signs of distress.
ex.cn: 马克在外表上没有现出沮丧的神色来。

ex.en: She simply observes the outward forms of religion.
ex.cn: 她只是表面上信教而已。

ex.en: To all outward appearances (= as far as it was possible to judge from the outside) they were perfectly happy.
ex.cn: 从外表上怎么看他们都显得无比幸福。

senses.def: going away from a particular place, especially one that you are going to return to

ex.en: the outward voyage/journey
ex.cn: 外出航程／旅程

senses.def: away from the centre or a particular point

ex.en: outward movement
ex.cn: 向外的运动

ex.en: outward investment (= in other countries)
ex.cn: 对外投资

ex.en: Managers need to become more outward-looking (= more open to new ideas).
ex.cn: 管理人员需要有更广阔的视野。

senses.def: going away from home or a particular place
on the surface; in appearance

ex.en: Though badly frightened, she remained outwardly composed.
ex.cn: 她虽然非常害怕，但表面上依然很镇静。

ex.en: Outwardly, the couple seemed perfectly happy.
ex.cn: 表面上看，这对夫妇似乎幸福美满。

senses.def: towards the outside; away from the centre or from a particular point

ex.en: The door opens outwards.
ex.cn: 这个门向外开。

ex.en: Factories were spreading outwards from the old heart of the town.
ex.cn: 工厂从旧城中心逐渐向外扩展。

senses.def: to be greater or more important than sth

ex.en: The advantages far outweigh the disadvantages.
ex.cn: 利远大于弊。

senses.def: to defeat sb/sth or gain an advantage over them by doing sth clever

ex.en: Somehow he always manages to outwit his opponents.
ex.cn: 他反正总能设法智胜对手。

senses.def: outside of sth; not within sth
work that is done by people at home
the activity of doing work away from the office or factory that provides the work
senses.chn: （由单位或公司发包的）外包工作

senses.def: old-fashioned and no longer useful

ex.en: outworn institutions
ex.cn: 陈腐的习俗

senses.def: a strong alcoholic drink from Greece, made from aniseed and usually drunk with water
senses.chn: 茴香烈酒（希腊产，通常兑水饮用）

senses.def: shaped like an egg

ex.en: an oval face
ex.cn: 鹅蛋脸

senses.def: an oval shape
a ground for Australian Rules football
senses.chn: 澳大利亚式橄榄球球场

senses.def: either of the two organs in a woman's body that produce eggs; a similar organ in female animals, birds and fish
the part of a plant that produces seeds
enthusiastic clapping by an audience as a sign of their approval

ex.en: to give sb a huge/rapturous/rousing ovation
ex.cn: 对某人表示万分的／狂热的／热烈的欢迎

ex.en: The soloist got a ten-minute standing ovation (= in which people stand up from their seats).
ex.cn: 独奏演员受到了长达十分钟的起立鼓掌欢呼。

senses.def: the part of a cooker/stove shaped like a box with a door on the front, in which food is cooked or heated

ex.en: Take the cake out of the oven.
ex.cn: 把蛋糕从烤箱中取出来。

ex.en: a gas/an electric oven
ex.cn: 煤气／电烤箱

ex.en: a cool/hot/moderate oven
ex.cn: 低温／高温／中温烤箱

ex.en: Open a window, it's like an oven in here!
ex.cn: 打开窗户。这儿热得像火炉！

senses.def: a glove made of thick material, used for holding hot dishes from an oven
suitable for use in a hot oven
senses.chn: 适于烤箱内用的；耐热的

ex.en: an ovenproof dish
ex.cn: 耐热碟子

senses.def: bought already prepared and ready for cooking
senses.chn: 已调制好的；加工过的；可直接入炉的

senses.def: dishes that can be used for cooking food in an oven
downwards and away from a vertical position
senses.chn: 从直立位置向下和向外；落下；倒下

ex.en: Try not to knock that vase over.
ex.cn: 小心别把那个花瓶碰倒了。

ex.en: The wind must have blown it over.
ex.cn: 准是风把它吹倒了。

senses.def: from one side to another side

ex.en: She turned over onto her front.
ex.cn: 她翻过身俯卧着。

ex.en: The car skidded off the road and rolled over and over.
ex.cn: 汽车滑出路面不断翻滚。

senses.def: across a street, an open space, etc.
senses.chn: 穿过（街道、开阔的空间等）

ex.en: I stopped and crossed over.
ex.cn: 我停下来，走到对面。

ex.en: He rowed us over to the other side of the lake.
ex.cn: 他把我们摆渡到湖的对岸。

ex.en: They have gone over to France.
ex.cn: 他们渡海到法国去了。

ex.en: This is my aunt who's over from Canada.
ex.cn: 这是我姑姑，她是从加拿大过来的。

ex.en: I went over (= across the room) and asked her name.
ex.cn: 我走过去问她叫什么名字。

ex.en: Put it down over there.
ex.cn: 把东西放到那边去。

senses.def: so as to cover sb/sth completely

ex.en: The lake was frozen over.
ex.cn: 湖面完全封冻了。

ex.en: Cover her over with a blanket.
ex.cn: 给她盖条毯子。

senses.def: above; more

ex.en: children of 14 and over
ex.cn: 14 岁及 14 岁以上的儿童

ex.en: You get an A grade for scores of 75 and over.
ex.cn: 75 分及 75 分以上的分数就是优等。

senses.def: remaining; not used or needed
senses.chn: 剩余的；未用的；不需要的

ex.en: If there's any food left over, put it in the fridge.
ex.cn: 要是有剩下的饭菜，就放到冰箱里。

senses.def: again

ex.en: He repeated it several times over until he could remember it.
ex.cn: 他重复了几遍直到能记住为止。

ex.en: It's all wrong—you'll have to do it over.
ex.cn: 完全错了。你得重做一遍。

senses.def: ended

ex.en: By the time we arrived the meeting was over.
ex.cn: 我们到达时，会议已经结束了。

ex.en: Thank goodness that's over!
ex.cn: 谢天谢地，事情总算过去了！

ex.en: I was glad when it was over and done with.
ex.cn: 事情终告了结，我很高兴。

senses.def: used to talk about sb/sth changing position

ex.en: He's gone over to the enemy (= joined them).
ex.cn: 他已变节投敌。

ex.en: Please change the wheels over (= for example, put the front wheels at the back).
ex.cn: 请把轮子调个个儿。

ex.en: Let's ask some friends over (= to our home).
ex.cn: 咱们邀请几个朋友来家里吧。

ex.en: Hand over the money!
ex.cn: 把钱交出来！

senses.def: used when communicating by radio

ex.en: Message received. Over (= it is your turn to speak).
ex.cn: 消息收到了。完毕。

ex.en: Message understood. Over and out.
ex.cn: 消息听懂了。通话完毕。

senses.def: a second time from the beginning

ex.en: He did the work so badly that I had to do it all over again myself.
ex.cn: 他活儿做得太糟糕了，我只好亲自从头再做一次。

senses.def: in contrast with sth
many times; repeatedly

ex.en: I've told you over and over again not to do that.
ex.cn: 我已一再跟你讲不要再那么做了。

senses.def: used to say that it is sb's turn to do sth
resting on the surface of sb/sth and partly or completely covering them/it

ex.en: She put a blanket over the sleeping child.
ex.cn: 她给熟睡的孩子盖上毯子。

ex.en: He wore an overcoat over his suit.
ex.cn: 他在西服外面再加了一件大衣。

ex.en: She put her hand over her mouth to stop herself from screaming.
ex.cn: 她用手捂住嘴，以免叫出声来。

senses.def: in or to a position higher than but not touching sb/sth; above sb/sth

ex.en: They held a large umbrella over her.
ex.cn: 他们给她撑起一把大伞。

ex.en: The balcony juts out over the street.
ex.cn: 阳台伸出在街道上方。

ex.en: There was a lamp hanging over the table.
ex.cn: 桌子上方吊着一盏灯。

senses.def: from one side of sth to the other; across sth

ex.en: a bridge over the river
ex.cn: 横跨河面的桥

ex.en: They ran over the grass.
ex.cn: 他们跑过草地。

ex.en: They had a wonderful view over the park.
ex.cn: 他们放眼望去，把公园美丽的景色尽收眼底。

senses.def: on the far or opposite side of sth

ex.en: He lives over the road.
ex.cn: 他住在马路对面。

senses.def: so as to cross sth and be on the other side

ex.en: She climbed over the wall.
ex.cn: 她翻过墙去。

senses.def: falling from or down from a place

ex.en: The car had toppled over the cliff.
ex.cn: 汽车从山崖上跌落下去了。

ex.en: He didn't dare look over the edge.
ex.cn: 他不敢从边缘向下看。

senses.def: in or on all or most parts of sth

ex.en: Snow is falling all over the country.
ex.cn: 全国各地都在下雪。

ex.en: They've travelled all over the world.
ex.cn: 他们游遍了全世界。

ex.en: There were papers lying around all over the place.
ex.cn: 文件散落一地。

senses.def: more than a particular time, amount, cost, etc.
senses.chn: 多于（某时间、数量、花费等）

ex.en: over 3 million copies sold
ex.cn: 售出三百多万册

ex.en: She stayed in Lagos for over a month.
ex.cn: 她在拉各斯待了一个多月。

ex.en: He's over sixty.
ex.cn: 他六十多岁了。

senses.def: used to show that sb has control or authority

ex.en: She has only the director over her.
ex.cn: 她的上司只有主任一个。

ex.en: He ruled over a great empire.
ex.cn: 他统治着一个大帝国。

ex.en: She has editorial control over what is included.
ex.cn: 她有权决定编辑的内容。

senses.def: during sth

ex.en: We'll discuss it over lunch.
ex.cn: 我们将在吃午饭时商量此事。

ex.en: Over the next few days they got to know the town well.
ex.cn: 在以后几天中，他们逐渐熟悉了这个小镇。

ex.en: She has not changed much over the years.
ex.cn: 这些年来她没有多大变化。

ex.en: He built up the business over a period of ten years.
ex.cn: 他用了十年时间把这个企业创建起来。

ex.en: We're away over (= until after) the New Year.
ex.cn: 新年期间我们不在家。

senses.def: past a particular difficult stage or situation

ex.en: We're over the worst of the recession.
ex.cn: 我们已渡过了经济衰退的最艰难时期。

ex.en: It took her ages to get over her illness.
ex.cn: 她花了很长时间才把病治好。

senses.def: because of or concerning sth; about sth

ex.en: an argument over money
ex.cn: 为了钱的争吵

ex.en: a disagreement over the best way to proceed
ex.cn: 在如何最好地推进工作这一问题上出现的分歧

senses.def: using sth; by means of sth

ex.en: We heard it over the radio.
ex.cn: 我们从广播中听到的。

ex.en: She wouldn't tell me over the phone.
ex.cn: 她不肯在电话里告诉我。

senses.def: louder than sth

ex.en: I couldn't hear what he said over the noise of the traffic.
ex.cn: 交通噪声太大，我听不清他说的话。

senses.def: in addition to sth

ex.en: There are other factors over and above those we have discussed.
ex.cn: 除了我们所讨论的之外，还有其他因素。

senses.def: a series of six balls bowled by the same person
senses.chn: 一轮投球（同一个投球手连续投出的六个球）

senses.def: more than usual; too much

ex.en: overproduction
ex.cn: 生产过剩

ex.en: overload
ex.cn: 使超载

ex.en: over-optimistic
ex.cn: 过分乐观的

ex.en: overconfident
ex.cn: 过分自信的

ex.en: overanxious
ex.cn: 过于急切

senses.def: completely

ex.en: overjoyed
ex.cn: 十分高兴

senses.def: upper; outer; extra

ex.en: overcoat
ex.cn: 长大衣

ex.en: overtime
ex.cn: 加班

senses.def: over; above

ex.en: overcast
ex.cn: 阴云密布

ex.en: overhang
ex.cn: 悬挂

senses.def: to do better than expected in your studies or work
senses.chn: 学习（或工作）得比预期好；取得比预期好的成绩

senses.def: to try too hard to be successful in your work
to behave in a way that is exaggerated and not natural, especially when you are acting a part in a play
senses.chn: 举止过火；表现做作；过分夸张地表演

senses.def: causing harm by doing sth too much

ex.en: an overactive thyroid
ex.cn: 亢进的甲状腺

senses.def: too active, especially so that they imagine things that are not true
senses.chn: 过于活跃的；（尤指）想入非非的

ex.en: She suffers from an overactive imagination.
ex.cn: 她患上了狂想症。

senses.def: in contrast with sth
too old to be allowed to do a particular thing
including all the things or people that are involved in a particular situation; general

ex.en: the person with overall responsibility for the project
ex.cn: 全面负责本项目的人

ex.en: There will be winners in each of three age groups, and one overall winner.
ex.cn: 三个年龄组将各产生一位优胜者，另有一位总优胜者。

ex.en: an overall improvement in standards of living (= affecting everyone)
ex.cn: 生活水平的全面提高

ex.en: When she finished painting, she stepped back to admire the overall effect.
ex.cn: 画完以后，她退后一步，以审视总体效果。

senses.def: including everything or everyone; in total

ex.en: The company will invest $1.6m overall in new equipment.
ex.cn: 这个公司将总计投资 160 万美元购置新设备。

senses.def: generally; when you consider everything
senses.chn: 一般来说；大致上；总体上

ex.en: Overall, this is a very useful book.
ex.cn: 总的来说，这是一本很有用的书。

ex.en: In conclusion, the study has provided useful insights into the issues relating to people's perception of crime.
ex.cn: 综上所述，本研究为人们对犯罪活动的认识问题提供了有益的见解。

ex.en: Based on this study, it can be concluded that the introduction of new street lighting did not reduce reported crime.
ex.cn: 基于这项研究可以得出这样的结论：增加街道照明设备并没有使犯罪案件报案数量减少。

ex.en: To sum up, no evidence can be found to support the view that improved street lighting reduces reported crime.
ex.cn: 总而言之，没有证据表明街道照明的改进能使犯罪案件报案数量减少。

ex.en: The available evidence clearly leads to the conclusion that the media do have an influence on the public perception of crime.
ex.cn: 现有证据显然可以得出这一结论：公众对犯罪活动的认识确实受到媒体的影响。

ex.en: The main conclusion to be drawn from this study is that public perception of crime is significantly influenced by crime news reporting.
ex.cn: 本研究可以得出的一个主要结论是：公众对犯罪活动的认识受到犯罪新闻报道的很大影响。

senses.def: a loose coat worn over other clothes to protect them from dirt, etc.

ex.en: The lab assistant was wearing a white overall.
ex.cn: 实验室助手穿着一件白罩衣。

senses.def: a loose piece of clothing like a shirt and trousers/pants in one piece, made of heavy cloth and usually worn over other clothing by workers doing dirty work

ex.en: The mechanic was wearing a pair of blue overalls.
ex.cn: 机修工穿着一件蓝色工装连衣裤。

senses.def: a piece of clothing that consists of trousers/pants with an extra piece of cloth covering the chest, held up by strips of cloth over the shoulders
more votes in an election or vote than all the other people or parties together
senses.chn: 总体多数（票数超过其他人或政党票数的总和）

senses.def: the difference between the number of members that the government has in a parliament and the number that all the other political parties have together
senses.chn: 总体优势（执政党在议会中的议员人数与所有其他政党议员总数的差额）

ex.en: a huge 101-seat overall majority
ex.cn: 多达 101 个席位的总体优势

senses.def: too determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc.
senses.chn: 进取心过强的；野心过大的

senses.def: unsuccessful or likely to be unsuccessful because of needing too much effort, money or time
senses.chn: 所需投入过大的，目标过高的（因而未成功或成功机会甚微）

ex.en: Her plans were overambitious.
ex.cn: 她的计划都过于宏大。

senses.def: in addition to sth

ex.en: There are other factors over and above those we have discussed.
ex.cn: 除了我们所讨论的之外，还有其他因素。

senses.def: very important, because it includes or influences many things
senses.chn: 非常重要的；首要的；概莫能外的

senses.def: if you throw a ball overarm, you throw it with your arm swung backwards and then lifted high above your shoulder
senses.chn: 肩上投球（投球时举手过肩）

senses.def: to impress sb so much that they feel nervous or frightened
to lose your balance and fall; to make sb/sth lose their balance and fall

ex.en: He overbalanced and fell into the water.
ex.cn: 他失去了平衡，落入水中。

senses.def: trying to control other people in an unpleasant way

ex.en: an overbearing manner
ex.cn: 专断的作风

senses.def: a condition in which a person or animal's upper jaw is too far forward in relation to their lower jaw
that is made to seem larger, more impressive or more important than it really is
senses.chn: 过分的；夸张的；虚饰过度的

senses.def: past the best, most beautiful stage
over the side of a boat or a ship into the water

ex.en: to fall/jump overboard
ex.cn: 从船上落入／跳入水中

ex.en: Huge waves washed him overboard.
ex.cn: 巨浪把他冲下甲板卷入海中。

senses.def: to be too excited or enthusiastic about sth or about doing sth

ex.en: Don't go overboard on fitness.
ex.cn: 别过分热衷健身运动。

senses.def: to get rid of sb/sth that you think is useless
to sell more tickets on a plane or reserve more rooms in a hotel than there are places available
senses.chn: 超额预订（飞机座位或旅馆客房）

ex.en: The flight was heavily overbooked.
ex.cn: 该班机售票大大超出机位数量。

senses.def: a bridge over a railway/railroad or road
to give sb/sth more work, worry, etc. than they can deal with
the situation in which an industry or a factory cannot sell as much as it is designed to produce
covered with clouds; dull

ex.en: an overcast sky/day
ex.cn: 阴沉的天空／天气

ex.en: Today it will be dull and overcast.
ex.cn: 今天将为阴天。

senses.def: too careful
senses.chn: 过于谨慎的；过分小心的

senses.def: to make sb pay too much for sth

ex.en: Make sure they don't overcharge you for the drinks.
ex.cn: 注意别让他们多收饮料费。

ex.en: We were overcharged by £5.
ex.cn: 我们让人家多收了 5 英镑。

senses.def: a long warm coat worn in cold weather
to succeed in dealing with or controlling a problem that has been preventing you from achieving sth

ex.en: She overcame injury to win the Olympic gold medal.
ex.cn: 她战胜了伤痛，赢得了奥运会金牌。

ex.en: The two parties managed to overcome their differences on the issue.
ex.cn: 两个政党设法弥合了在这个问题上的分歧。

senses.def: to defeat sb
