ex.en: In the final game Sweden easily overcame France.
ex.cn: 在决赛中，瑞典队轻松战胜了法国队。

senses.def: to be extremely strongly affected by sth

ex.en: Her parents were overcome with grief at the funeral.
ex.cn: 在葬礼上她的父母悲痛欲绝。

ex.en: The dead woman had been overcome by smoke.
ex.cn: 这个女人是被烟呛死的。

senses.def: to do too much when trying to correct a problem and so cause a different problem
senses.chn: 过度补偿（为纠正某事而做得过分）；矫枉过正

ex.en: She overcompensated for her shyness by talking too much and laughing too loud.
ex.cn: 她努力克服羞怯，却矫枉过正，说话太多，笑声太大。

senses.def: too confident
to cook food for too long
too critical
senses.chn: 过分挑剔的；吹毛求疵的

senses.def: with too many people or things in it

ex.en: overcrowded cities/prisons
ex.cn: 拥挤不堪的城市／监狱

ex.en: Too many poor people are living in overcrowded conditions.
ex.cn: 有太多贫民生活在十分拥挤的条件下。

senses.def: the situation when there are too many people or things in one place
that has grown too large
senses.chn: 发育过度的；过于发达的

ex.en: overdeveloped muscles
ex.cn: 过于发达的肌肉

ex.en: an overdeveloped sense of humour
ex.cn: 过分的幽默感

senses.def: to do sth too much; to exaggerate sth
senses.chn: 做得过分；做得过火；夸张

ex.en: She really overdid the sympathy (= and so did not seem sincere).
ex.cn: 她真是同情得过火了。

senses.def: to use too much of sth

ex.en: Don't overdo the salt in the food.
ex.cn: 菜里别放太多盐。

ex.en: Use illustrations where appropriate but don't overdo it.
ex.cn: 要适当地使用插图，但不宜过多。

senses.def: to cook sth for too long

ex.en: The fish was overdone and very dry.
ex.cn: 这鱼烧的时间太长，都干掉了。

senses.def: to work, study, etc. too hard or for too long

ex.en: He's been overdoing things recently.
ex.cn: 他最近过于努力了。

ex.en: I overdid it in the gym and hurt my back.
ex.cn: 我在健身房练得过火了，结果弄伤了背。

senses.def: a person, organization or country that is successful or in a stronger position than others, especially when they seem to have an unfair advantage
senses.chn: （尤指不公正地）占上风者，占优势者；特权阶层

ex.en: political leaders who support the interests of the overdog
ex.cn: 支持特权阶层利益的政治领导人

senses.def: too much of a drug taken at one time

ex.en: a drug/drugs overdose
ex.cn: 药物剂量过大

ex.en: She took a massive overdose of sleeping pills.
ex.cn: 她服用了过量的安眠药。

senses.def: to take too much of a drug at one time, so that it is dangerous

ex.en: He had overdosed on heroin.
ex.cn: 他过量服用了海洛因。

ex.en: I had overdosed on sun.
ex.cn: 我晒太阳的时间过长了。

senses.def: the amount of money that you owe to a bank when you have spent more money than is in your bank account; an arrangement that allows you to do this

ex.en: to run up/pay off an overdraft
ex.cn: 透支；付清透支

senses.def: to take out more money from a bank account than it contains

ex.en: Customers who overdraw their accounts will be charged a fee.
ex.cn: 透支的客户须付手续费。

senses.def: having taken more money out of your bank account than you have in it

ex.en: I'm overdrawn by £100.
ex.cn: 我透支了 100 英镑。

senses.def: with more money taken out than was paid in or left in

ex.en: an overdrawn account
ex.cn: 透支的账户

ex.en: Your account is £200 overdrawn.
ex.cn: 您的账户已透支 200 英镑。

senses.def: wearing clothes that are too formal or too elegant for a particular occasion
senses.chn: 穿着太正式的；打扮过分的

senses.def: an extra high gear in a vehicle, that you use when you are driving at high speeds

ex.en: to be in overdrive
ex.cn: 在超速挡驾驶

senses.def: to start being very active and working very hard
senses.chn: 加劲；加倍努力；拼命工作

ex.en: As the wedding approached, the whole family went into overdrive.
ex.cn: 随着婚礼将近，全家人都忙得不亦乐乎。

senses.def: to record new sounds over the sounds on an original recording so that both can be heard
senses.chn: 把（录音）配到原带上；叠录

senses.def: not paid, done, returned, etc. by the required or expected time
senses.chn: （到期）未付的，未做的，未还的；过期的

ex.en: an overdue payment/library book
ex.cn: 逾期的欠款；逾期未还图书馆的书

ex.en: The rent is now overdue.
ex.cn: 现在房租已属拖欠。

ex.en: Her baby is two weeks overdue.
ex.cn: 她的胎儿已超过预产期两周了。

ex.en: This car is overdue for a service.
ex.cn: 这辆汽车早就该保养了。

senses.def: that should have happened or been done before now
senses.chn: 早该发生的；早应完成的

ex.en: overdue reforms
ex.cn: 迟来的改革

ex.en: A book like this is long overdue.
ex.cn: 像这样的书早就该有人出版了。

senses.def: turned over when almost cooked and fried for a short time on the other side
to eat more than you need or more than is healthy
used to say that you think sb has done more than is necessary, or has added unnecessary details to make sth seem better or worse than it really is

ex.en: If you're telling lies, keep it simple—never over-egg the pudding.
ex.cn: 如果撒谎，措辞要简短，千万别画蛇添足。

senses.def: used to say that you think sb has done more than is necessary, or has added unnecessary details to make sth seem better or worse than it really is

ex.en: If you're telling lies, keep it simple—never over-egg the pudding.
ex.cn: 如果撒谎，措辞要简短，千万别画蛇添足。

senses.def: too much emphasis or importance

ex.en: an overemphasis on curing illness rather than preventing it
ex.cn: 过分强调治病而不是预防

senses.def: to estimate sth to be larger, better, more important, etc. than it really is

ex.en: They overestimated his ability when they promoted him.
ex.cn: 他们提拔他的时候高估了他的能力。

ex.en: The importance of these findings cannot be overestimated (= is very great).
ex.cn: 这些发现的重要性是无法充分估量的。

senses.def: an estimate about the size, cost, etc. of sth that is too high
too excited and not behaving in a calm or sensible way
senses.chn: 过度兴奋的；兴奋得忘乎所以的

ex.en: Don't get the children overexcited just before bedtime.
ex.cn: 临睡前不要让孩子过于兴奋。

senses.def: to affect the quality of a photograph or film by allowing too much light to enter the camera
to allow sb/sth to be seen too much on television, in the newspapers, etc.

ex.en: The club is careful not to let the younger players be overexposed, and rarely allows them to be interviewed.
ex.cn: 俱乐部不想让年轻队员过度曝光，因而很少允许他们接受采访。

senses.def: involved in more work or activities, or spending more money, than you can manage without problems
senses.chn: 承担过多工作；开支过大

senses.def: to give sb/sth too much food
the process of taking so many fish from the sea, a river, etc. that the number of fish in it becomes very low
to be so full that the contents go over the sides

ex.en: The bath is overflowing
ex.cn: 浴盆溢水了！

ex.en: Plates overflowed with party food.
ex.cn: 聚会上的食物碟满盘盈。

ex.en: Her heart overflowed with love.
ex.cn: 她的心里充满了爱。

ex.en: The river overflowed its banks.
ex.cn: 河水涨出了堤岸。

senses.def: to have too many people in it

ex.en: The streets were overflowing with the crowds.
ex.cn: 街上到处挤满了人。

ex.en: The hospitals are filled to overflowing (= with patients).
ex.cn: 医院都人满为患。

senses.def: to spread beyond the limits of a place or container that is too full

ex.en: The meeting overflowed into the street.
ex.cn: 集会的人群延伸到了大街上。

senses.def: a number of people or things that do not fit into the space available

ex.en: A new office block was built to accommodate the overflow of staff.
ex.cn: 新建了一座办公大楼以便容纳多出的员工。

ex.en: an overflow car park
ex.cn: 备用停车场

senses.def: the action of liquid flowing out of a container, etc. that is already full; the liquid that flows out

ex.en: an overflow of water from the lake
ex.cn: 漫出的湖水

ex.en: an overflow of powerful emotions
ex.cn: 横流的激情

senses.def: a pipe that allows extra liquid to escape
a fault that happens because a number or data item (for example, the result of a calculation) is too large for the computer to represent it exactly
senses.chn: 溢出，溢流（运算产生的数值位数或字的长度等超过存储单元的长度）

senses.def: to fly over a place

ex.en: We overflew the war zone, taking photographs.
ex.cn: 我们飞越战区摄影。

ex.en: the noise from overflying planes
ex.cn: 过往飞机发出的噪声

senses.def: liking sb/sth too much
an item of clothing that is worn over other clothes
to make a statement that is not accurate because it is too general
senses.chn: 做过分概括的陈述；说话过于笼统

senses.def: giving too much of sth
senses.chn: （施与某物时）过于慷慨，过分大方

ex.en: She is not overgenerous with praise.
ex.cn: 她不说过头的恭维话。

senses.def: if land is overgrazed, it is damaged by having too many animals feeding on it
on or above the surface of the ground, rather than under it

ex.en: The new railway line will run overground.
ex.cn: 新铁路线将采用地上铺设。

senses.def: covered with plants that have been allowed to grow wild and have not been controlled
senses.chn: 植物蔓生的；杂草丛生的

ex.en: an overgrown path
ex.cn: 长满野草的小径

ex.en: The garden's completely overgrown with weeds.
ex.cn: 花园里长满了杂草。

senses.def: that has grown too large
senses.chn: 发展过快的；长得过大的

ex.en: an overgrown village
ex.cn: 膨胀过大的村庄

ex.en: They act like a pair of overgrown children (= they are adults but they behave like children).
ex.cn: 他俩的举动就像一对大孩子。

senses.def: too much growth of sth, especially sth that grows on or over sth else
to stick out over and above sth else
senses.chn: 悬垂；悬挂；突出于某物之上

ex.en: His big fat belly overhung his belt.
ex.cn: 他那硕大肥胖的肚子垂在腰带上面。

ex.en: The path was cool and dark with overhanging trees.
ex.cn: 小路树木掩映，凉爽幽暗。

senses.def: the part of sth that sticks out over and above sth else

ex.en: The roof has an overhang to protect the walls from the rain.
ex.cn: 屋顶有飞檐突出，保护墙壁不受雨淋。

senses.def: the amount by which sth hangs over and above sth else
the state of being extra to what is required; the things that are extra

ex.en: attempts to reduce the overhang of unsold goods
ex.cn: 减少滞销商品积压的尝试

senses.def: done too soon or doing sth too soon, especially without enough thought
senses.chn: 过于匆忙的；过急的；过于草率的

ex.en: an overhasty decision
ex.cn: 过于草率的决定

ex.en: We were overhasty in making the choice.
ex.cn: 我们当初作选择时太仓促了。

senses.def: an examination of a machine or system, including doing repairs on it or making changes to it

ex.en: a complete/major overhaul
ex.cn: 彻底检修；大修

ex.en: A radical overhaul of the tax system is necessary.
ex.cn: 有必要彻底改革税制。

senses.def: to examine every part of a machine, system, etc. and make any necessary changes or repairs

ex.en: The engine has been completely overhauled.
ex.cn: 发动机已彻底检修过了。

senses.def: to come from behind a person you are competing against in a race and go past them

ex.en: He managed to overhaul the leader on the final lap.
ex.cn: 他在最后一圈发力超过了领先的选手。

senses.def: above your head; in the sky

ex.en: Planes flew overhead constantly.
ex.cn: 飞机不断从头顶上飞过。

ex.en: Thunder boomed in the sky overhead.
ex.cn: 雷声在天空中隆隆作响。

senses.def: above your head; raised above the ground
senses.chn: 头上方的；地面以上的；高架的

ex.en: overhead power lines
ex.cn: 高架输电线

senses.def: connected with the general costs of running a business or an organization, for example paying for rent or electricity

ex.en: overhead costs
ex.cn: 营运开支

senses.def: a piece of equipment that projects an image onto a wall or screen so that many people can see it
regular costs that you have when you are running a business or an organization, such as rent, electricity, wages, etc.
senses.chn: 经费；营运费用；经常性开支

ex.en: labour/production costs
ex.cn: 人工／生产成本

ex.en: rising costs
ex.cn: 正在上涨的成本

ex.en: public spending
ex.cn: 公共开支

ex.en: More spending on health was promised.
ex.cn: 已承诺增加医疗开支。

ex.en: expenditure on education
ex.cn: 教育支出

ex.en: legal expenses
ex.cn: 律师费

senses.def: to hear, especially by accident, a conversation in which you are not involved

ex.en: We talked quietly so as not to be overheard.
ex.cn: 我们低声交谈，以免别人听到。

ex.en: I overheard a conversation between two boys on the bus.
ex.cn: 我在公共汽车上无意中听到两个男孩的对话。

ex.en: We overheard them arguing.
ex.cn: 我们碰巧听到他们吵嘴。

ex.en: I overheard him say he was going to France.
ex.cn: 我偶然听见他说他要去法国。

senses.def: to become or to make sth become too hot

ex.en: The engine is overheating.
ex.cn: 发动机过热了。

ex.en: It's vital not to overheat the liquid.
ex.cn: 最关键的是不要让液体过热。

senses.def: to be too active, with rising prices
senses.chn: 发展过热，过于活跃（以致物价高涨）

senses.def: too hot

ex.en: Don't sleep in an overheated room.
ex.cn: 不要在太热的屋子里睡觉。

senses.def: too interested or excited
senses.chn: 过于热心的；过于兴奋的；痴迷的

ex.en: the figment of an overheated imagination
ex.cn: 想入非非而虚构的事物

senses.def: too active in a way that may cause problems
to have too much of sth nice, especially food or drink
senses.chn: 过多地享用（尤指食物或饮料）

senses.def: to give sb more than is good for them

ex.en: His mother overindulged him.
ex.cn: 他母亲对他过于溺爱。

senses.def: too high

ex.en: overinflated house prices
ex.cn: 过高的房价

senses.def: made to seem better, worse, more important, etc. than it really is
senses.chn: 夸张的；夸大的；言过其实的

senses.def: filled with too much air

ex.en: Overinflated tyres burst more easily.
ex.cn: 充气过量的轮胎更容易爆裂。

senses.def: extremely happy or pleased

ex.en: He was overjoyed at my success.
ex.cn: 我的成功使他欣喜若狂。

ex.en: We were overjoyed to hear their good news.
ex.cn: 听到他们的好消息，我们都大喜过望。

ex.en: She was overjoyed that her article had been published.
ex.cn: 她的文章发表了，这使她高兴极了。

senses.def: too much of sth that reduces the effect it has
senses.chn: 过犹不及；做得过火的事

ex.en: There is a danger of overkill if you plan everything too carefully.
ex.cn: 如果事事过分谨小慎微，那结果难免有适得其反的危险。

senses.def: across the land; by land, not by sea or by air
senses.chn: 横跨陆地的；通过陆路的

ex.en: an overland route
ex.cn: 陆上路线

senses.def: if one thing overlaps another, or the two things overlap, part of one thing covers part of the other

ex.en: A fish's scales overlap each other.
ex.cn: 鱼鳞一片片上下交叠。

ex.en: The floor was protected with overlapping sheets of newspaper.
ex.cn: 地板用一张搭着一张的报纸保护着。

senses.def: to make two or more things overlap

ex.en: You will need to overlap the pieces of wood slightly.
ex.cn: 你得使这些木片像鱼鳞片似的搭叠起来。

senses.def: if two events overlap or overlap each other, the second one starts before the first one has finished
to cover part of the same area of interest, knowledge, responsibility, etc.

ex.en: Our jobs overlap slightly, which sometimes causes difficulties.
ex.cn: 我们的工作略有重叠，所以有时引起一些困难。

ex.en: The language of science overlaps with that of everyday life.
ex.cn: 有些科学用语也用于日常生活。

senses.def: a shared area of interest, knowledge, responsibility, etc.

ex.en: There is (a) considerable overlap between the two subjects.
ex.cn: 两门科目之间有相当多的共通之处。

senses.def: the amount by which one thing covers another thing

ex.en: an overlap of 5 cm on each roof tile
ex.cn: 每片房瓦上 5 厘米的重叠度

senses.def: a period of time in which two events or activities happen together
senses.chn: （两事发生的）重叠时间，交接时期

ex.en: There will be an overlap of a week while John teaches Ann the job.
ex.cn: 将有一周的交接期可以让约翰教导安如何接手工作。

senses.def: to put sth on top of a surface so as to cover it completely; to lie on top of a surface

ex.en: wood overlaid with gold
ex.cn: 包金木

senses.def: to add sth, especially a feeling or quality, to sth else so that it seems to cover it
senses.chn: （尤指以感情或品质）撒满，遮掩

ex.en: The place was overlaid with memories of his childhood.
ex.cn: 这个地方处处都装点着他童年的回忆。

senses.def: a transparent sheet with drawings, figures, etc. on it that can be placed on top of another sheet in order to change it

ex.en: An overlay showing population can be placed on top of the map.
ex.cn: 可以在地图上加一层显示人口的透明膜。

senses.def: a thing that is laid on top of or covers sth else

ex.en: an overlay of fibreglass insulation
ex.cn: 玻璃纤维绝缘层

senses.def: on the other side of the page of a book, etc.
senses.chn: 在（书页等的）背面；在后面

ex.en: Complete the form overleaf.
ex.cn: 填好背面的表格。

ex.en: The changes are explained in detail overleaf.
ex.cn: 修改处在背面有详细的说明。

senses.def: to lie over sth

ex.en: overlying rock
ex.cn: 压在上面的岩石

senses.def: to put too great a load on sth

ex.en: an overloaded truck
ex.cn: 一辆超载的卡车

senses.def: to give sb too much of sth

ex.en: He's overloaded with responsibilities.
ex.cn: 他担负的责任过多。

ex.en: Don't overload the students with information.
ex.cn: 不要给学生灌输过多的信息。

senses.def: to put too great a demand on a computer, an electrical system, etc. causing it to fail
senses.chn: 使（计算机）超载运行；使（电路）超负荷

senses.def: too much of sth

ex.en: In these days of technological change we all suffer from information overload.
ex.cn: 在这科技日新月异的时代，过多的信息使人人都应接不暇。

senses.def: too long

ex.en: an overlong agenda
ex.cn: 过长的议程表

senses.def: to fail to see or notice sth

ex.en: He seems to have overlooked one important fact.
ex.cn: 他好像忽略了一个重要的事实。

senses.def: to see sth wrong or bad but decide to ignore it
senses.chn: （对不良现象等）不予理会，视而不见

ex.en: We could not afford to overlook such a serious offence.
ex.cn: 对这样严重的违法行为，我们决不能视若无睹。

senses.def: if a building, etc. overlooks a place, you can see that place from the building

ex.en: a restaurant overlooking the lake
ex.cn: 一家濒湖餐厅

ex.en: Our back yard is overlooked by several houses.
ex.cn: 好几栋房子都看得见我家的后院。

senses.def: to not consider sb for a job or position, even though they might be suitable

ex.en: She's been overlooked for promotion several times.
ex.cn: 几次提职时都没有考虑她。

senses.def: (especially in the past) a person who has power over many other people

ex.en: feudal overlords
ex.cn: 封建领主

senses.def: too; very

ex.en: I'm not overly fond of pasta.
ex.cn: 我不怎么喜欢吃意大利面食。

ex.en: We think you are being overly optimistic.
ex.cn: 我们认为你过于乐观了。

senses.def: having more workers than are needed
senses.chn: 人浮于事的；人员过多的

senses.def: too much; very much

ex.en: She didn't worry overmuch about it.
ex.cn: 她对此不太担忧。

senses.def: used to show you are strongly opposed to sth
senses.chn: （表示强烈反对）除非我死了，我死也不

ex.en: She moves into our home over my dead body.
ex.cn: 除非我死了，否则她别想搬进我们家。

senses.def: during or for the night

ex.en: We stayed overnight in London after the theatre.
ex.cn: 我们看完戏后在伦敦住了一晚。

senses.def: suddenly or quickly

ex.en: Don't expect it to improve overnight.
ex.cn: 不要指望这事一下子就改善了。

senses.def: happening during the night; for a night
senses.chn: 夜间的；晚上的；只供一夜的

ex.en: an overnight flight
ex.cn: 夜间飞行

ex.en: overnight accommodation
ex.cn: 一夜住宿

ex.en: She took only an overnight bag (= containing the things needed for a night spent away from home).
ex.cn: 她只带了一个外出住宿一晚的用品旅行袋。

senses.def: happening suddenly or quickly
senses.chn: 突然的；很快的；一夜之间的

ex.en: The play was an overnight success.
ex.cn: 这部剧作一夜成名。

senses.def: too confident that sth will be successful

ex.en: I'm not over-optimistic about my chances of getting the job.
ex.cn: 我对获得这份工作不抱太大希望。

senses.def: showing more confidence that sth will be successful than is justified by later events
senses.chn: 期望过高的；过于乐观的

ex.en: The sales forecasts turned out to be over-optimistic.
ex.cn: 结果证明销售预测过于乐观。

senses.def: a bridge that carries one road over another one
to pay sb too much; to pay sb more than their work is worth
to give too much importance to sth
to spoil your chance of success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.chn: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势

senses.def: to spoil your chance of success by judging your position to be stronger than it really is
senses.chn: 因不自量力而毁掉胜机；高估自己的地位；错估形势

senses.def: with too many people living in it
to defeat or gain control over sb completely by using greater strength

ex.en: Police finally managed to overpower the gunman.
ex.cn: 警察最终制伏了持枪歹徒。

senses.def: to be so strong or great that it affects or disturbs sb/sth seriously
senses.chn: 压倒；令人折服；使难以忍受

ex.en: Her beauty overpowered him.
ex.cn: 她的美貌令他倾倒。

ex.en: The flavour of the garlic overpowered the meat.
ex.cn: 大蒜的味道盖过了肉味。

senses.def: very strong or powerful
senses.chn: 强烈的；极强大的；坚强的

ex.en: an overpowering smell of fish
ex.cn: 浓烈的鱼腥味儿

ex.en: an overpowering personality
ex.cn: 极强的个性

ex.en: The heat was overpowering.
ex.cn: 酷热难当。

senses.def: too expensive; costing more than it is worth
senses.chn: 价格太高的；过于昂贵的

ex.en: I can't afford it—it's just too expensive for me.
ex.cn: 我买不起，对我来说这太贵了。

ex.en: an expensive restaurant
ex.cn: 高档餐馆

ex.en: You want to avoid costly legal proceedings if you can.
ex.cn: 如果能够的话你希望避免昂贵的法律诉讼。

ex.en: ridiculously overpriced designer clothes
ex.cn: 贵得离谱的名牌衣服

ex.en: Houses in the village are now too pricey for local people to afford.
ex.cn: 如今该村镇的房价太高，当地人根本买不起。

ex.en: Everything's so dear now, isn't it?
ex.cn: 现在什么东西都那么贵，是不是？

senses.def: to print sth on a document, etc. that already has printing on it
to produce more of sth than is wanted or needed
too anxious to protect sb from being hurt, in a way that restricts their freedom
senses.chn: 过分保护的；袒护的；溺爱有加的

ex.en: overprotective parents
ex.cn: 溺爱子女的父母

senses.def: having more experience or training than is necessary for a particular job, so that people do not want to employ you
to have too high an opinion of sb/sth; to put too high a value on sb/sth

ex.en: In my opinion, Hirst's work has been vastly overrated.
ex.cn: 依我看，赫斯特的作品被大大地高估了。

senses.def: to fail by trying to achieve more than is possible

ex.en: In making these promises, the company had clearly overreached itself.
ex.cn: 这家公司作出这些承诺，显然是不自量力。

senses.def: to react too strongly, especially to sth unpleasant
senses.chn: 反应过激，反应过火（尤指对不愉快的事情）

ex.en: The financial markets overreacted to the news.
ex.cn: 金融市场对这条消息反应过于强烈。

senses.def: to use your authority to reject sb's decision, order, etc.

ex.en: The chairman overrode the committee's objections and signed the agreement.
ex.cn: 主席不顾委员会的反对，径行签署了协议。

senses.def: to be more important than sth

ex.en: Considerations of safety override all other concerns.
ex.cn: 对安全的考虑高于一切。

senses.def: to stop a process that happens automatically and control it yourself
senses.chn: 超驰控制，超控（使自动控制暂时失效，改用手工控制）

ex.en: A special code is needed to override the time lock.
ex.cn: 这定时锁要用特定密码才能打开。

senses.def: more important than anything else in a particular situation
senses.chn: 最重要的；首要的；凌驾一切的

ex.en: the overriding factor/consideration/concern
ex.cn: 首要因素／考虑／关注的事

ex.en: Their overriding aim was to keep costs low.
ex.cn: 他们的首要目标是维持低成本。

senses.def: too ripe

ex.en: overripe fruit
ex.cn: 熟过头的水果

senses.def: to change a decision or reject an idea from a position of greater power

ex.en: to overrule a decision/an objection
ex.cn: （以权力）推翻决议／异议

ex.en: The verdict was overruled by the Supreme Court.
ex.cn: 最高法院驳回了那个裁决。

senses.def: to fill or spread over an area quickly, especially in large numbers

ex.en: The house was completely overrun with mice.
ex.cn: 这房子简直成了老鼠的天下。

ex.en: Enemy soldiers had overrun the island.
ex.cn: 敌军士兵侵占了该岛。

senses.def: to take more time or money than was intended

ex.en: Her lectures never overrun.
ex.cn: 她讲课从不拖堂。

ex.en: You've overrun your time by 10 minutes.
ex.cn: 你超时 10 分钟了。

senses.def: too difficult or complicated for sb to understand
senses.chn: 超过某人理解力；过于复杂

ex.en: A lot of the jokes went (= were) right over my head.
ex.cn: 那些笑话有很多我完全听不懂。

senses.def: to a higher position of authority than sb
senses.chn: 职位比某人高；超过某人

ex.en: I couldn't help feeling jealous when she was promoted over my head.
ex.cn: 她受到提拔职位超过了我，我不由得感到嫉妒。

senses.def: connected with foreign countries, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean

ex.en: overseas development/markets/trade
ex.cn: 海外发展／市场／贸易

ex.en: overseas students/visitors
ex.cn: 外国留学生／游客

senses.def: to or in a foreign country, especially those separated from your country by the sea or ocean

ex.en: to live/work/go overseas
ex.cn: 在国外生活／工作；出国

ex.en: The product is sold both at home and overseas.
ex.cn: 这个产品行销国内外。

senses.def: to watch sb/sth and make sure that a job or an activity is done correctly
a person whose job is to make sure that other workers do their work
a person or an organization that is responsible for making sure that a system is working as it should
senses.chn: （某体系的）监督者，监督机构，督察

senses.def: to say that sb/sth is better than they really are

ex.en: He has a tendency to oversell himself.
ex.cn: 他爱自我吹嘘。

senses.def: to sell too much or more of sth than is available

ex.en: The seats on the plane were oversold.
ex.cn: 飞机上的座位超卖了。

senses.def: too easily upset or offended
senses.chn: 过于敏感的；爱生气的；动不动就发脾气的

senses.def: having stronger sexual desire than is usual
to make sb/sth seem less important, or successful
senses.chn: 使显得逊色；使黯然失色

ex.en: He had always been overshadowed by his elder sister.
ex.cn: 他与他姐姐相比总是相形见绌。

senses.def: to make an event less enjoyable than it should be

ex.en: News of the accident overshadowed the day's events.
ex.cn: 出事的消息给这一天的活动蒙上了阴影。

senses.def: to throw a shadow over sth

ex.en: The garden is overshadowed by tall trees.
ex.cn: 花园中大树浓荫密布。

senses.def: to give more information than people want to hear about your personal life

ex.en: Her tendency to overshare is sometimes embarrassing!
ex.cn: 她喜欢过度分享自己的私生活，有时真叫人尴尬！

senses.def: a shoe worn over another shoe, especially in wet weather or to protect a floor
senses.chn: 套鞋，罩鞋（在雨天时或为保护地板而穿）

senses.def: to go further than the place you intended to stop or turn

ex.en: The aircraft overshot the runway.
ex.cn: 飞机冲出了跑道。

ex.en: She had overshot by 20 metres.
ex.cn: 她超过了 20 米。

senses.def: to do more or to spend more money than you originally planned
senses.chn: 超过（原计划）；突破（预计费用）

ex.en: The department may overshoot its cash limit this year.
ex.cn: 这个部门今年可能要突破现金限额。

senses.def: the fact of making a mistake because you forget to do sth or you do not notice sth

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave her name off the list; it was an oversight.
ex.cn: 我不是有意在名单上漏掉她的名字的，这是个疏忽。

senses.def: the state of being in charge of sb/sth

ex.en: The committee has oversight of finance and general policy.
ex.cn: 该委员会负责处理财政和一般性政策。

senses.def: to describe a situation, a problem, etc. in a way that is too simple and ignores some of the facts
senses.chn: 陈述过于简略；说明过于简单化

ex.en: It's easy to oversimplify the issues involved.
ex.cn: 很容易把涉及的问题看得太简单。

ex.en: an oversimplified view of human nature
ex.cn: 对人性过于简单化的看法

senses.def: bigger than the normal size; too big
senses.chn: 过大的；硕大的；大得超过正常的

senses.def: to sleep longer than you intended

ex.en: I overslept and missed the bus.
ex.cn: 我睡过了头，因此误了班车。

senses.def: to spend too much money or more than you planned
senses.chn: 花钱过多；比（预计的）花得多；超支

ex.en: The company has overspent on marketing.
ex.cn: 这个公司在市场推广方面开支过多。

ex.en: Many departments have overspent their budgets this year.
ex.cn: 许多部门今年开支都超过了预算。

senses.def: people who move out of a city because it is too crowded to an area where there is more space

ex.en: New towns were designed to house London's overspill.
ex.cn: 新的城镇是为容纳伦敦的过剩人口而设计的。

senses.def: having more workers than are needed
to say sth in a way that makes it seem more important than it really is

ex.en: He tends to overstate his case when talking politics.
ex.cn: 他一谈政治便流于夸夸其谈。

ex.en: The seriousness of the crime cannot be overstated.
ex.cn: 这一罪行的严重性怎么说也不为过。

senses.def: to stay longer than the length of time you are expected or allowed to stay

ex.en: They overstayed their visa.
ex.cn: 他们居留超过了签证期限。

senses.def: to go beyond what is normal or allowed
senses.chn: 超越（正常或允许的）范围；越权；僭越

ex.en: to overstep your authority
ex.cn: 越权

ex.en: He tends to overstep the boundaries of good taste.
ex.cn: 他往往文雅过度而流于庸俗。

senses.def: to behave in a way that people think is not acceptable
to buy or make more of sth than you need or can sell
senses.chn: 库存过多（货物）；进（货）过多

senses.def: to put too many animals in a place where there is not enough room or food for them
senses.chn: （在空间、食物不足的地方）畜养过多的动物

senses.def: to do more than you are capable of; to make sb/sth do more than they are capable of
senses.chn: （使）勉强维持，硬撑着，超负荷运转

ex.en: This will overstretch the prison service's resources.
ex.cn: 这将使监狱的资源不堪负荷。

ex.en: Credit cards can tempt you to overstretch yourself (= spend more money than you can afford).
ex.cn: 信用卡能诱使你超额消费。

senses.def: if an activity, service, etc. is oversubscribed, there are fewer places, tickets, etc. than the number of people who are asking for them
senses.chn: （活动、服务等）供不应求的，未能达到需求量的

senses.def: done in an open way and not secretly
senses.chn: 公开的；明显的；不隐瞒的

ex.en: There was little overt support for the project.
ex.cn: 对这个项目公开表示支持的很少。

senses.def: to go past a moving vehicle or person ahead of you because you are going faster than they are

ex.en: He pulled out to overtake a truck.
ex.cn: 他驶出车流，以超过一辆卡车。

ex.en: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.
ex.cn: 在弯道强行超车是危险的。

senses.def: to become greater in number, amount or importance than sth else
senses.chn: （在数量或重要性方面）大于，超过

ex.en: Nuclear energy may overtake oil as the main fuel.
ex.cn: 核能可能会超过石油成为主要燃料。

ex.en: We mustn't let ourselves be overtaken by our competitors.
ex.cn: 我们决不能让竞争对手超过我们。
